jobs.title: Sr Automation Engineer - (Development Lead)
jobs.description:
Automation Engineer – Data Centers (SCADA / Ignition / PLC )

We are seeking a Senior Controls / Automation Engineer Lead with hands-on experience in PLC programming, SCADA development, and system integration to support our mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role focuses on developing, deploying, and maintaining industrial control systems used in high-availability environments.

The ideal candidate has experience with Allen-Bradley (Rockwell) PLCs, Ignition SCADA, and industrial networking, and is comfortable working in fast-paced, uptime-sensitive environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, program, and maintain PLC control logic primarily using Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation platforms (ControlLogix, CompactLogix, MicroLogix, Micro800, Studio 5000)
  • Design and configure Ignition SCADA applications, including HMI screens, alarming, trending, and data visualization
  • Integrate PLCs, SCADA systems, and third-party devices using protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, BACnet/IP, and OPC UA
  • Support Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) and other critical infrastructure systems within data centers
  • Assist in system architecture, controls design, and network layout for industrial automation systems
  • Participate in factory testing, site commissioning, and system startup activities
  • Diagnose and resolve control system, SCADA, and communication issues in live environments
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including electrical, mechanical, and IT/OT engineers
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including control narratives

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, or a related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, or SCADA development
  • Experience with Allen-Bradley PLC programming (Studio 5000 / RSLogix500)
  • Experience developing or supporting SCADA/HMI systems, preferably Ignition
  • Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus TCP, BACnet/IP, OPC UA)
  • Solid understanding of industrial networking fundamentals (IP addressing, subnets, switches, VLANs)
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, control diagrams, and P&IDs
  • Willingness to travel for commissioning and deployment activities
  • Candidate must be based in Eastern or Central time zone

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data centers, critical infrastructure, or high-availability environments
  • Familiarity with EPMS systems and power monitoring
  • Exposure to redundant system architectures and failover strategies
  • Experience with Ignition Perspective
  • Experience working with version control, change management, and structured deployment processes

jobs.title: Medical Coding Auditor -  Evaluation & Management
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Evaluation & Management (E/M) Auditor is responsible for conducting comprehensive audits of provider documentation and coding across multiple medical specialties to ensure compliance with payer, regulatory, and organizational requirements. This role reviews E/M services and minor procedures for accuracy, appropriate code selection, and documentation integrity while identifying coding trends and educational opportunities. The auditor serves as an expert in E/M coding guidelines, specialty-specific documentation requirements, and industry regulations, including CMS and AMA.

The auditor analyzes audit findings, provides coding education feedback to providers, and supports compliance and quality improvement initiatives. This position requires strong analytical skills, in-depth knowledge of professional fee coding across diverse specialty areas, and the ability to interpret complex clinical documentation. Working with a high degree of independence, the E/M Auditor makes informed decisions, applies regulatory guidance to ambiguous situations, and collaborates with operational, clinical, and compliance teams to promote coding accuracy and revenue integrity.

The Medical Coding Auditor is responsible for validating the accuracy and compliance of CPT coding assignments through detailed reviews of medical documentation and coding practices. This role identifies trends and opportunities for improvement. The auditor applies extensive knowledge of coding guidelines, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies to support quality, compliance, and operational objectives.

The Medical Coding Auditor exercises independent judgment in evaluating coding accuracy, resolving coding discrepancies, and addressing complex or occasionally ambiguous situations. Working with minimal supervision, the auditor follows established procedures while supporting continuous improvement efforts through data analysis, audit findings, education, and collaboration with coding, compliance, and operational teams.

jobs.title: Head of AI Adoption & Enablement
jobs.description:
HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Us

HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the Travel Tech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.

We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.

HBX Group comprises best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets.


Job Summary


The Head of AI Adoption & Enablement is responsible for ensuring AI is effectively deployed and used across HBX, enabling the organization to adopt and scale AI capabilities across all functions. As an AI thought leader for the organization, the role continuously scans the market for emerging AI capabilities to ensure HBX stays at the forefront of practical, secure and scalable AI usage across all functions. Working in close partnership with Technology, the role co-defines which AI platforms and vendor capabilities are used and how they are applied, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards. The role owns the central demand management and prioritization of AI use cases (individual-contributor level and mid-tier functional level), ensuring opportunities are prioritized based on value, feasibility and scalability, and translated into measurable usage and impact, with thorough cost control. The role enables functions to deploy AI effectively by providing AI literacy training, guidance and tools, ensuring teams can adopt and implement use cases in a controlled, consistent and secure way. The role also supports the AI-empowered Workforce strategy by enabling the tools, capabilities and ways of working required to scale highest-impact AI initiatives.


Job Responsibilities

  • Define and drive adoption of the enterprise AI stack, including copilots, agentic platforms and embedded SaaS capabilities, in partnership with Technology and key vendors. Ensure alignment with technology, data and security standards, and translate business priorities into clear AI usage models and guidance across HBX.
  • Co‑define the AI licensing strategy with Technology and Procurement, establishing role‑based access models that balance value and cost. Monitor license usage, adoption and value realization to optimize or scale AI tools as needed.
  • Drive AI literacy and capability building across functions through scalable programmes, training and tools. Build an AI Champion community and ensure adoption delivers measurable behavior change, productivity gains and business impact, tracked through clear KPIs.
  • Own a central, scalable intake and prioritization process for AI use cases, classifying demand and assessing opportunities based on value, feasibility, scalability, risk and readiness. Track progress, impact and cost while identifying patterns to inform platform and governance decisions.
  • Partner with Technology to define AI and data platform requirements aligned with the AI‑enabled workforce strategy, acting as the link between business use cases and platform evolution. Ensure interoperability across the AI tool landscape and alignment with orchestration platforms.
  • Work with Legal, Risk, Security, Technology and Data to define and apply risk‑based AI deployment principles. Support governance and policy adoption to ensure safe, compliant AI use while balancing effective risk management with speed of execution.

Skillset and Experience Required

  • Strong understanding of AI platform ecosystems (e.g. copilots, LLMs, agentic platforms) and ability to translate vendor capabilities into business applications
  • Deep understanding of AI fundamentals, LLMs, AI market solutions and automation tools (incl. prompt engineering, workflow automation, AI assistants & applied GenAI)
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI tech stacks, role-based access models and configuration standards, ensuring safe and effective usage across the organization.
  • Experience in demand management and prioritization of AI use cases; balancing value, feasibility and scalability
  • Strong commercial mindset, with ability to assess and track value, cost (incl. AI/agent usage), and ROI of AI initiatives
  • Strong change management & behavioral transformation skills
  • Strong leadership and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders and mobilise global teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a co-ownership model with Technology, translating business needs into platform and capability requirements
  • Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in high-demand, fast-evolving environments
  • Strong capability in translating complex AI and LLM concepts into simple, actionable learning adapted to different audiences and expertise levels.
  • Expertise in learning design, capability building and adult education methodologies for large-scale programmes.
  • Excellent project planning and coordination abilities to run training waves, manage AI Leads, and orchestrate enablement routines.
  • Storytelling and communication skills to design awareness campaigns and drive engagement across the organization
  • High interpersonal and coaching skills to guide AI Leads, functional teams and advanced users.
  • Analytical skills to track adoption metrics, capability uplift and effectiveness of training programmes.
  • 8+ years of experience in Digital Transformation with proven exposure to AI tools in recent years.
  • Experience working with or alongside enterprise technology teams on platform adoption, SaaS capabilities or AI/automation tools
  • Experience defining or supporting prioritization frameworks for digital or AI use cases at scale
  • Exposure to AI platform vendors (e.g. Microsoft, Google, Anthropic) and understanding of how enterprise organizations adopt and scale these capabilities
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools, LLM-based applications, automation workflows or GenAI platforms, with the ability to translate technology into user-centric adoption.
  • Experience tracking adoption, usage and value metrics (including cost considerations) for digital or AI initiatives
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale enablement programmes or organizational capability-building initiatives across multiple functions.
  • Proven track record deploying new digital solutions or workplace technologies at enterprise scale (e.g., automation tools, collaborative platforms, AI assistants).
  • Experience driving behavioral and cultural change, supporting functional teams in adopting new digital capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience coordinating training delivery, content development, role-based learning pathways and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Tech, HR and business units to embed new digital capabilities into day-to-day operations.
  • Experience managing external training vendors, content partners or digital capability providers
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or related
  • Master’s degree, MBA or equivalent preferred
  • Certifications in change management, AI fundamentals, agile or learning design preferred

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drivesinnovation and makestravel a force for good. We're committed to creatinganinclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
about the role

At Amiqus, our north star is checks run: how many checks our clients run through our platform. As Senior Product Manager for our Staff Product team, that’s the number you’ll own. You’ll be the general manager of the team’s suite of checks, deciding what gets built and why, taking it to market with our commercial teams, and staying with it until clients are running it and loving it.


You’ll lead the team in partnership with its tech lead, spend time with clients every week, and use AI every day to move in days and weeks rather than quarters. It’s a senior role with a real voice in how Amiqus grows, well beyond your own roadmap.

key responsibilities

  • Own checks run for the Staff Product suite of checks, knowing your actuals, forecast and trajectory every week and acting quickly on any gap

  • Decide what the team works on, in what order and what gets traded off, writing a short PRFAQ before any work longer than a sprint begins

  • Co-create big bets with a small group of committed design partners, getting prototypes in front of them within days and launching with live users already on board

  • Own the route to market as well as the route to production, building go-to-market plans with Growth, Sales, Client Success and Operations before launch, and driving adoption long after it

  • Spend time with clients every week, running discovery yourself, joining strategic sales calls and representing Amiqus at client events and industry forums

  • Build your own relationships in key accounts, working alongside Client Success so no account depends on a single contact

  • Lead the team with your tech lead: you own the what and the why, they own the how, and you agree dates together

  • Set clear guardrails around compliance, security and client data, so engineers and AI can take care of small improvements without waiting on you

  • Use AI daily for synthesis, analysis, specs and prototypes, and find and fix the slowest stage in how your team gets from idea to adoption

  • Play your part as a senior leader, bringing progress, risks and asks to leadership forums and helping build the people, processes and systems we need to scale

about you

You’re at your best in a dynamic, high-growth setting, where you can bring structure and focus to several concurrent projects. Someone who’s previously worked in a start up or scale up environment would probably thrive most in this role. You think like an owner. You’d rather be measured on what clients use than on what you shipped, you’re comfortable making the call with the evidence available, and when you disagree you bring a better proposal, then get behind the decision.


In addition, we’re looking for:

  • Significant product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just shipping features

  • Strong commercial instincts and comfort working to a number, linking what you build to adoption and revenue

  • Confidence with clients at every level, from discovery interviews through to strategic sales conversations

  • Experience taking products to market hand in hand with marketing, sales and customer success teams

  • A hands-on habit of using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and curiosity about how they can change the way teams build

  • The ability to lead through influence and build buy-in across engineering, design and commercial teams, up to board level

  • Sound judgement on when to move fast and when to slow down, particularly around security, compliance and client data

  • Clear, honest communication, calling out risks and missed numbers early and plainly

It would also be advantageous if you have:

  • Experience in a regulated sector such as legal, financial services or property, or with compliance, identity verification, KYC or AML products

  • Experience with DIATF, working for a DVS

  • Experience with API or embedded integrations

  • Experience running design partner or co-creation programmes

  • Familiarity with working-backwards methods such as PRFAQs

  • Experience coaching or mentoring other product managers


This is a fast-growing, scale-up environment - not a large scale corporation. Things move quickly. Whilst we have structure and excellent people - you’ll need to be able to deliver and implement things directly so we’re looking for someone who’s energised by making change, having specific impact and scaling themselves as we grow on our 10x plan.

interview process

We think it’s important to have an open and transparent process. The process might vary slightly but here’s what to expect:


  • An initial conversation with a member of the People team

  • Interview with Product Lead and Commercial Lead

  • Structured Panel interview and/or presentation for shortlisted candidates with Engineering Lead and a few other senior members of the team

  • References and background checks followed after verbal role offer

privacy policy

We recognise that diverse teams outperform. Perspectives and people of all backgrounds are welcome at Amiqus.


We enable our people to do their best work and reward them based on performance. We acknowledge our moral and legal responsibilities to promote equal opportunities and pursue equality in all of our work.


If there’s anything we can do to make sure you have a positive interview experience, please let us know.


Lastly, as you might expect, we care about privacy and have a privacy policy which explains how we handle your information and data.

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

About the Role

ClickUp is looking for an FP&A Manager to serve as the financial business partner across three functions: R&D, G&A, and Corporate. You'll own the full cycle of forecasting, month-end close, and budget vs. actuals reporting for each, partnering directly with department leaders and the accounting team. This is a high-autonomy role on a lean Strategic Finance team where you'll have real ownership from day one.

 

What You'll Do

  • R&D: Own expense management, vendor and invoice approvals, headcount planning, non-headcount forecasting, cloud infrastructure cost tracking, and month-end variance analysis and leadership reporting.

  • G&A: Drive expense forecasting, headcount planning, vendor approvals, and month-end close activities including variance analysis and BvA reporting for G&A departments.

  • Corporate: Prepare board of directors, QFR, and investor-ready reporting decks. Manage billings actualization and forecasting, and deliver monthly finance readouts to executive leadership.

  • Partner with Accounting through the monthly close cycle, including soft close, hard close, and results review with budget owners.

  • Maintain rolling forecasts, provide variance commentary for material deviations, and lock forecasts on a monthly cadence.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with recruiting, procurement, and department leaders on headcount and spend decisions.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate forecasting workflows, variance commentary, and ad-hoc analysis, setting the bar for AI-augmented FP&A on the team.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of FP&A or strategic finance experience, ideally in a high-growth SaaS/tech environment.

  • Experience owning multiple cost centers or business lines simultaneously.

  • Fluency in SaaS financial metrics (ARR, NRR, gross margin, CAC, CLTV) and the ability to connect operating metrics to financial outcomes.

  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and budget-to-actual analysis skills.

  • Comfort with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan, or similar), ERP systems (NetSuite preferred), and procurement platforms (Coupa or equivalent).

  • Experience preparing materials for board, executive, and investor audiences, distilling complex data into clear, actionable narratives.

  • Ability to operate independently across multiple stakeholder groups with minimal direction.

  • Strong business partnering instincts: you make department heads sharper, not slower.

 

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in a high-growth, pre-IPO environment.

  • Genuine AI fluency: you actively use AI tools to accelerate modeling, analysis, and communication in your daily work.

  • Familiarity with AWS/cloud cost tracking and COGS reporting.

  • Experience with HRIS/ATS systems (Workday, Ashby, Greenhouse) for headcount management.

Full-Stack Developer – Next.js & Python

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build and maintain production web applications across a modern frontend, backend, database, and cloud stack.

This is a hands-on development role for someone who can own a slice of the product across both UI and API. You’ll work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, relational and graph databases, multi-service architecture, real-time functionality, and Azure infrastructure.

What You’ll Own

Frontend Development

  • Build production web applications using Next.js 16 with App Router, React 19, and strict TypeScript.
  • Work with server/client boundaries and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.
  • Build interfaces using Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui + Radix, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, and AG Grid Enterprise.
  • Work with Framer Motion and Socket.IO.
  • Write frontend tests using Vitest + Testing Library.
  • Build end-to-end tests using Playwright.

Backend Development

  • Build and maintain backend services using Python 3.13 and FastAPI.
  • Work with Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel, Alembic, Celery, Redis, and uv.
  • Work with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.
  • Work within a multi-service codebase using HTTP between services, Redis, and workers.

Database & Data

  • Work with relational modeling and migrations using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.
  • Work with Azure SQL (MSSQL) and PostgreSQL.
  • Work with Neo4j for family / heirship graphs.
  • Work with PostgreSQL + pgvector.
  • Work with MongoDB for logs.

Cloud & Operations

  • Work with Docker Compose.
  • Work with Prometheus / Grafana.
  • Work with pnpm workspaces + Turborepo.

Advanced Features & Integrations

  • Work with complex data UIs including AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, and rich text using Tiptap.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Optomechanical Design Engineer — Precision CNC Parts (Remote)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior optomechanical and mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in precision optics and optomechanics. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in precision optics or optomechanics.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

jobs.title: PPC Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist - UK
jobs.description:
Role: Customer Support Specialist

Reports to: BU Team Lead

Location: Remote-first working (UK based)

We are currently a remote-first organisation, but hybrid working may be an option in the future.

Salary: Up to £34,000 depending on experience, plus equity

Hours: Full-Time 37.5 hours per week

A note about recruitment at Vestd

We recognise how challenging the job market can be for candidates, and at Vestd we strive to provide a positive candidate experience. If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly request that your application and all communication go through official application channels. Apply via our website careers page, other job site or LinkedIn, as opposed to sending the team individual emails or LinkedIn direct messages. We want each candidate to be considered fairly, and for everyone who applies to receives a consistent experience.

Contacting Vestd employees via email, personal social media, or other informal routes is not appropriate. We also have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of harassment or abuse directed at our team. Candidates who do not respect these boundaries may be disqualified from the recruitment process and, in serious cases, barred from applying in future.

About Vestd

Vestd is a leading sharetech platform for equity management - shares schemes, fund raising, company secretarial and much more.

Our regulated platform makes light work of all of the most popular and tax-efficient share scheme types, empowering businesses to attract and retain their talent. Our powerful software also helps investors, and founders seeking investment.

Vestd was founded by Ifty Nasir, who lives and breathes our mission. Vestd’s big moonshot aim is to see one billion people worldwide invested in the companies they work hard to grow by 2030. We are all about inclusion and fairness for our customers and our team.

Vestd is also a B Corp-certified company, which means we’re committed to balancing profit with purpose. We care about our people, our customers, and the wider world – and we hold ourselves to the highest social and environmental standards.

If you’d like to learn more about Vestd, check out this short video from our founder, Ifty.

Requirements

The role

We are looking for individuals who are not only passionate about our mission but also comfortable and confident using cutting-edge technologies and AI tools, to streamline processes, drive innovation, and contribute to the growth of Vestd.

As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the go-to person for founders, finance leaders and their teams when they need help with Vestd. You'll resolve queries across share schemes, company secretarial tasks and the platform itself, turning technical and often unfamiliar equity processes into clear, simple guidance customers can act on with confidence.

This role sits at the intersection of excellent service and technical product knowledge. You'll handle questions through tickets, chat, email and calls, troubleshoot platform issues, and work closely with colleagues in Customer Success, Equity Consulting and Product to resolve more complex cases. What matters most is that you learn complex concepts quickly, get the detail right and explain things simply to people who aren't experts.

This isn't a sales role, but you'll play an important part in keeping customers happy and with Vestd. You'll spot where customers are at risk or could get more from the platform and pass this on to the right team, and you'll help shape the help content that lets customers find answers for themselves.

What success looks like in year one

By the end of your first year, you'll be a trusted first point of contact for our customers, resolving the full range of platform and equity queries independently, including the complex ones, and escalating cleanly when specialist input is needed. You'll be consistently meeting our ticket response and time-to-serve SLAs with strong customer satisfaction scores, and you'll have turned recurring questions into help content or process improvements that reduce our cost to serve. Specific targets will be agreed with your team lead during your probation period.

What you’ll own

  • Resolving customer queries across tickets, chat, email and calls, accurately and within our response and time-to-serve SLAs.
  • Investigating and troubleshooting platform issues, and escalating clearly to Product or Engineering when needed.
  • Explaining equity schemes, share processes and platform features in clear, simple language that non-experts can act on.
  • Writing and maintaining help centre articles, macros and FAQs so customers can find answers for themselves
  • Spotting churn risks, feedback themes and upgrade opportunities, and passing them to Customer Success, Product and Sales.

What we’re looking for

Essential elements of this role

We cannot provide an exhaustive list of duties; additional duties may arise, but these will be core elements of this role.

  • A proven ability to learn complex technical concepts quickly, for example through legal, financial, technical or academic work.
  • The ability to explain complex ideas simply and accurately to people who are not experts.
  • At least 2 years' experience in a customer support or helpdesk role, ideally within a B2B SaaS business.
  • Experience working to service levels (SLAs) and managing a busy queue of priorities, with the judgement to work through problems that don't have an obvious answer.
  • Curious, with a real interest in building expertise in equity, share schemes and startup finance.
  • Highly organised, able to prioritise and manage your own workload in a fast-moving environment.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • You must be comfortable with working in a remote-first environment.

Nice to have

These will help you stand out from the pack:

  • A background in law, paralegal work or legal tech.
  • Experience in fintech, or another technical or regulated environment.
  • Experience with support tools such as Intercom, Zendesk or HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Experience writing knowledge base or help centre content.
  • A strong academic record (a degree is helpful but not essential).
  • Experience working with B2B customers.
  • Exposure to founders or C-suite stakeholders.
  • Startup/scaleup experience.
  • Knowledge of shares and share schemes.
  • Experience working in a remote team.

Culture fit

What makes Vestd folk collaborative, adaptable, and eager to grow?

  • Thrives in a startup environment, ready to tackle diverse challenges with enthusiasm
  • Adaptable - open to taking on responsibilities beyond the defined role as needed
  • Passionate about contributing to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Embraces technology to improve processes and drive efficiency

While the above describes the core responsibilities, this role may from time to time involve tasks beyond this list — as needed to respond to evolving business needs.

Benefits

What you can expect

Our culture is our backbone (BreatheHR named us one of the ‘Top 3 Companies in the UK for Company Culture’), and we take team happiness seriously.

Vestd strives to be as principled as possible. We’re all about Goal 8 of the United Nations ‘Sustainable Development Goals. This goal is about ‘Decent work and economic growth,’ and we consider it both with our external activities and internal workings.

We’ll do everything we can to help you grow in your role. In return, you’ll want to learn all about our industry and do all you can to help us continue leading it.

Vestd is remote-first, so in return for your commitment, diligence, and productivity, you’ll have a lot of autonomy during your working day. Some roles demand office hours (to fit our customers’ schedules), but we are committed to offering flexibility where possible.

Happy employees make for happy customers, as demonstrated in our five-star reviews. Vestd’s excellence has also been recognised by The Europas, The Fintech Awards London, The Hustle Awards, TechRound, and BusinessCloud’s Fintech50. See more about our awards here.

This could be the perfect opportunity if you’re an autonomous, self-driven individual passionate about contributing to a meaningful mission and value being part of a supportive, close-knit team.

Why work at Vestd?

Vestd is a great place to work. Don’t just take our word for it - take a look at the award-winning suite of benefits that you can look forward to as one of our folk:

  • This job remote-first, although attendance is required twice yearly at our in-person get-togethers
  • A flexible environment to help you achieve the best work/life balance
  • Equity, of course! (After the qualifying period)
  • Monthly recognition scheme, where we celebrate our folk
  • Support with home working equipment*
  • A personal training and development budget to keep your career and professional growth on track
  • Private medical insurance (after the qualifying period)
  • Team retreats are held twice a year. They can include an overnight stay and focus on fun and team cohesion
  • Great team ethos, connect through regular team and company socials.
  • 25 days annual leave plus one extra day per year of service (up to five days)
  • Employer contribution pension scheme (after the qualifying period)

We’re looking for somebody with initiative who can focus on the business and their personal growth path. This is a great time to join our team, and it would be a superb role for the right person.

*At Vestd we provide our folk with the hardware and software required to support them in their role. As a remote-first business, we expect anyone applying for a job to have a suitable, quiet working space. You must have an appropriate desk/table and chair, with a reliable internet connection.

Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) at Vestd

At Vestd, we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and diverse team. Trust is one of our core values; with that comes a commitment to fairness and transparency. We want to be open about our EDI efforts.

We wish to recruit people who are passionate about working in a diverse environment and who will support us to ensure that all colleagues are supported and included while working with us.

Research shows that while men are likely to apply when they meet 60% of a job’s requirements, women and individuals from underrepresented groups often apply only when they meet every criterion.

We understand the value of transferable skills and the unique perspectives that diversity brings. That’s why we encourage applications from candidates with unique strengths and experiences.


Our application process

jobs.title: Corporate & Integration Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Athens

Remote role based in Athens, covering mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens). Independent contractor engagement at $3,500–$4,500 per month (USD), depending on experience. As a contractor, you’ll invoice us monthly and handle your own taxes and social security contributions.

ABOUT 3Y HEALTH

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. We're backed by over $200mm from Founders Fund, General Catalyst, SoftBank and 8VC.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We enter new markets by acquiring a foundational clinic for each specialty and region we go into, and we partner with independent clinics across the country. Every clinic adds entities, filings, contracts, staff records and deadlines that need to stay in order.

In this role, you'll own a set of our entities from start to finish. When we acquire a clinic, you'll carry out its integration plan: collect and file the records, prepare the filings, get staff ready for day one and follow up with everyone until each item is closed. Each deal comes with a detailed plan and timeline from the deal lead. Acquired clinics keep running largely as they do today until we bring them onto our platform, usually within a few months. Once a clinic is integrated, you'll keep its entity in good standing, alongside the existing entities you own.

You don't need experience in US healthcare. Every deal comes with a detailed checklist, and we'll teach you the US specifics. You need to learn fast, care about details and follow through. You'll work closely with our Corporate Development, Legal, Billing and HR teams in the US, and with a teammate in the same role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Acquisitions

  • Work through each deal's integration checklist from before signing through the first months after close, keep the tracker current, and flag anything at risk of slipping

  • Document how the clinic runs today, such as scheduling, intake, referrals and billing handoffs

  • Check that each acquired entity is in good standing, and that its legal name and tax ID match across IRS, state, bank and payer records

  • Support our team and advisors on payer change-of-ownership notices, Medicare enrollment updates and credentialing checks

  • Map every payer's electronic payment setup (EFT/ERA) and each clinic's bank accounts, so our billing team can keep cash flowing through close

  • Prepare staff for day one: verify the employee roster, gather employment records for legal review, run license and exclusion checks, collect onboarding paperwork securely, and help get payroll, benefits and staff FAQs ready

  • Inventory each clinic's vendors, software and logins, collect business associate agreements (BAAs) for legal review, and track which systems switch to ours at close, later or not at all

  • Follow through after close on staff communication, moving patients of departing providers to remaining clinicians, lease and facility license items, and the former owners' transition commitments

Entity management and corporate operations

  • Keep the entities you own in good standing, primarily by managing our vendors: prepare annual reports, state registrations, IRS updates and other filings, and track them to on-time filing with our legal team

  • Maintain entity records, including formation documents, officers, registered agents and ownership

  • Prepare and submit provider and facility enrollments with state Medicaid programs and other public payers, and track them to approval

  • Make sure incoming mail for your entities is logged, routed and acted on, especially anything with a deadline

  • Prepare contracts from templates, route them for signature, and keep our contract management system and renewal dates current

  • Note what worked and what didn't, so our checklists get better with each deal

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–5 years in healthcare operations, practice management, credentialing or provider enrollment, or acquisition integration

  • A track record of managing many details and deadlines to completion

  • Comfort working with contracts, licenses and government forms. You read carefully and catch errors.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills, and quick to learn new systems

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Most of your work is with US teams, agencies and vendors, and most decisions happen in writing.

  • Comfort handling confidential information

  • High agency and low ego. You don't need to be chased, and you'll do the tedious work as carefully as the interesting work.

  • Based in Athens and able to work mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in US healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry

  • Experience working with US companies or customers

  • Experience with corporate filings, contract administration or compliance work

  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to work faster

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A monthly fee of $3,500–$4,500 (USD), depending on experience

  • A long-term role at a venture-backed US company, working closely with leadership

  • Room to grow as we acquire more clinics and enter new specialties

ENGAGEMENT

This is a long-term independent contractor engagement with 3Y Health, not an employment contract. You'll need to be registered as a freelancer in Greece, or be willing to register before your start date. You'll be paid monthly in USD.

If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

Establish trusted metrics

Building a Team

  • Build and lead the team as it grows, staying hands-on during the greenfield phase.

Showing Impact

What You’ll Be Doing

Execute field and on-campus marketing events (30%)

Partner with Sales to support pipeline generation (25%)

  • Attend regular Sales meetings to stay informed about account activity, upcoming opportunities, and campaign requirements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate MQL handoffs, supporting lead follow-up and providing relevant campaign collateral and activation materials.

Execute digital campaigns and manage agency activity (20%)

Maintain campaign data and performance reporting (10%)

  • Ensure marketing activities are correctly tagged and tracked to support reliable reporting and lead management.
  • Build and distribute regular campaign performance reports to support the AMD's reporting requirements and commercial planning.
  • Use Excel and analytics tools to interpret campaign results, identify trends, and provide clear, actionable performance insights.

Coordinate marketing assets and production (10%)

  • Coordinate the production of marketing assets with agencies and internal teams, including event collateral, digital creative, campaign content, and Sales enablement materials.
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships to support the timely delivery of campaigns and events.
  • Ensure all marketing materials follow global brand guidelines and meet agreed quality standards.
  • Track project timelines, deliverables, and expenditure to ensure activities are completed accurately, on time, and within budget.

Support budget and project delivery (5%)

  • Support the execution of the assigned North America marketing budget, maintaining accurate spend tracking.
  • Coordinate multiple campaign and event workstreams across product portfolios, managing priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Identify creative opportunities to maximize the reach and impact of field marketing and event outreach.
  • Work collaboratively across teams, maintaining a customer-first approach and strong professional relationships.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • 3–5 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally within education, healthcare, publishing, or a related sector.
  • Hands-on experience executing multi-channel marketing campaigns from brief through delivery.
  • Experience delivering field marketing events, on-campus activations, tradeshows, and other in-person marketing activities.
  • Practical experience using Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform (MAP) for campaign build, execution, and reporting.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM for lead tracking, MQL management, and activity reporting is desirable.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized Connected TV advertising. Our business is growing rapidly and we're in the midst of transforming from a services agency to a product-led business with our new native platform, Convoy.

We are a small, remote-first team of high-performing professionals with diverse backgrounds located across many time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia. We prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation but come together as a team to solve hard problems.


The Role

Revive is building its first true inbound and outbound go-to-market motion, and we need one person to own the data, process, and analysis that show how the revenue business is performing and where it can grow. You’ll be Revive’s first RevOps hire, reporting to the CRO as their right-hand data partner.

Today, nobody can see pipeline health, team performance against goals, retention by team, or margin in one place. You’ll fix that.

You’ll work side by side with our Head of Marketing. Marketing owns brand, positioning, ABM, content, lead scoring logic, and outbound outreach. You’ll own the data and reporting that make that work measurable, and the analysis that turns it into decisions.

The job has four parts: keep HubSpot data clean and trusted, track performance against goals, analyze the client base for growth, and own forecasting, margin, and ad hoc analysis.

What you'll own

1. HubSpot systems and hygiene (~30%)

  • Own HubSpot architecture: properties, pipelines, deal stages, workflows, permissions, and integrations
  • Build the plumbing marketing needs to run its lane: lead and lifecycle stages, scoring fields and workflows (marketing defines the model, you build and maintain it), lead routing, attribution properties, and the sync from Clay and sequencing tools into HubSpot
  • Define and enforce funnel definitions with the CRO and Head of Marketing: lead, MQL, meeting, opportunity, and closed-won
  • Run a weekly hygiene review across HubSpot: stale deals, missing amounts or close dates, deals in the wrong stage, unassigned records, and budget changes not reflected in booked revenue
  • Send automated reminders to owners when records fall out of compliance, and escalate repeat gaps to managers
  • Run recurring training sessions with the Account Strategy and sales teams so everyone knows how to log activity, update deals, and use reports
  • Connect HubSpot to Convoy and Redshift so bookings and spend tie back to pipeline
  • Document processes and keep a single source of truth for how we use our tools

2. Performance and goal tracking (~25%)

  • Build and maintain scorecards for every role against their quarterly goals: Account Leads, Account Managers, sales, and channel partner teams
  • Automate goal tracking that is manual today: meetings (new vs. existing), proposals, pipeline created, bookings, upsell, and AMC adoption
  • Send the CRO a weekly recap of how each person and pod is tracking, with clear flags on who is ahead, who is behind, and why
  • Run bonus and incentive tracking so grading is consistent, auditable, and easy to explain
  • Give managers the data to coach, improve the team, and make exits with evidence

3. Client base and growth analysis (~25%)

  • Measure retention and churn by account, owner, pod, channel partner, and vertical
  • Flag at-risk accounts early using spend trends, pacing, and engagement signals
  • Find upsell and cross-sell opportunities: accounts underpenetrated on products like Prime Video, STV, Netflix, AMC, and Signal, and brands we could add within agencies we already serve
  • Track AMC adoption across the team and accounts, and show where the gaps are
  • Turn findings into clear talking points for the CRO on where the business can grow, for leadership updates, QBRs, and partner conversations

4. Forecasting, margin, and special projects (~20%)

  • Own the revenue forecast: build forward projections by pod, channel, and product, and track forecast accuracy over time
  • Build leading indicators the CRO can pull quickly: new deal count, opportunity value over trailing 30 and 60 days, and spend vs. booked variance
  • Track gross and net margin by pod, partner, account, and product, including partner rev share and platform fees
  • Support platform partnerships with data: Amazon, Netflix, and other partner spend forecasts, joint business plan inputs, and commitment tracking
  • Take on ad hoc analysis when a question comes up, get into the data, and come back with a clear answer and a recommendation

Requirements

  • Four or more years in RevOps, sales ops, or revenue analytics at a B2B company, ideally as the first or only ops hire
  • Deep HubSpot admin experience: you've rebuilt a messy instance, not just inherited a clean one
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills; comfortable pulling from a data warehouse such as Redshift and building in a BI tool
  • Experience building forecasts and tracking forecast accuracy
  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
  • You turn messy data into a clear weekly story a CRO can act on
  • Builder mindset: you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

Nice to have

  • Ad tech, programmatic, or agency experience, especially Amazon DSP or AMC
  • Experience with margin and unit economics analysis in a rev share or fee-based business
  • Experience with AI tools to automate reporting and analysis
  • Python or scripting experience
  • Experience setting up comp, quota, or bonus tracking

Benefits

  • Comprehensive healthcare including medical, vision & dental benefits covered at 100% for employees and 50% for dependents
  • We're fully remote and offer a remote working stipend
  • Flexible PTO - take what you need, when you need
  • Coffee or Tea Subscription
  • Monthly 3 day weekend

Revive Media provides the wage it reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for all remote roles and as otherwise required by applicable law. The expected base pay for this role is $130k-$150k, with a quarterly bonus + equity. Actual compensation may vary within the listed range based on a wide array of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience, and specific geographic location.

Revive Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We assess all qualified candidates on the basis of skill, experience and talent.

Job Title: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for pipeline monitoring, deployments, and data refresh cycles)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and reliable data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across the business.

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep experience with modern data stacks, and a passion for building clean, reliable, and high-performance data systems. The Data Engineer will ensure data flows seamlessly from source systems into warehouses, dashboards, and downstream applications while maintaining high standards for quality, governance, and scalability.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver trustworthy and actionable data.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Data Integration

  • Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, or Scala
    • Orchestrate workflows using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools
    • Ingest structured and unstructured data from APIs, SaaS platforms, databases, files, and streaming systems
    • Develop scalable connectors and automated ingestion workflows

Data Warehousing & Modeling

  • Manage and optimize cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift
    • Design scalable schemas using star and snowflake modeling techniques
    • Implement partitioning, clustering, indexing, and performance optimization strategies
    • Build clean, analytics-ready datasets for business intelligence and reporting use cases

Data Quality, Governance & Reliability

  • Implement validation checks, anomaly detection, logging, and monitoring to ensure data integrity
    • Enforce naming conventions, lineage tracking, and documentation standards using tools such as dbt or Great Expectations
    • Maintain audit-ready data processes and ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or industry-specific requirements
    • Monitor pipeline health and proactively resolve failures or inconsistencies

Streaming & Real-Time Data Processing

  • Build and manage real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or similar platforms
    • Support low-latency ingestion and event-driven architectures for time-sensitive applications
    • Monitor streaming infrastructure and optimize throughput and reliability

Collaboration & Analytics Enablement

  • Partner closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable datasets
    • Support dashboard and reporting initiatives across Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
    • Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and models
    • Maintain clear technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, and workflows

Infrastructure, DevOps & Automation

  • Containerize data services using Docker and manage deployments through Kubernetes when applicable
    • Automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
    • Manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • Continuously optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud costs

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Passionate about building clean, reliable, and scalable data systems
    • Strong debugging and problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail
    • Balance of software engineering discipline and analytical thinking
    • Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Proactive communicator who takes ownership of data quality and reliability

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Back-End Engineering, or Data Infrastructure roles

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

  • Experience with at least one modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery)
    • Hands-on experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect
    • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and data transformation workflows
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation management
    • Streaming and event-driven data pipeline experience (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
    • Experience with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, GCP Dataflow, or Azure Data Factory
    • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or CI/CD workflows
    • Background in regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or enterprise SaaS
    • Experience optimizing warehouse costs and query performance at scale

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Data Engineer’s day revolves around maintaining reliable pipelines, improving data quality, and enabling teams with scalable access to trustworthy data. You will:

  • Monitor pipeline health and troubleshoot failed jobs in Airflow or related orchestration systems
    • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for APIs, SaaS platforms, and operational databases
    • Optimize SQL queries and warehouse performance to improve efficiency and reduce cloud costs
    • Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to provide curated datasets for reporting and modeling
    • Implement validation checks and monitoring to prevent downstream data quality issues
    • Document data models, transformations, and workflows to ensure scalability and maintainability

In essence: you ensure the organization has accurate, timely, and reliable data powering operational, analytical, and strategic decisions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• Pipeline uptime ≥ 99%

  • Data freshness maintained within agreed SLAs
    • Zero critical data quality issues reaching downstream reporting systems
    • Improved warehouse query performance and cost optimization
    • Timely delivery of scalable and reliable datasets
    • Positive feedback from analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders

  • Technical Assessment (e.g., build a small ETL pipeline or optimize a SQL query)

jobs.title: Senior Editor - Journal of Ecology
jobs.description:
Are you an active researcher with broad interests in plant ecology?

Salary: c. £7,900 per annum, which equates to approximately €9,150 or US$10,800
Contract: 3-year contract
Location: at the holder’s host university or organisation, based anywhere in the world
Closing date: Friday 15 January 2027
Interview date: January or February 2027 TBC, via Microsoft Teams

About the Journal

Journal of Ecology is a renowned British Ecological Society journal that publishes original research papers on all aspects of the ecology of plants (including algae), in both aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems.

Journal of Ecology publishes high-quality, influential papers where plant ecology is central. We welcome studies of the role of plants in aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, and the interactions of plants with animals, fungi or bacteria. Journal of Ecology was established over 100 years ago as the foundation publication of British Ecological Society and has become the Society’s flagship outlet for research focused on plant ecology.

The journal has a wide international audience, an active social media presence with over 33,000 followers on Twitter and a dedicated journal blog, and excellent publication metrics including a current Impact Factor of 5.6, and a CiteScore of 11.4.

The Journal’s editorial team consists of five Editors who are supported by dedicated editorial office personnel and an international board of around 100 Associate Editors. The Senior Editors work together to determine journal strategy and to increase the reputation and quality of the Journal, in addition to making decisions on around 1300 manuscripts submitted each year. Further details about the Journal and its current editorial team can be found here.

Requirements

About you

We are seeking an Editor to strengthen and complement the editorial team and to continue raising the Journal’s profile worldwide.

To complement our Editor team, we are looking for an active researcher broad interests in plant ecology. Expertise in remote sensing, trophic networks, aquatic ecology or plant physiology is particularly welcomed but not required.

Applications are welcome from leading scientists covering any areas of the Journal’s scope who could contribute to the Journal’s development in topical and developing fields.

The ideal candidate will be a clear communicator who works well as part of a team and a good decision-maker who acts with integrity in both their editorial and own scientific work. They will be a creative thinker, with a solid understanding of their own field of plant ecology, as well as an overview of the wider discipline; experience of reviewing and editing processes; commitment to maintaining the high editorial standards of the Journal; and an interest in ongoing developments within academic publishing.

About the role

We are seeking an ecologist who is highly motivated in publishing excellent plant ecology to join the team of Editors of Journal of Ecology.

Working with other members of the Journal team to promote the aims of the Journal, commission and evaluate submissions, and plan and implement strategies that will enhance its profile, expand its reach, and better serve its community of authors and readers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assess submitted manuscripts for suitability, selecting handling Associate Editors and reviewers, and making decisions based on their comments and your own judgement
  • Actively promote the Journal and the BES to your networks and when attending conferences
  • Solicit contributions in all areas relevant to the Journal
  • Identify key subject areas on which the Journal should focus
  • Gather opinions from fellow academic ecologists: use this information to suggest changes in procedure, to develop new initiatives and/or to feed into general discussions about the strategic direction of the Journal
  • Identify and recruit new Associate Editors, including through the promotion of open recruitment calls, with a focus on ensuring diverse representation and participation amongst editorial board members
  • Assist the editorial office team to identify papers for further promotion via blogs, video, podcasting and the media
  • Contribute to the Journal’s development and join in discussions with those involved with other BES journals to help identify opportunities for cross-journal initiatives
  • Act as Associate Editor for a limited number of manuscripts
  • Actively engage with social media tools in order to help promote the Journal (desirable)

Selection criteria:

  • Evidence of an active and relevant publication record
  • Knowledge and understanding of the subject area, complementary to that of the existing Editors
  • Experience of reviewing (essential) and of other editorial work (highly desirable)
  • Ability to work as part of a team of Editors, thinking both strategically and creatively
  • Ability to work independently and to prioritise from a range of active projects
  • Ability to form, communicate with, and operate in, scientific networks and engage with other relevant audiences, including through use of social media
  • Ability to consider multiple information sources or viewpoints, and act decisively
  • Commitment to the post and to the mission of the BES, and a desire to explore new opportunities to develop and enhance journal publishing

The Journal recognises the benefits that a diverse editorial board brings. We strongly encourage leading ecologists from underrepresented demographic groups and geographic regions to apply.

This post is a part-time three-year contract (current honorarium c. £7,900 per annum, which equates to approximately €9,150 or US$10,800) and located at the holder’s host university or organisation, based anywhere in the world. Some additional financial support is available to facilitate attendance at meetings with other BES Editors and to act as an ambassador for the Journal at relevant conferences.
