Our client is seeking a Financial Analyst / Data Analyst to build financial models, analyze operational and financial performance, and deliver data-driven insights that support strategic decision-making.

This role combines financial analysis with modern data analytics, requiring strong quantitative skills, business acumen, and proficiency with reporting and BI tools. The Financial Analyst / Data Analyst serves as the bridge between raw data and executive strategy — ensuring reporting is accurate, actionable, and aligned with business goals.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of transforming complex datasets into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis

  • Build and maintain 3-statement financial models including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections
    • Create scenario, sensitivity, break-even, ROI, IRR, and valuation analyses to evaluate risks and opportunities
    • Support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning initiatives
    • Analyze financial performance and identify trends impacting profitability, growth, and operational efficiency

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Query SQL databases and work with large structured datasets
    • Clean, transform, and validate data using Excel, Python, R, or related tools
    • Conduct variance analysis comparing actual performance against budgets and forecasts
    • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports for finance, operations, and leadership teams

Dashboard Development & Business Intelligence

  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI tools
    • Ensure reporting consistency, data integrity, and standardized metric definitions across departments
    • Create executive-ready visualizations and reporting packages for leadership and board presentations
    • Improve visibility into operational and financial performance through automated reporting systems

Forecasting, Planning & Business Support

  • Partner with FP&A, finance, sales, and operations teams to refine forecasts and budgets
    • Incorporate real-time business trends into rolling forecasts and scenario planning
    • Support strategic initiatives through financial and operational analysis
    • Translate business needs into measurable KPIs and analytical frameworks

Data Governance & Accuracy

  • Validate and reconcile data sources to ensure accuracy and reliability
    • Document methodologies, assumptions, and reporting processes for transparency and repeatability
    • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and data quality
    • Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and analysis workflows

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, and strategy teams
    • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Support decision-making with concise, actionable insights backed by data and financial analysis

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong analytical thinker capable of turning complex data into simple, actionable insights
    • Highly detail-oriented with strong standards for accuracy and consistency
    • Excellent communicator comfortable presenting to executives and stakeholders
    • Curious and proactive in identifying trends, opportunities, and operational risks
    • Strong balance of technical analysis and business understanding

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, business intelligence, or data analytics
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH, lookup formulas, and modeling
    • Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing datasets
    • Experience preparing variance analyses, forecasting models, and management reports
    • Ability to work with large datasets and synthesize findings clearly

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and data transformation
    • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
    • Industry experience in SaaS, finance, healthcare, or professional services
    • Experience extracting data from ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle
    • Knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and operational KPI frameworks
    • Exposure to automation or advanced reporting workflows

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Financial Analyst / Data Analyst’s day revolves around transforming financial and operational data into meaningful business insights. You will:

  • Pull, clean, and validate data from SQL databases, ERP systems, or reporting platforms
    • Update financial models and run scenario analyses based on the latest business performance
    • Prepare variance analyses explaining deviations from forecast or budget
    • Build and maintain dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into KPIs
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret data and support strategic decisions
    • Document assumptions, methodologies, and reporting logic to ensure consistency and transparency

In essence: you ensure leadership always has accurate, timely, and actionable insights to guide business decisions and long-term strategy.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Forecast and model accuracy within agreed variance thresholds
    • Timely delivery of monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting
    • Reliability and usability of dashboards and reporting tools
    • Improved data quality and reporting consistency
    • Actionable insights that support strategic and operational decisions
    • Positive stakeholder feedback on reporting clarity and analytical support

jobs.title: PPC Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in DACH. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara’s products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 2+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, Fleet or general operations background a huge plus
  • Previous experience working in a Fleet Sales environment
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.)
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Channel Account Manager - ShareGate
jobs.description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap, built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

ShareGate is a trusted favourite with partners who run Microsoft 365 migrations, and we're now taking those relationships from product-centric to strategic. As Channel Account Manager, you'll own a defined book of Premier and Elite partners across North America and be the strategic owner of their growth with ShareGate. This is a sales-first role: we're looking for someone with a hunter mindset who goes after revenue alongside partners, not someone who simply maintains accounts.

Your impact:

  • Drive partner-led revenue growth by owning your number, keeping pipeline coverage strong, and forecasting accurately, so ShareGate hits (and beats) its channel targets quarter after quarter.
  • Own your book of Premier and Elite partners by building a growth plan for each one (goals, joint actions, success metrics), so top performers scale, high-potential partners take off, and underperforming partners become growth accounts.
  • Evolve partner relationships from product-centric to strategic by building multi-level connections (sales, technical, leadership) and becoming your partners' ShareGate Sherpa, so ShareGate is the vendor they choose to grow their business with.
  • Equip partners to sell more and close faster by running sales training and technical sessions with the enablement team, bringing in the right internal resources (technical, RevOps, direct sales) at the right time, and building demand with channel marketing, so more partners close ShareGate deals on their own and no opportunity stalls for lack of support.
  • Open new revenue streams with your partners by uncovering larger, more complex migration opportunities, expanding mailbox migration (including displacing competitive tools) and Protect adoption, and driving uptake of new partner programs as they launch.
  • Use AI daily for account research, partner planning, forecasting, and communications, so your time goes to the conversations that move deals forward, not to prep work.

Your team

The ShareGate Channel team is growing fast and works the way we like to: quickly, collaboratively, and with plenty of trust. You'll report to the Channel Sales Manager and work daily with the Director, fellow Channel Account Managers, Distribution Channel Managers, and Partner Development Managers, with channel marketing, RevOps, technical enablement, support, and direct sales close by whenever you need them. Over the next 6 to 12 months, the team's ambition is to shift the channel from product-centric to strategic: deepening relationships with Premier and Elite partners, driving adoption of new partner programs as they launch, and turning high-potential partners into true growth accounts. Within six months, you'll own your book and cadences, have built a growth plan for your partners, and be testing new ideas to set up what comes next.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of channel sales experience in North America, ideally including the US, with a documented track record of meeting and exceeding quota (up to 30% travel between Canada and the US);
  • Experience managing Premier- or Elite-level partners, including building and executing partner business plans;
  • A sales-first, hunter mindset: an independent, entrepreneurial owner who creates their own pipeline, shows sound judgment and initiative, and can hit the ground running;
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ease to talk to both sales teams and executives at partner organizations;
  • A solid understanding of the IT channel ecosystem (distributors, resellers, and services partners);
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) daily for account research, planning, forecasting, and communications: not an experiment, a habit;
  • Bonus: Microsoft ecosystem experience and existing relationships with M365 partners.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $120,000 - $140,000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
    • OTE: $185,000 - $215,000 CAD
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gathering twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Nuestra misión se guía por un compromiso con la conservación ambiental y el empoderamiento de las comunidades indígenas a través de alianzas y prácticas sostenibles.

Descripción del puesto:

Para los pueblos A’i Cofán, Siona, Siekopai y Waorani, defender el territorio también significa poder vivir bien en él. Cuando las familias no encuentran en su territorio los medios para sostener su vida, crece la presión del extractivismo, la dependencia de economías externas y la migración de los jóvenes, y con ellas se debilitan la cultura, la vida organizativa y la selva.

Para responder a este desafío, Amazon Frontlines está construyendo el área de Economías Propias, un área emergente que busca trabajar junto con los pueblos indígenas para que la selva siga en pie y la cultura viva y que esto sea la base de una vida digna para las familias y comunidades. El área se organiza en tres ejes: Economías para la reproducción biocultural, Economías para la autonomía familiar y comunitaria y Economías para la sostenibilidad política y territorial. Desde estos ejes se impulsan la soberanía alimentaria, iniciativas productivas y comerciales gestionadas por las propias comunidades y/o asociaciones, con un rol protagónico de las mujeres y jóvenes, y recursos propios que fortalezcan la autonomía de las nacionalidades y sus organizaciones.

El/la Líder de Economías Propias será responsable del direccionamiento estratégico, la planificación y gestión integral del área, en coherencia con las prioridades de Amazon Frontlines y la Alianza Ceibo, y las visiones, necesidades y potencialidades de las nacionalidades y sus territorios.

Trabajará transversalmente con las coordinaciones regionales, las áreas programáticas y de soporte de Amazon Frontlines y las instancias directivas y técnicas de la Alianza Ceibo. Asimismo, impulsará alianzas estratégicas que fortalezcan las iniciativas económicas territoriales.

Se requiere una persona con visión estratégica y sensibilidad intercultural, capaz de traducir estrategias en planes, presupuestos y resultados concretos, respetando las estructuras de gobierno propio, los tiempos y las decisiones de los pueblos indígenas.

Responsabilidades específicas

Iniciativas económicas en territorio

  • Sistematizar las iniciativas económicas acompañadas por Amazon Frontlines y la Alianza Ceibo, identificando logros, desafíos y aprendizajes.
  • Fortalecer la soberanía alimentaria mediante sistemas productivos tradicionales, diversidad de semillas y conocimientos asociados.
  • Promover iniciativas basadas en conocimientos tradicionales y el uso sostenible de productos del bosque, fortaleciendo la transmisión intergeneracional de saberes.
  • Acompañar iniciativas productivas y comerciales, desde la producción y el valor agregado hasta el acceso a mercados justos.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades organizativas, administrativas y financieras para la gestión autónoma de iniciativas y la reinversión de recursos propios, incluyendo fondos comunitarios.
  • Impulsar iniciativas que generen recursos propios para las organizaciones indígenas y la Alianza Ceibo, fortaleciendo su autonomía, gobernanza y defensa territorial.
  • Promover las economías propias como alternativa al extractivismo, evitando impactos territoriales y conflictos internos, asegurando una distribución justa de beneficios y respetando las decisiones colectivas.
  • Impulsar tecnologías apropiadas para el acceso a agua segura, energía y conectividad, en articulación con la línea de agua y solar.

Dirección estratégica y planificación

  • Orientar el desarrollo del área, asegurando la coherencia de sus intervenciones, alianzas y decisiones con las prioridades institucionales y territoriales.
  • Liderar los planes y presupuestos anuales, concertando prioridades, metas y acciones con las coordinaciones Norte, Centro-Sur y Perú y la Alianza Ceibo.
  • Concertar los planes con el Directorio de la Alianza Ceibo y sustentar los requerimientos presupuestarios ante la Dirección de Programas y las instancias correspondientes de Amazon Frontlines.

Seguimiento, evaluación y gestión del conocimiento

  • Traducir las orientaciones estratégicas en metas e indicadores, asegurando su implementación, seguimiento y evaluación.
  • Coordinar con ambas organizaciones la programación, monitoreo y evaluación de las acciones de campo.
  • Comunicar avances, resultados, desafíos y aprendizajes a las instancias directivas, facilitando la toma de decisiones y la transparencia.

Articulación y transversalización

  • Articular con la Dirección de Programas, la Dirección Ejecutiva y el Directorio de la Alianza Ceibo las economías propias con las demás líneas de trabajo: educación propia, agua y solar, defensa territorial y comunicación.
  • Promover la incorporación transversal del enfoque de economías propias, facilitando acuerdos y acciones conjuntas entre las áreas de ambas organizaciones.
  • Integrar criterios de equidad de género y participación intergeneracional en la planificación, presupuestación, implementación y evaluación de iniciativas.

Alianzas y movilización de recursos

  • Gestionar alianzas con universidades, ONG, empresas, mercados, gobiernos locales y otros actores estratégicos.
  • Liderar el diseño técnico de propuestas basadas en el potencial biocultural y las prioridades territoriales.
  • Coordinar con Recaudación de Fondos la identificación de oportunidades de financiamiento, formulación de propuestas y relaciones con donantes, aportando insumos técnicos, programáticos y presupuestarios para propuestas y reportes.

Gestión de riesgos y fortalecimiento institucional

  • Anticipar riesgos institucionales, financieros, operativos y territoriales, promoviendo medidas de mitigación y ajustes estratégicos.
  • Impulsar la incorporación del enfoque de economías propias en la identidad, estructura, agenda e instrumentos de gestión de ambas organizaciones.

Perfil requerido

Formación académica y experiencia profesional

  • Título de tercer nivel en Ciencias Sociales, Económicas o Ambientales.
  • Deseable formación de cuarto nivel en Administración de Empresas, Gestión de Proyectos, Cooperación Internacional, Desarrollo Territorial o afines.
  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en dirección, coordinación o gestión de programas y proyectos de desarrollo económico, fortalecimiento organizativo o iniciativas productivas sostenibles.
  • Experiencia con pueblos y nacionalidades indígenas y organizaciones de base, de segundo y/o tercer grado, preferentemente en la Amazonía.
  • Experiencia en planificación estratégica y operativa, gestión presupuestaria, gestión de equipos y evaluación de resultados.
  • Experiencia en gestión de alianzas con universidades, ONG, empresas, mercados, gobiernos locales y organismos de cooperación.
  • Experiencia en identificación de oportunidades económicas, cadenas de valor, desarrollo de mercados e iniciativas productivas y comerciales.
  • Experiencia en formulación de propuestas y movilización de recursos para programas e iniciativas territoriales.

Competencias y habilidades

  • Visión estratégica para orientar procesos institucionales, establecer prioridades y articular líneas programáticas.
  • Capacidad para facilitar el diálogo, construir acuerdos y armonizar prioridades entre diferentes actores.
  • Capacidad para traducir estrategias en planes, presupuestos, metas e indicadores SMART.
  • Capacidad para identificar oportunidades económicas basadas en el patrimonio biocultural, los conocimientos tradicionales y las visiones de vida de las nacionalidades.
  • Habilidad para identificar oportunidades de financiamiento y construir propuestas técnicas y estratégicas.
  • Capacidad para promover el trabajo colaborativo, la construcción colectiva y acompañar equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Capacidad para integrar la equidad de género y la participación intergeneracional en la gestión de iniciativas.
  • Idiomas: español nativo o equivalente. Inglés deseable.

Competencias personales

  • Sensibilidad intercultural y respeto por las estructuras de gobierno propio, los tiempos y las decisiones de los pueblos indígenas.
  • Escucha activa, diálogo, construcción de consensos e interlocución política e institucional.
  • Pensamiento crítico, estratégico y adaptación a contextos complejos.
  • Orientación a la colaboración y al aprendizaje institucional.
  • Iniciativa, autonomía y capacidad para resolver problemas.
  • Integridad, transparencia y compromiso con los derechos colectivos y la autodeterminación indígena.

Lugar de trabajo:

La posición estará basada en Ecuador, con disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes a los territorios de las nacionalidades en la Amazonía ecuatoriana y viajes ocasionales a Perú, según las necesidades del área.

Amazon Frontlines es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de raza, nacionalidad, etnia, religión, creencias políticas, edad, género, orientación sexual o clase social. En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, alentamos especialmente a postular a personas de pueblos indígenas y comunidades afrodescendientes.

Gorin Systems is an AI-first software agency based in Jacksonville, FL. We build web and mobile applications for mission-driven organizations — Jewish nonprofits, publishers, e-commerce companies, and SaaS startups. We currently manage 14+ active client projects across Linear, including e-commerce platforms processing hundreds of thousands of SKUs, AI-powered zoning analysis tools, content management systems with multilingual pipelines, mobile apps (React Native), SaaS dashboards, and internal automation tooling. Our stack is modern, our pace is fast, and every developer is expected to own their work end-to-end.

The Role

We're hiring a Full-Stack Developer to join our distributed team and take ownership of features and bug fixes across multiple client projects. You'll work primarily in React and Node.js, with exposure to Next.js, React Native, and various backend services depending on project needs. You'll be assigned to one or two client teams in Linear, collaborate with a Technical Project Manager (TPM) and Client Project Manager (CPM), and ship code daily using AI-assisted workflows.

This is a hands-on building role. You'll receive well-scoped Linear issues with plain-English requirements and technical specs, and you're expected to deliver working, tested features — not just PRs that "look right." You'll use AI tools as a core part of your workflow, but you need the engineering fundamentals to review, debug, and correct AI-generated output.

  • Debug production issues: Triage and fix bugs reported by CPMs or clients. Investigate logs, reproduce issues, and deploy hotfixes when needed.
  • Communicate progress: Update Linear issue status daily. Flag blockers early. Write clear commit messages and PR descriptions. Attend weekly team syncs.

  • Project Management: Linear (issues, projects, cycles), Hubstaff (time tracking), Slack, Loom

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional full-stack development experience
  • Strong proficiency in React (hooks, context, component architecture) and Node.js
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR, API routes, App Router preferred)
  • Comfortable with TypeScript in production codebases
  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) — can write and optimize queries
  • Experience with Git workflows (feature branches, PRs, rebasing)
  • Ability to read and debug code you didn't write — including AI-generated code
  • Strong English communication skills (written — daily Linear updates, PR descriptions, Slack)
  • Available during core overlap hours: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST (flexible outside core hours)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with React Native / Expo for mobile development
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in day-to-day development
  • Experience with Supabase, Firebase, or similar BaaS platforms
  • E-commerce platform experience (Stripe, marketplace APIs, MedusaJS)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
  • Previous agency or consulting experience (comfortable context-switching between projects)
  • Familiarity with Linear or similar issue-tracking workflows
  • Basic Hebrew reading comprehension (a plus — several projects involve Hebrew content)

Compensation & Structure

  • Independent contractor engagement
  • Starting part-time (~20–30 hrs/week), with path to full-time based on performance and project demand
  • Fully remote — must be available during 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST core hours

Why Gorin Systems?

  • AI-first development: You won't be writing boilerplate. You'll be orchestrating AI agents to ship faster than teams twice your size.

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

The ideal candidate had deep experience in materials management, production scheduling, inventory optimization and supplier management. The Materials Leader will work cross functionally, with Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, Technical Program managers, Datacenter Operations and Finance teams to ensure critical infrastructure components are met for current and planned growth needs. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require experience in complex supply chains and global suppliers. The ideal candidate should be experienced in the hyperscale, cloud, AI infrastructure or data center environment. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

  • Strategic Materials Planning

  • Develop and execute the materials management strategy to support rapid growth of AI and cloud infrastructure deployments.

  • Align material supply plans with capacity expansion, customer demand, and data center build schedules.

  • Establish inventory policies, stocking strategies, and replenishment models to ensure uninterrupted operations.

  • Inventory Management & Optimization

  • Own inventory planning, control, and optimization across warehouses, integration centers, and data centers.

  • Monitor inventory health, turns, days of supply, and excess & obsolete inventory.

  • Implement processes to improve inventory accuracy and maintain audit-ready controls.

  • Supply Assurance & Risk Management

  • Ensure continuous availability of critical infrastructure components, including servers, GPUs, networking equipment, drives, cables, optics, and other spare parts.

  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risks through buffer strategies, alternate sourcing, and allocation management.

  • Lead material allocation decisions during constrained supply situations.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Procurement, Engineering, Capacity Planning, Deployment, Operations, and Finance teams to align supply with business requirements.

  • Support new technology introductions and infrastructure expansion programs.

  • Drive material readiness for all deployment and operational milestones.

  • Warehouse & Fulfillment Operations

  • Oversee receiving, storage, kitting, staging, and material fulfillment processes.

  • Optimize inventory positioning across 3PL warehouses and data center locations.

  • Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Business, or related field.

  • 10+ years of progressive supply chain or materials management experience.

  • 5+ years leading teams in high-growth technology, cloud, electronics, networking, server, or data center environments.

  • Experience managing inventory and materials for complex hardware products.

  • Deep understanding of MRP, ERP (NetSuite), inventory optimization, demand planning, and fulfillment operations.

  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated use of data to drive decisions.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with engineering, procurement, logistics, operations, and finance teams.

$150,000 - $175,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

jobs.description:

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results.   • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets

  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal

  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

jobs.title: Strategic Solutions Engineer II
jobs.description:
Turn complex parcel data into practical solutions that improve cost, service, and customer outcomes.

At Green Mountain Technology, we help large, complex shippers reduce costs, enhance delivery experiences, and build long-term competitive advantages through technology, analytics, and logistics expertise.

We are seeking a Strategic Solutions Engineer II to transform complex customer requirements and parcel data into reporting, analytics, and solutions that create measurable value. You will work directly with customers to understand their operations and the ever-changing parcel ecosystem, model opportunities, solve problems, and guide them toward sustainable best practices.

This role combines the responsibilities of a business analyst, logistics engineer, project coordinator, and trusted customer advisor. The ideal candidate has strong SQL, business intelligence, and analytical capabilities, along with the confidence to lead customer conversations and translate technical findings into clear recommendations. This includes the ability to apply system-level, network-wide thinking while balancing competing parcel contract requirements.

This is an individual contributor role that requires a self-motivated, outcome-oriented approach with the ability to independently manage complex assignments, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality solutions with limited oversight.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with customers to understand their operational needs, business objectives, and technical requirements, and translate them into practical Green Mountain Technology solutions.
  • Lead customer requirements meetings, evaluate potential approaches, and recommend solutions that support the customer’s broader parcel network.
  • Guide customers from their initially requested solution toward scalable, sustainable best practices when a different approach will produce a better outcome.
  • Develop solutions with a mindset of applying system-level, network-wide thinking while balancing competing parcel contract requirements.
  • Develop parcel RFP models from baseline analysis through final contract proposal.
  • Model complex carrier optimization opportunities and advanced day-definite networks involving multiple carriers, services, and operational constraints.
  • Analyze parcel networks and identify opportunities to reduce cost, improve service, and strengthen network performance.
  • Build, enhance, and maintain business intelligence reports and dashboards that give customers accurate, relevant, and actionable information.
  • Manage customer reporting portfolios, including recommending when reports should be added, revised, consolidated, or retired.
  • Research data anomalies, reporting discrepancies, processing delays, and system issues, identify root causes, and recommend sustainable solutions.
  • Use SQL to design and execute queries, validate data, investigate issues, and support reporting and business intelligence changes.
  • Create and maintain customer business rules for cost center allocation, package direction, data labeling, general ledger allocation, and related reporting requirements.
  • Support new customer implementations and changes to existing customer environments, including invoicing data, order files, customer data, reporting, allocation rules, and business intelligence fields.
  • Produce high-quality analysis that has been thoroughly tested, validated, documented, and reviewed before it is delivered to a customer.
  • Lead customer calls when needed, communicate project status and risks, and explain technical or analytical findings in clear business terms.
  • Partner with Strategic Solutions Managers, Technology, Contract Management and other teams to resolve issues and deliver complete customer solutions.
  • Maintain accurate project requests, action items, requirements, due dates, and supporting documentation in Jira and Confluence.
  • Identify customer requests that fall outside the applicable statement of work and escalate potential consulting or service opportunities.
  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, assist with troubleshooting, provide constructive feedback, and help strengthen team standards and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, analytics, workflows, quality controls, documentation, and the scalability of customer solutions.
  • Use company approved AI technologies to constantly improve and enhance Green Mountain’s ability to serve our customers and internal efficiencies

What You’ll Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Management Information Systems, or similar discipline.
  • At least two years of professional experience demonstrating SQL competency, including designing and executing queries within a relational database.
  • At least two years of professional experience designing, enhancing, or modifying business intelligence dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable platform.
  • At least two years of experience translating customer requirements into practical solutions and guiding customers from their requested approach to a sustainable best practice.
  • Experience supporting parcel RFPs for large or complex shippers.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including advanced formulas, VBA, data cleansing, and data manipulation.
  • Advanced knowledge of systems, processes, audits, and procedures, with proficiency in reporting, cost center configuration, package direction, network modeling, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Knowledge of transportation and supply chain systems and concepts.
  • An understanding of business intelligence tools, relational databases, and data warehousing.
  • Proficiency using Jira and Confluence to manage work and maintain documentation.
  • Strong critical-thinking and root-cause problem-solving skills, including the ability to recognize when an individual issue may be part of a broader system or configuration problem.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead customer calls and explain complex information clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to move between projects with different scopes, sizes, and levels of complexity.
  • The ability to work through ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, and recommend a practical path forward.
  • A self-motivated and outcome-oriented approach, with a strong commitment to timelines, quality, and customer satisfaction with limited oversight.
  • The ability to provide technical guidance, troubleshooting support, and constructive feedback to less-experienced Strategic Solutions Engineers
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience leading through influence without having formal management authority.
  • A demonstrated track record of mentoring less-experienced analysts or engineers and helping elevate team standards, quality, or technical capability.
  • Expert knowledge of parcel transportation reporting, cost center and package direction rules, parcel data, performance metrics, and the needs of large parcel shippers.
  • Experience analyzing large datasets and converting the results into clear, actionable customer recommendations.
  • Deep knowledge of SQL queries and relational databases.
  • Experience developing solutions that take into consideration total systems and parcel networks amid competing priorities.
  • Understanding of basic AI functions and how to use them appropriately to work more efficiently.
  • Experience developing complex parcel RFP models or carrier optimization scenarios.
  • Experience modeling multi-carrier or advanced day-definite parcel networks.
  • The ability to move quickly between projects with different scopes, timelines, and levels of complexity.
  • The ability to understand how a customer describes a problem, identify the underlying need, and clearly explain the most appropriate solution.
  • The confidence to tell a customer when a requested approach is not sustainable and recommend a better alternative.

Why Green Mountain Technology

Green Mountain Technology is a technology-enabled parcel logistics management and advisory firm. Large, complex shippers turn to us to continuously improve customer delivery experiences and the cost to make them possible.

Innovation is not an initiative. It is our culture. We were founded on a belief in pairing technology with talented and knowledgeable professionals in shipping, logistics, data analytics, and technology to create meaningful financial outcomes for our customers. We believe in continuously innovating differentiated value and empowering our people to lead with curiosity, creativity, and ownership.

Green Mountain Technology offers eligible team members medical coverage with two options, along with dental and vision benefits. Our HSA-qualified high-deductible health plan includes a generous company contribution, with optional health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts. Company-paid basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage are available from day one, with voluntary supplemental plans also offered. Additional benefits include fully remote work options in certain US states, paid holidays, PTO, Summer Hours with no waiting period, and a 401(k) plan with an automatic company contribution.

Green Mountain Technology is an equal opportunity employer that embraces inclusion and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Certificate Authority Program Steward
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
  • Coordinate work and build program expertise: Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
  • Improve tools and automate CA program tasks: Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.

What you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.

Our client is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager (B2B) to lead and scale the company’s marketing strategy across paid, organic, outbound, and brand channels.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution and is ideal for a growth-minded marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments, understands modern B2B marketing trends, and can drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

The Digital Marketing Manager will own the full marketing funnel — from demand generation and lead nurturing to brand positioning and performance optimization — ensuring consistent growth, high-quality lead flow, and strong brand visibility.

The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, execution-focused, and comfortable balancing strategy with day-to-day campaign management.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Marketing Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive B2B marketing strategy aligned with company growth goals
    • Own the marketing funnel end-to-end, from awareness and demand generation through lead nurturing and conversion
    • Partner closely with leadership and sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue objectives
    • Build, manage, and mentor high-performing marketing resources, agencies, or contractors as needed
    • Identify scalable growth opportunities across acquisition, retention, and brand channels

Campaign Management & Growth Execution

  • Lead and optimize multi-channel marketing campaigns across paid media, SEO, outbound, email marketing, social media, partnerships, and content
    • Manage budgets and allocate spend strategically to maximize ROI and efficiency
    • Oversee campaign messaging, positioning, and creative direction to maintain brand consistency
    • Launch and manage performance-driven campaigns focused on pipeline growth and customer acquisition
    • Test new acquisition channels, campaign structures, audiences, and messaging to improve results

Analytics, Optimization & Reporting

  • Track and analyze campaign performance metrics including CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, traffic, MQLs, SQLs, and revenue attribution
    • Build dashboards and reports using platforms such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or other analytics tools
    • Use data-driven insights to refine targeting, messaging, budget allocation, and campaign strategy
    • Present actionable recommendations and performance updates to leadership regularly
    • Continuously optimize campaigns through A/B testing and experimentation

Content, Branding & Messaging

  • Collaborate with content, design, and technical teams to ensure cohesive execution across channels
    • Guide messaging strategy and brand positioning to strengthen market visibility and engagement
    • Support content initiatives including blogs, landing pages, outbound messaging, and campaign assets
    • Ensure all marketing efforts align with brand voice, customer pain points, and business objectives

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, funnel conversion, and campaign alignment
    • Coordinate with operations and product stakeholders to ensure marketing supports business priorities
    • Contribute to broader growth strategy discussions and go-to-market initiatives

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strategic thinker who connects marketing execution to business outcomes
    • Hands-on operator comfortable managing campaigns and optimizing performance directly
    • Data-driven marketer who thrives on experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement
    • Creative storyteller capable of building compelling brand and campaign messaging
    • Strong communicator and collaborative leader who works effectively across teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in B2B marketing leadership roles such as Head of Marketing, Growth Lead, or Senior Marketing Manager
    • Demonstrated success driving measurable growth through paid ads, outbound marketing, SEO, and organic channels
    • Strong understanding of modern B2B marketing tools and platforms including LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, analytics tools, and outbound systems
    • Experience balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution
    • Strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting performance data and optimizing campaigns accordingly
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience leading marketing functions in B2B service-based, SaaS, or professional industries
    • Background in account-based marketing (ABM) or performance-driven demand generation
    • Familiarity with CRM and automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo
    • Experience managing cross-functional marketing teams or external agencies
    • Strong branding, storytelling, and positioning capabilities
    • Experience scaling marketing systems in high-growth environments

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Digital Marketing Manager’s day is a mix of strategic planning, campaign execution, and performance analysis. You will:

  • Review campaign dashboards and optimize active marketing initiatives
    • Collaborate with leadership, sales, and content teams to align priorities and messaging
    • Launch and refine campaigns across paid and organic channels
    • Monitor lead flow, pipeline quality, and funnel conversion performance
    • Test new acquisition ideas, audience segments, creatives, and messaging strategies
    • Analyze campaign data and prepare actionable reports and recommendations

In essence: you are responsible for driving pipeline growth, strengthening brand visibility, and ensuring marketing efforts generate measurable business impact.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
    • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Marketing ROI
    • Website traffic and conversion rate growth
    • Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-customer conversion rates

• Paid campaign performance and ROAS

  • Brand visibility, engagement, and audience growth across channels

Interview Process

  • Application Review – Assessment of experience and role alignment
    • Initial Interview – Discussion of background, marketing expertise, and growth mindset
    • Technical Interview – Deep dive into strategy, campaign management, analytics, and execution capabilities
    • Final Interview – Leadership and culture fit discussion with the client team

• Offer & Background Verification

About Global Expansion

Global Expansion is an Employer of Record. We let companies hire and manage people internationally without setting up their own legal entities. We are a premium, high-touch, relationship-driven service business, not a software platform, and that is the whole basis of the difference between us and most of our competitors.

Client & Employee Services is the front line of that promise. Everyone in this family is accountable for two things at once: the transaction being right, and the relationship being intact. A job in this family that delivers only the transaction has missed the point.

About the Role

As a Client Services Manager at GX, you'll be the face of our white-glove service for EOR clients. You'll be their main point of contact and will work with our Employee Onboarding, Ongoing Service, Offboarding and Experience teams to deliver a seamless experience from first presentation to long-term partnership. Your work drives client satisfaction, retention and growth.

What You’ll Do

1. Build and own client relationships:

  • Lead the onboarding of new clients through presentations and our established processes, through to full completion.
  • Act as the primary contact for your clients, building long-lasting relationships and understanding their business objectives so you can recommend tailored EOR solutions.
  • Run regular check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews to discuss performance, gather feedback and agree actions.

2. Coordinate service delivery:

  • Oversee the Employee Onboarding, Ongoing Service and Offboarding teams so clients get consistent, high-quality service.
  • Implement and monitor SLAs to keep response and resolution times on target.
  • Work with the Onboarding team to bring new employees on smoothly while meeting local regulations and client requirements.
  • Oversee offboarding with professionalism and legal compliance, and take on management responsibility when a client requests a termination.

3. Communicate and report:

  • Bridge communication between clients and internal teams, keeping everything clear and transparent.
  • Prepare and present service performance reports covering employee satisfaction, onboarding and offboarding timelines, and issue resolution rates.
  • Keep clients up to date on new services, compliance updates and changes that could affect their business.

4. Resolve problems:

  • Identify potential issues early and work with the right teams to resolve them quickly.
  • Resolve client concerns within SLA, and use interaction data and feedback to identify trends and recommend process improvements.

5. Grow your accounts:

  • Identify opportunities to expand services within your accounts and partner with Sales to convert them.
  • Develop client expansion strategies and track metrics such as additional services adopted and employee growth.

6. Advise strategically:

  • Work with clients to understand their future hiring plans and advise on scaling through EOR.
  • Align internal service delivery with client business goals.
  • Stay on top of industry trends and regulatory changes, and offer proactive advice.

What You’ll Bring

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing role, with a strong background in managing client relationships.
  • A confident, credible presence and strong communication skills. You instill confidence in clients and colleagues alike.
  • A business mindset, with the ability to understand client goals and connect them to commercial outcomes.
  • A collaborative approach to working across teams.
  • Willingness to travel. Travel is part of the role, ranging from once a year to more than once a quarter depending on client needs, so please apply only if you are comfortable with this.

Desirable

  1. EOR, global mobility, international payroll, PEO or professional services background.
  2. Exposure to multi-country employment, in-country partner or vendor models.
  3. Experience preparing and presenting business reviews to client stakeholders.
  4. Experience using Monday.com.

Why Join Us

You'll join a team that takes pride in delivering high-touch service and doing right by clients and their people. You'll own your client relationships and have real influence over how we serve and grow them.

The Operational Leader is accountable for end-to-end delivery of an assigned pharmacovigilance service-line scope across single-scope or multi-scope projects.
