jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Product & Infrastructure)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to build, scale, and maintain modern web applications and cloud infrastructure across high-impact product environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can own features end-to-end — from front-end user experience to back-end architecture, APIs, databases, deployments, and infrastructure reliability.

You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ship scalable applications that are performant, secure, and built for long-term growth.

This role goes beyond simply writing code. You’ll contribute to technical architecture, improve engineering processes, mentor junior developers, and help shape the reliability and scalability of the platform as the company grows.

If you enjoy building production-grade systems, solving infrastructure challenges, and shipping features quickly without compromising quality, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Full Stack Product Development

  • Build and maintain scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue
    • Develop secure and performant back-end services using Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), or similar frameworks
    • Design and build RESTful and GraphQL APIs
    • Translate Figma or product requirements into responsive, production-ready interfaces
    • Optimize front-end performance, accessibility, and user experience across devices

Database & System Architecture

  • Design scalable database schemas using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB
    • Write efficient queries and optimize application performance
    • Build systems that support scalability, maintainability, and reliability
    • Contribute to architecture decisions and long-term technical planning

Infrastructure, DevOps & Cloud Deployment

  • Deploy and manage applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar tools
    • Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployments through Kubernetes or serverless infrastructure
    • Monitor uptime, logs, and system health across environments

Testing, Reliability & Security

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Jest, Cypress, PyTest, or similar tools
    • Maintain strong testing standards and high code quality
    • Implement secure authentication, authorization, and API best practices
    • Follow modern security standards including OWASP best practices and secure infrastructure design
    • Troubleshoot outages, performance bottlenecks, and production issues proactively

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Participate in architecture reviews and technical planning discussions
    • Review pull requests and mentor junior engineers through code feedback and collaboration
    • Work closely with product managers and designers to refine requirements and technical feasibility
    • Help improve engineering workflows, standards, and development processes

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You can independently ship features from concept to deployment
    • You understand both application development and infrastructure reliability
    • You balance speed, scalability, and code quality effectively
    • You enjoy solving complex technical problems in production environments
    • You communicate clearly and collaborate well across teams
    • You take ownership of outcomes, not just tickets

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional full stack software engineering experience
    • Strong proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js
    • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB)
    • Experience deploying and managing applications in AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Strong understanding of APIs, authentication, and scalable application architecture
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows
    • Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading architecture discussions or technical design reviews
    • Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation)
    • Background working on SaaS products or high-traffic web applications
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless architectures
    • Familiarity with microservices and event-driven systems
    • Experience monitoring production systems using Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar tools
    • Exposure to performance optimization and cloud cost management

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Senior Full Stack Engineer’s day revolves around building features, improving infrastructure, and maintaining system reliability. You will:
• Participate in standups and technical planning discussions
• Build front-end interfaces and back-end APIs for new product features
• Review and merge pull requests while mentoring junior developers
• Debug production issues and optimize application performance
• Deploy updates through CI/CD pipelines and monitor infrastructure health
• Collaborate with product and design teams to refine workflows and user experience
• Improve testing, scalability, and long-term maintainability of the platform

In short: you are responsible for building reliable, scalable, and production-ready software systems that directly support business growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of features and technical initiatives
    • Application uptime and infrastructure reliability (99.9%+)
    • Code quality, testing coverage, and reduction of technical debt
    • Performance optimization and scalability improvements
    • Successful mentoring and collaboration across engineering teams
    • Stability and reliability of production deployments

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (Full Stack Exercise or Architecture Scenario)
    • Client Interview(s) with Engineering Team

jobs.title: Campaigns Director
jobs.description:
About U.S. Nature Initiative

U.S. Nature Initiative advances durable, bipartisan conservation outcomes by strategically aligning philanthropic investment with policy, campaign, and communications expertise. As a pooled funder, regranting partner, and strategic campaign architect, we resource high-impact efforts across public lands, private lands and water- strengthening the field and building lasting wins.

U.S. Nature Initiative is a fiscally sponsored project of Resources Legacy Fund (RLF). RLF delivers transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide. To learn more about Resources Legacy Fund, visit .

Position Summary

The U.S. Nature Initiative (USNI) is seeking a Campaign Director with a proven track record of successful advocacy campaign execution in the water, private lands, and/or public lands sectors. The Campaign Director will support USNI's conservation advocacy campaigns across various stages of development and implementation. They build strong working relationships with partners across the political spectrum. The Campaign Director works closely with the Vice President of Campaigns and USNI’s communications team.

This position is full-time, exempt, and reports to USNI’s Vice President of Communications. It is fully remote within the U.S., with occasional travel (estimated 25%.)

Key Responsibilities:

Grantee Partnership Management (50%)

  • Collaborating closely with selected grantees to ensure the successful development and delivery of high-quality campaign deliverables.
  • Providing grantees with strategic guidance, technical assistance, and ensuring alignment with USNI's objectives while engaging the USNI team as appropriate.
  • USNI anticipates having 10-15 active advocacy campaigns at any given time spanning fresh water, private land, and public lands issues.

Campaign Planning and Strategy (20%)

  • Assisting leadership in the development of robust, measurable, and impactful campaign plans–primarily focusing on developing subsequent phases of campaigns following the success of existing advocacy campaign investments.

Grantee Identification and Vetting (20%)

  • Assisting leadership in researching, evaluating, and recommending potential grantees capable of executing campaign goals.

Ad Hoc Campaign Support (10%)

  • Executing various other campaign-related tasks as determined by USNI leadership.

Requirements

Qualifications:

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

  • 8+ experience in conservation advocacy campaign execution, including implementing long-term, multi-phase advocacy campaigns that create momentum for bold policy outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: water resource conservation, private and working lands management/conservation, or public lands and wildlife protection/advocacy.
  • A robust understanding of strategic communications tactics and how to effectively deploy these tactics in service of conservation advocacy campaigns.
  • Strong project management skills, particularly in managing multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with non-profit organizations, grassroots groups, and other field partners.
  • Experience working with organizations from across the ideological spectrum, ensuring alignment behind long-term goals and objectives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and time management ability; a self-starter who takes initiative.

Preferred Qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a deep working knowledge and experience with public land and wildlife policy, particularly in the Intermountain West.
  • Possess a working knowledge of various accountability tools and tactics that can be deployed to build and wield influence for a policy goal, including familiarity with 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) advocacy rules
  • Have experience working in partnership and interfacing with philanthropy

Commitment to Nondiscrimination

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.

RLF participates in E-Verify, potential candidates can review the information here and here.

Benefits

The starting salary range for the Campaigns Director is $120,000-135,000 annually, salary commensurate with experience. We offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.

jobs.title: Sales Executive (South Africa)
jobs.description:
Position: Sales Executive

Salary: ~£900–£1,200/month base + incentives

Working Hours & Conditions: UK hours: 9:00am – 5:30pm (1-hour lunch); full-time (remote)

Holidays: UK Holidays

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition for the company.

This is a front-end sales role where you will take ownership of the entire sales process, from identifying potential clients and making the first approach through to arranging sales meetings, presenting our services, handling objections, closing deals and managing the initial onboarding process.

You'll be targeting contractors and construction-related businesses across the UK, identifying those who could benefit from having a dedicated outsourced business development team working on their behalf.

You'll need to be comfortable picking up the telephone, sending targeted emails, networking through LinkedIn and proactively approaching business owners and directors.

Your objective is straightforward: identify businesses that need help winning more work, demonstrate how our services can help them and convert those opportunities into paying clients.

This isn't a passive sales role. We want someone who is hungry for new business, enjoys speaking to decision-makers, follows up consistently and takes pride in closing deals.

You'll be supported by the wider company team, but you'll be responsible for managing your own sales pipeline and driving your own results.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Prospecting & Identifying New Clients

  • Research and identify potential new clients within the UK construction industry.
  • Build targeted prospect lists of contractors, subcontractors, specialist trades and construction-related businesses.
  • Identify business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
  • Use LinkedIn, company websites, construction directories and other research tools to identify suitable prospects.
  • Understand each prospect's business, services, market position and potential need for outsourced business development.
  • Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of potential clients.

2. Outbound Sales & Lead Generation

  • Make consistent outbound telephone calls to prospective clients.
  • Send targeted cold emails introducing the company and explaining the benefits of our service.
  • Use LinkedIn to connect with business owners, directors and other relevant decision-makers.
  • Build relationships with prospective clients through consistent communication and follow-up.
  • Generate interest in the company's outsourced business development service.
  • Identify businesses experiencing challenges with winning new work, developing relationships or maintaining a consistent sales pipeline.
  • Convert initial interest into qualified sales conversations.

3. Booking & Conducting Sales Meetings

  • Arrange telephone and online meetings with prospective clients.
  • Understand their current business development arrangements, commercial objectives and growth ambitions.
  • Explain how the company operates and how our team would work as an extension of their business.
  • Present the benefits of having dedicated outsourced business development support.
  • Explain our approach to prospecting, relationship building, introductions and generating new work opportunities.
  • Demonstrate the value of our services through relevant examples and case studies.
  • Handle questions, concerns and objections confidently.

4. Closing New Business

  • Follow up on proposals and sales conversations.
  • Maintain consistent communication with prospective clients throughout the sales process.
  • Handle commercial discussions and explain pricing and contractual arrangements.
  • Overcome objections and help prospects understand the value of investing in business development.
  • Secure signed agreements and confirm new client commitments.
  • Follow opportunities through to successful payment and onboarding.
  • Maintain ownership of your sales pipeline until the client has successfully joined the company.

5. Client Onboarding & Handover

  • Coordinate the initial onboarding process for new clients.
  • Collect relevant company information, service details, capabilities and target market requirements.
  • Ensure agreements and initial payments are completed.
  • Arrange introductions and handovers to the Business Development Account Management team.
  • Ensure the client has a clear understanding of what happens next and how their service will operate.
  • Maintain a professional relationship with newly signed clients throughout the transition.

6. Sales Reporting & Performance

  • Maintain accurate records of prospecting, calls, emails, LinkedIn activity and sales conversations.
  • Manage your pipeline using our internal CRM and tracking systems.
  • Monitor conversion rates from initial contact through to signed agreements.
  • Provide regular sales activity and performance updates.
  • Work towards agreed targets for prospecting, appointments, proposals and new client acquisitions.
  • Take responsibility for developing your own pipeline and achieving your sales objectives.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:

We're looking for someone who is naturally confident, commercially minded and motivated by bringing new business into a growing company.

You should enjoy speaking to people, be comfortable approaching businesses you have never spoken to before and have the persistence to follow opportunities through to a successful sale.

You don't necessarily need construction industry experience, as training will be provided. However, previous experience in B2B sales, telesales or business development would be beneficial.

Essential Skills & Attributes

  • Confident in making outbound cold calls.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable speaking with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
  • Confident presenting and selling a professional business service.
  • Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills.
  • Persistent and proactive when following up sales opportunities.
  • Organised and able to manage multiple prospects and sales conversations.
  • Target-driven with a genuine desire to achieve and exceed sales targets.
  • Comfortable using LinkedIn, email, telephone and CRM systems.
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of sales performance.
  • Professional, personable and confident representing the company.

Desirable Experience

● Previous B2B sales experience.

  • Experience in telesales, outbound sales or appointment setting.
  • Experience selling professional services or business-to-business solutions.
  • Experience dealing with company directors and business owners.
  • Knowledge of the UK construction industry.

Benefits

Commission:

In addition to your basic salary, you'll receive commission for every new client you successfully bring into the business. We will pay a commission of £100.00 per sale and we will also provide a commission ladder where you will receive further bonuses dependent on the number of sales made.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.title: Junior Product Illustrator
jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Do You Turn Great Creative Direction Into Finished, On-Style Product Art?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world, and we are looking for an early-career illustrator who wants to spend their days making the art that goes into our products.

We are seeking a Junior Product Illustrator to work hand-in-hand with our Chief Creative Officer, taking her creative direction and carrying it through to finished, production-ready product art. This is a maker's seat, not a template-and-layout role. If you love to draw, you have a genuine eye for cute, playful, kid-friendly design, and you want to grow your craft inside a brand that ships beautiful products every month, this is a rare opportunity to build your portfolio while doing work that reaches millions of families.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission: We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision: We aim to build the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

As our Junior Product Illustrator, your one job is to turn the Chief Creative Officer's vision into finished, on-style product art, so Hadley Designs launches new products faster and our creative capacity is multiplied, not capped by a single set of hands. The CCO sets the tone, the style, and the strategy; you carry the hands-on execution, creating new artwork, completing sets in an established style, and building each concept out to production-ready. This is a deliberately early-career seat for someone with real illustration talent who wants to keep growing that craft. You will not be expected to arrive as a seasoned art director. You will be expected to draw well, learn our style quickly, take direction cleanly, and finish the last mile of the creative so the CCO can stay focused on setting direction rather than executing it.

Key Responsibilities

Original Illustration & Artwork

  • Create new artwork and complete sets in Hadley Designs' established style across our product lines.
  • Draw and illustrate original elements like characters, motifs, patterns, and scenes that fit our cute, kid-friendly aesthetic.

Product Design Execution

  • Turn the CCO's concepts and creative direction into finished, production-ready product designs.
  • Carry a design from initial handoff through final build-out without kicking work back up the chain.

Creative Production Support

  • Own the execution offload (variations, building out a design across a full set, and file prep) that frees the CCO's hands.
  • Prepare print and production files to spec, and build mockups and product previews for listings.

Style Consistency

  • Keep every piece on-style and on-brand across the full product set.
  • Maintain the living style-reference so the look stays consistent as the catalog grows.

As-needed: occasional ad-ops support (A+ content, storefront updates, CMYK ad images) and revisions on existing product lines. This is secondary support, not the core of the role.

How Success Is Measured

First-pass approval rate: the share of deliverables the CCO accepts with no major rework. This is how we measure "on-style" objectively.

New original art created: the volume of original artwork generated to feed the product pipeline.

Sets / SKUs completed: finished design sets shipped per month. The speed lever.

On-time delivery: the share of assigned pieces delivered by the agreed deadline.

  • Framework-to-finish independence: the share of projects carried from CCO handoff to production-ready without kicking work back up.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are an early-career illustrator with genuine drawing talent and a real eye for cute, playful, kid-friendly design. You love to make art and you want to keep doing exactly that. This is the work you want to grow in, not a stepping stone into something else. You take creative direction cleanly, you learn a style fast, and you can carry a piece all the way to finished without needing it handed back to you. You thrive in a remote, fast-moving environment where new products ship every month, and you are excited to build your portfolio inside a brand that reaches millions of families.

Must-haves

  • A portfolio of original illustration work that shows a cute, playful, kid-friendly or product-design sensibility.
  • Working proficiency in Adobe Illustrator for native illustration (not just file handling or layout).
  • Ability to match and extend an existing art style, completing a set so new pieces sit naturally alongside the originals.
  • Strong ability to take written and verbal creative direction and turn it into finished work.
  • Reliability on deadlines while managing several pieces at once.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience preparing print / production files to spec.
  • Familiarity with the children's, educational, or consumer-product space.
  • Comfort with lightweight project tools (Notion, ClickUp) and file organization.
  • Note: this is an entry-level maker's role. We are not looking for a senior art director or a veteran illustrator. We are looking for real talent early in its arc, with the interest and hunger to grow.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.
  • Growth: Learn directly from our Chief Creative Officer and build a portfolio of shipped, real-world product work.
  • Remote-first work environment
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Access to learning resources and professional development
  • Free access to Hadley Designs products
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CCO
  • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

In this role, you will apply rigorous analytic methods to complex education policy and systems questions while helping develop innovative tools and resources that improve project efficiency, strengthen analytic capabilities, and enhance the value we deliver to clients. You will work closely with researchers, technical staff, and project leaders to bridge education content expertise with data science and technical development, contributing to high-quality analyses, reproducible workflows, and practical solutions that advance ESP’s research and client work.

Candidates hired for the position may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories. 

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

Headquarters: Kitchener, Ontario, Canada

Job Title
Senior WordPress / WooCommerce Engineer
Location
Remote – Canada (EST Availability)
Employment Type
New, Full-Time Permanent position
Compensation
$100,000–$130,000 CAD annually, plus 5% employer retirement matching and benefits

About Mad Barn
Mad Barn is a growing equine nutrition company dedicated to improving horse health through research, education, and evidence-based nutritional solutions.
Our WordPress and WooCommerce platforms are central to our business, supporting e-commerce operations, recurring subscriptions, customer accounts, educational content, and custom functionality across the Canadian and US markets.

As we continue to grow, we're investing in our engineering capabilities to ensure our platforms remain secure, reliable, performant, and scalable.

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Senior WordPress / WooCommerce Engineer to join our development team.
This is a hands-on technical role combining full-stack development with proactive platform engineering. You will spend approximately half your time developing new features, maintaining existing functionality, and resolving technical issues. The remaining time will focus on improving application security, database integrity, reliability, performance, and engineering practices.

You will work alongside an experienced WordPress developer as a senior technical peer, contributing independently to development projects and collaboratively improving the quality and maintainability of our codebase.

The ideal candidate has worked on complex, business-critical web applications and understands the engineering practices required to support a high-growth e-commerce business. You should be comfortable working directly in the codebase, investigating technical problems, identifying risks, and implementing solutions without requiring detailed instructions for every improvement.

What We Offer:
  • Competitive salary with comprehensive health benefits and RRSP matching opportunity.
  • 100% remote position, offering the flexibility and convenience of working from home.
  • Commitment to professional growth.
Key Responsibilities
WordPress & WooCommerce Development
  • Develop and enhance custom WordPress plugins, themes, and WooCommerce functionality, including checkout, subscriptions, recurring billing, and customer accounts.
  • Troubleshoot complex bugs, compatibility issues, and production problems.
  • Build and maintain third-party integrations using APIs and webhooks.
  • Evaluate and manage plugins, modernize legacy code, and reduce technical debt to improve maintainability and performance.
  • Collaborate with the existing developer on architecture, implementation, testing, and code reviews.
Database Integrity & Reliability
  • Take ownership of application-level database integrity, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and recoverability of orders, subscriptions, and customer records.
  • Implement safeguards against data corruption, duplication, and loss, and optimize database operations.
  • Work with the hosting provider to strengthen backup, redundancy, and recovery capabilities, including point-in-time recovery where appropriate.
  • Establish, document, and regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Implement proactive monitoring and alerts for critical processes, including checkout, payment processing, subscription renewals, and background jobs.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventative solutions.
Security & Vulnerability Management
  • Proactively identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities across WordPress, WooCommerce, plugins, themes, custom code, and application dependencies.
  • Conduct security reviews and implement secure coding practices, including appropriate authentication, access controls, input validation, and data protection.
  • Evaluate third-party plugins for security, compatibility, maintenance, and operational risk.
  • Monitor security advisories and work with the hosting provider to implement security improvements and application hardening.
  • Maintain secure development and deployment practices, including appropriate review and validation of AI-generated code and automated coding agents.
Platform Engineering, Performance & Scalability
  • Evaluate and improve platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Identify and resolve PHP, database, caching, and application performance bottlenecks; optimize MySQL/MariaDB queries, indexing, and WooCommerce data structures.
  • Improve automated testing, continuous integration, deployment workflows, and rollback procedures.
  • Establish safe processes for plugin updates, database migrations, and production deployments.
  • Support technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and overall website performance.
  • Reduce unnecessary plugin dependencies and contribute to technical documentation and shared engineering standards.
Proactive Engineering & Collaboration
  • Conduct an initial assessment of platform security, database integrity, backup systems, architecture, and development practices.
  • Identify and prioritize technical risks and improvements based on business impact, independently driving solutions from assessment through implementation.
  • Collaborate with the existing developer, hosting provider, and internal teams, communicating technical risks and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Participate in shared emergency coverage for critical production incidents.
What Success Looks Like
In your first three months, you will become familiar with our existing codebase and technical environment, contribute to active development projects, and conduct an assessment of application security, database integrity, backups, reliability, and engineering practices. You will identify priority risks and work with the team to establish a practical improvement plan.

Over your first year, you will deliver meaningful improvements to our WooCommerce functionality, code quality, security, monitoring, recovery capabilities, and development processes. Success in this role means building useful features while making the underlying platform more dependable, secure, and capable of supporting continued growth.

Qualifications
Required
  • Significant professional software engineering experience, ideally 7+ years, including substantial hands-on WordPress and WooCommerce development.
  • Advanced proficiency in PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SQL.
  • Demonstrated experience building complex custom WordPress plugins, themes, and WooCommerce extensions.
  • Strong knowledge of WooCommerce architecture, order processing, customer accounts, and subscriptions.
  • Advanced experience with MySQL or MariaDB, including query optimization, indexing, database integrity, and safe schema changes.
  • Experience supporting production e-commerce applications where reliability, security, and data accuracy are business-critical.
  • Strong understanding of application security, vulnerability management, secure coding practices, and OWASP principles.
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing, staging environments, and production deployment workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting performance, database, and application-level reliability issues.
  • Experience developing and maintaining REST API integrations and webhooks.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot, including responsible code review, validation, and security practices.
  • Strong communication, independent problem-solving, and collaborative technical decision-making skills.
Asset
  • Experience developing or maintaining high-traffic, high-transaction-volume WooCommerce stores including:
    • WooCommerce Subscriptions, payment gateways, Action Scheduler, and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Experience implementing or improving backup architecture, point-in-time recovery, disaster recovery, and production monitoring.
  • Familiarity with WordPress Multisite or multilingual WordPress implementations, including WPML and implementing Elasticsearch solutions in a multilingual environment.
  • Experience with Cloudflare, CDN configurations, application caching, and WordPress performance optimization.
  • Experience with technical SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and large content-driven websites.
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications and refactoring complex WordPress codebases.
  • Familiarity with automated vulnerability scanning and application security assessment tools.

jobs.title: Director of Customer Success
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's Enterprise Solutions team partners with Global grocery and retail chains to power their digital commerce through StorefrontPro, Enterprise API (Fulfillment and Ads), CarrotAds, and adjacent Enterprise Solutions  products. We're seeking a Director, Customer Success to lead the  Customer Success organization — accountable for post-live value realization  across the enterprise software portfolio.

In this highly visible role, you will lead senior managers and Customer Success Managers who serve as the strategic advisor of Instacart to retailer executives. You'll own retailer value realization, measured through adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score coverage, at-risk portfolio management, CSAT, and QBR quality across the portfolio. You'll partner closely with Business Development, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness. You'll also partner with Enterprise Solutions Delivery, Technology leadership, and Product on portfolio strategy, retailer signal, and roadmap adoption.

This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. The role reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Solutions , and is remote across the United States and Canada with a preference for proximity to Toronto for key cross-functional collaboration.

About the Job

  • Lead the Customer Success organization for the Enterprise Solutions  portfolio — owning value realization,  outcomes end to end, and partner closely with BD, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness.Build and develop a senior consultative CS bench by hiring, sponsoring, and ramping Customer Success Managers  who engage with retailer executives on ecommerce strategy, merchandising, and operations and who can credibly influence retailer P&L outcomes and roadmap adoption.
  • Manage senior managers leading segments, setting standards for what good looks like across the CSM’s  — including QBR quality, growth planning, executive engagement, and renewal execution.
  • Operate in a BD-led commercial environment as a true commercial peer to BD — preserving BD's ownership of the primary commercial relationship while owning post-sale accountability and surfacing churn, expansion, and escalation signal early and clearly.
  • Partner with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering on shared-account coordination — ensuring the cross-org account team ( CS + Technical Account Managers (TAM’s) ) functions as one team to the retailer despite the functional ownership, with co-authored protocols and clean escalation paths.
  • Define and enforce the CSM/TAM boundary based on segmentation — CSM’s lead retailer-executive engagement, value realization, and growth planning, while TAM’s own technical delivery, configuration, and issue resolution, so that CSM capacity stays focused on strategic advisory, not technical execution.
  • Own the consultative transformation roadmap — talent strategy, comp structure, operating cadence, and tooling shifts required to evolve CS from a feature-enablement function into a strategic business advisory function.
  • Partner with the Director of Retailer Delivery on the implementation-to-success motion as a managed lifecycle (not a document handoff) — ensuring CS is engaged early, named handoff criteria are met, and accounts transition cleanly into early-lifecycle growth ownership.
  • Operationalize the retailer segmented  model in CS — applying high-touch coverage and scaled/digital-first models, with clear exception protocols and capacity guardrails.
  • Build a structured retailer-signal feedback loop into Product — using CS engagements to surface durable patterns (not anecdotes), instrument adoption of roadmap items, and hold CS accountable for adoption outcomes.
  • Apply AI augmentation to scale CS coverage and quality without linear headcount growth — including health monitoring, account-prep automation, QBR/insight generation, and signal triage — partnering with the Technical org on tooling roadmap and adoption.
  • Represent the post-sale narrative for the portfolio to senior leadership — integrating retention, growth, churn risk, executive-account temperature, and pipeline outlook — and serve as the Director-level escalation point for retailer relationships when CSM-led engagement is insufficient.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of enterprise customer success, account management, or post-sale leadership at a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company.
  • Direct, accountable leadership of a customer success organization responsible for adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score, at-risk portfolio, CSAT, QBR quality and support BD with GRR, NRR, and expansion.
  • Track record of managing managers with demonstrated ability to set standards and develop senior leaders without micromanagement.
  • Ownership of a CS book of business or post-sale P&L of meaningful scale (e.g., $1000M+ ARR) with documented outcomes on Adoption, NRR, GRR, or expansion.
  • Proven success operating in a BD- or Sales-led commercial environment — clear instinct for where the CS lane begins and ends, comfort with shared standards rather than rigid RACI/process.
  • Demonstrated executive presence with enterprise customer counterparts (VP / SVP / C-level), including the ability to deliver hard news, navigate escalations, and rebuild trust after issues.
  • Experience designing and operating segmented  CS coverage models (high-touch for strategic accounts, scaled/digital for the long tail), including capacity planning and exception handling.
  • Hands-on experience hiring senior CS  talent — with a clear point of view on profile, comp, and ramp.
  • Strong background  having operated in an  end to end post sales service delivery ecosystem with strong CS interaction with Business Development/Sales, Delivery, Technical and Product teams. Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transforming a CS function from reactive enablement into proactive business advisory, including the talent, comp, operating-model, and tooling changes required (not a renaming exercise).
  • Track record of building or scaling seasoned strategist roles inside a CS org — including hiring profile, ramp, comp design, and integration with the rest of the account team.
  • Experience operating with a separate technical TAM function on shared enterprise accounts — including co-authoring cross-org protocols and managing escalations across an org boundary.
  • Background applying AI to CS workflows — health monitoring, account preparation, QBR generation, signal triage — with measurable impact on coverage, throughput, or quality.
  • Familiarity with the BD/CS interface in commercially complex enterprise sales motions, including renewals, multi-product expansion, and shared-account operating norms.
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise retail, grocery, ecommerce platforms, retail media, or adjacent complex B2B domains — including how large retailers evaluate, adopt, and scale technology solutions.
  • Experience instrumenting retailer signal into structured product feedback (not anecdotal) and partnering with Product leaders on adoption accountability.

#LI-Remote



Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

Upstart’s Secured Lending Quality team is responsible for building and operating the first line of defense quality control program across Upstart’s secured lending products, including Home Lending and Auto Lending. The team ensures loans meet high standards for accuracy, compliance, and salability through a multi-layered quality framework spanning origination, servicing, collections, and non-performing loan monitoring. The team operates independently from production management, providing credible challenges to the business while using AI-powered technology to deliver scalable, examination-ready quality assurance.

As the Secured Lending Quality Manager, you will lead quality control execution across the secured product portfolio, including pre-close and post-close reviews, compliance monitoring and testing, servicing and collections quality reviews, non-performing loan reviews, and investor defect analysis. You will serve as a key leader in strengthening Upstart’s quality infrastructure, partner closely with Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk, and help scale a modern, data-driven quality program in a fast-moving lending environment. This is an opportunity for an experienced quality leader who is energized by building programs from the ground up and improving how quality is measured, monitored, and operationalized across the secured lending lifecycle.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead execution of Upstart’s secured lending quality control program across origination, servicing, and collections, including pre-close and post-close reviews, compliance testing, denied/withdrawn application reviews, investor defect analysis, and non-performing loan reviews
  • Oversee QC sampling methodology and ensure risk-based, statistically sound sample selection aligned with regulatory expectations
  • Serve as product owner for the QC Engine, including rule approval, output validation, threshold calibration, and performance reporting
  • Drive root cause analysis and remediation for defect trends, investor kickouts, repurchase demands, early payment defaults, and other quality issues
  • Develop quality reporting, dashboards, and trend analyses for senior leadership, including defect trends, escape rates, cure rates, sampling coverage, and corrective action status
  • Prepare the Quality function for audits and regulatory exams through strong documentation, evidence management, and examination-ready processes
  • Partner with Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, and servicing teams to align on quality standards, escalation paths, and remediation timelines
  • Oversee third-party, subservicer, servicing, and collections quality reviews, including compliance with applicable consumer lending requirements
  • Support model risk monitoring through quality reviews tied to credit decisioning, adverse action accuracy, and early default trends

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 7+ years of experience in quality control, compliance testing, or risk management in consumer lending, including secured lending products such as mortgage, home equity, or auto
  • 2+ years of experience leading a QC team or managing quality analysts or auditors
  • Experience conducting pre-close and post-close file reviews, defect identification, root cause analysis, and corrective action management
  • Experience with regulatory exams and responses involving agencies such as the OCC, FDIC, CFPB, or state regulators
  • Experience designing or implementing QC sampling methodologies, including random and risk-based sampling
  • Experience with non-performing loan reviews, early default analysis, repurchase reviews, or servicing quality oversight
  • Working knowledge of key consumer lending regulations applicable to secured products
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-powered or automated QC tools
  • Experience with investor delivery requirements, repurchase demands, or loan buybacks
  • Experience with third-party and subservicer oversight frameworks
  • Experience building dashboards, executive reporting, or board-ready quality materials
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical QC procedures and testing frameworks

jobs.title: Sr. Director Revenue Accounting
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US Remote

Senior Director, Revenue Accounting

 

Bitwarden is looking for a Sr. Director of Revenue Accounting to own how we recognize, record, and report revenue across both self-service and sales-assisted channels. This leader is accountable for the full revenue cycle, from contract and invoice through cash and recognized revenue. You will own our revenue stack (Stripe, HubSpot, and Rillet) end to end and partner closely with Sales, Legal, FP&A, and Engineering.

 

What You'll Own:

 

  • Own end-to-end order to cash operations for both self-service (PLG, credit card, via Stripe) and sales-assisted (enterprise, multi-year, custom contract) revenue streams.
  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for self-service and sales-assisted contracts, including performance obligations, standalone selling price, contract modifications, multi-year and ramped deals, usage-based components, and channel or reseller arrangements.
  • Own deferred revenue, revenue schedules, and the monthly revenue close in Rillet, and deliver accurate revenue results to Corporate Accounting for month-end close.
  • Design billing and revenue processes for large, complex transactions: multi-entity contracts, custom pricing, mid-term upgrades and downgrades, true-ups, and co-terming, from HubSpot deal creation through Stripe invoicing to Rillet recognition.
  • Own the data flow and reconciliation across HubSpot, Stripe, and Rillet, including the bookings to billings to revenue reconciliation, the deferred revenue rollforward, and AR subledger to general ledger tie-outs.
  • Own sales tax compliance across all channels, including nexus monitoring, tax calculation and collection in Stripe, exemption certificate management, return filing and remittance, and audit readiness, in partnership with external tax advisors.
  • Write technical accounting memos for non-standard enterprise contracts and review them with external auditors.
  • Own SOX controls for the revenue cycle and serve as the main contact for audit fieldwork on revenue.
  • Define and monitor KPIs: billing accuracy, days sales outstanding, dunning/failed payment recovery rate, invoice cycle time, and dispute rates.
  • Partner with Sales to structure non-standard enterprise deals so they translate cleanly into accurate, compliant billing in Stripe.
  • Own sales commission accounting and administration, including commission calculations and payouts, ASC 340-40 capitalization and amortization of commission costs, and accrual accuracy, and partner with Sales leadership, FP&A, and HR on commission plan design, quota and attainment rules, and the cost and controls impact of plan changes.
  • Drive Stripe configuration and automation (subscription schedules, proration rules, dunning/failed payment recovery, invoicing rules) to reduce manual touch on high-volume self-service billing.
  • Partner with SalesOps to own the HubSpot-to-Stripe-to-Rillet data pipeline — ensuring deal terms, billing events, and revenue entries stay in sync, and closing gaps with native integrations, middleware, or custom tooling as needed.
  • Collaborate with Product/Engineering on Stripe/product OTC enhancements, new pricing models, and packaging changes.
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a billing, collections and commission teams (analysts, specialists, managers) as transaction volume and deal complexity grow.

 

What We're Looking For:

 

  • 10+ years of accounting experience, including 5+ years in SaaS revenue accounting and 3+ years leading teams.
  • CPA or equivalent public accounting experience 
  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606 experience for SaaS, including large and non-standard enterprise transactions: custom terms, multi-year deals, usage-based or hybrid pricing, amendments, and co-terming.
  • Experience accounting for both self-service (high-volume, automated, credit-card-based) and sales-assisted (contract-based, high-value) revenue.
  • Experience with SOX, external audit management, and building controls in a growing company.
  • Experience managing billing, collections, or order-to-cash teams, and commission
  • Track record of building scalable processes and automating manual workflows, including integrations between CRM, billing, and accounting systems.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $200,000 - $225,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits.

Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

We’re looking for team members who can own the current and future state of our Gov cloud infrastructure distributed across multiple cloud providers, design and build out new infrastructure, as well as operationalize tools and technologies that enable our team and application to scale.

jobs.title: Editorial Director, Brand & Creative Partnerships
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US: SF, NYC, Seattle and Remote

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team brings together Content Marketing, Brand Marketing, Portfolio Product Marketing, Copywriting, Copy Editing, and Customer Marketing. We create coherent, distinctive stories about the businesses, technologies, and economic forces shaping the internet.

What you’ll do

We are hiring a senior editorial leader to help bring original stories and insights from Stripe–based on our data, expertise, and customer conversations–to a broader audience via media partnerships and other brand marketing channels. This person will be an exceptional editor, writer, and creative partner with strong instincts about what earns attention: an argument worth making, an unexpected angle, an elegant execution, or a piece of work that people genuinely want to share.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the leader of Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team. The role will spend most of its time shaping major external media partnerships, with the remainder split between helping with original editorial work and advising partner teams on new ideas and their execution.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the editorial and creative direction for Stripe’s most important external media partnerships, including advertising content, research-led collaborations, and original editorial programs developed with respected publishers and creators.
  • Develop work that feels native to the audience and editorial environment in which it appears—not generic brand messaging placed beside someone else’s work.
  • Turn Stripe’s original data analyses, economic insights, customer stories, and more into content pieces that are clear, surprising, useful, and memorable–and that readers and listeners won’t want to skip over.
  • Shape the full editorial process for partnership work: refining briefs, identifying the strongest ideas, directing creative development, and providing decisive feedback on drafts and final deliverables.
  • Direct and manage agencies, external creators, and editorial partners as needed, working within existing partnership structures and commercial agreements.
  • Write, edit, and materially improve high-stakes content across formats, including blog posts, newsletter segments, podcast scripts, ad copy, social posts, and more.
  • Generate original concepts for creative programs, editorial franchises, and nontraditional formats that broaden how Stripe contributes to conversations about the internet economy.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to teams across Stripe, helping them clarify ideas, find the strongest expression of their work, and make better creative decisions.
  • Partner with colleagues in Brand Marketing, Brand Design, Content Marketing, Portfolio PMM, Copywriting, and Customer Marketing to make Stripe’s storytelling more coherent and distinctive.
  • Define and uphold a clear quality bar for editorial and partnership work, making well-reasoned calls about what is ready to represent Stripe and what still needs improvement.

Who you are

We are looking for someone with exceptional editorial judgment and a demonstrated ability to make complicated ideas compelling. You may have developed that experience in a newsroom, independent publication, creative studio, agency, research institution, technology company, or another rigorous creative environment.

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience in editorial, writing, creative development, journalism, publishing, media, brand strategy, or a closely related field. This may include experience writing consistently for a large online followership, even if not professionally.
  • You have an exceptional portfolio of published or public-facing work that demonstrates strong writing and editing, original thinking, and an ability to make ideas resonate with an audience.
  • You are, in the best sense, very online: an active reader of and contributor to the newsletters, social platforms, and niche communities where people debate new ideas about technology, economics, science, business, and culture. You can spot emerging arguments, voices, and formats early—and engage with them authentically, with intellectual honesty and your own point of view.
  • You are an excellent editor. You can diagnose what is missing from a draft or idea, identify the most interesting argument, and give feedback that makes the work materially better.
  • You have experience developing original editorial work, sponsored media, advertising, creative partnerships, or other high-quality audience-facing programs.
  • You understand the difference between work that is merely on-message and work that is genuinely interesting, useful, or worth discussing.
  • You can translate complex subjects—including technology, business, economics, science, or policy—into work that is accessible without becoming simplistic.
  • You have strong creative instincts and a sophisticated design sensibility. You understand how language, ideas, visuals, format, and distribution work together.
  • You are deeply curious about the technology industry and the broader cultural and economic context in which it operates.
  • You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, external partners, writers, designers, marketers, and agencies without relying on formal authority.
  • You can move fluidly between strategy and execution: developing the core idea, shaping the brief, improving the draft, and making the final call on quality.
  • You have high standards, sound judgment, and enough pragmatism to help teams make excellent work within real constraints.

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Revenue Enablement to lead and scale our enablement function as Tailscale enters its next phase of growth. You'll own the strategy, team, and systems that help our revenue organization ramp faster, develop deep technical and commercial expertise, and consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences.

This is an opportunity to build a world-class enablement function at a high-growth, product-led company. You'll partner closely with Sales, Customer Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, skills, and tools to effectively engage technical buyers, communicate the value of Tailscale's platform, and drive meaningful customer outcomes.

We're looking for someone who thinks beyond traditional training programs. As AI transforms how teams learn, engage customers, and work, you'll define the next generation of enablement at Tailscale, building scalable, AI-powered systems that accelerate productivity, deepen technical expertise, and keep pace with our rapidly evolving product and GTM motions.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, strong commercial instincts, technical aptitude, and a builder's mentality. You've successfully scaled enablement in a high-growth environment, understand what great customer-facing execution looks like across both sales and technical roles, and are energized by rethinking how enablement operates.

Key Responsibilities

Build and Lead Revenue Enablement
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter enablement strategy aligned with Tailscale's revenue priorities and growth objectives.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing enablement team, establishing scalable processes, clear priorities, and accountability.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to revenue leadership, identifying capability gaps and connecting enablement investments to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build scalable enablement systems that support rapid headcount growth, increasing product complexity, and the evolving needs of our customer-facing organization.
Accelerate Onboarding and Continuous Development
  • Own role-based onboarding and ongoing development across Sales, Sales Development, Customer Engineering, Customer Success, and other revenue-facing teams.
  • Build scalable learning paths, competency frameworks, and certifications that accelerate ramp time and drive continuous skill development.
  • Partner with frontline managers to establish coaching frameworks and reinforce learning through everyday workflows.
Drive Sales and Technical Excellence
  • Develop programs that strengthen sales execution, including discovery, value selling, competitive positioning, negotiation, and account development.
  • Partner with technical leaders to build enablement programs covering product architecture, technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept execution.
  • Establish role-specific proficiency standards, playbooks, and certifications that improve commercial and technical effectiveness across the customer lifecycle.
Connect Product Innovation to Field Readiness
  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and technical leaders to establish a repeatable product launch readiness framework.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into relevant learning experiences, messaging, and resources tailored to commercial and technical audiences.
  • Maintain scalable content and knowledge systems while establishing feedback loops to continuously improve field readiness.
Reimagine Enablement Through AI and Automation
  • Define and execute an AI-first enablement strategy that transforms how teams learn, practice, access knowledge, and improve performance.
  • Implement AI-powered workflows across onboarding, coaching, technical learning, and knowledge management to personalize development and accelerate productivity.
  • Partner cross-functionally to embed intelligent guidance into everyday workflows and drive adoption of emerging technologies.
Measure Impact and Drive Continuous Improvement
  • Establish metrics connecting enablement programs to ramp time, role proficiency, quota attainment, win rates, and customer-facing productivity.
  • Leverage performance data, conversation intelligence, and qualitative feedback to identify gaps and continuously improve programs.
  • Own the enablement technology strategy and lead readiness initiatives for key revenue events, including Sales Kickoff and technical bootcamps.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, technical enablement, sales leadership, or related GTM functions at B2B technology companies, including experience building and leading teams.
  • Proven success scaling enablement in high-growth environments, supporting both commercial and technical customer-facing organizations.
  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand complex infrastructure, networking, security, or developer-focused products and translate them into effective learning experiences.
  • Deep expertise in adult learning, instructional design, and competency development, with a track record of driving measurable improvements in performance.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience reinforcing sales methodology, developing customer-facing skills, and improving revenue productivity.
  • An AI-first, systems-oriented mindset, with experience leveraging AI, automation, and scalable processes to improve learning and productivity.
  • A data-driven approach, with demonstrated success measuring enablement effectiveness and connecting programs to business outcomes.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical audiences, advise executives, and drive organizational change.
  • A builder's mentality, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, high ownership, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in product-led growth environments or with developer-focused products.
  • Background in technical presales, Customer Engineering, or quota-carrying sales roles.
  • Experience building technical certification programs or hands-on learning environments.
  • Experience implementing AI-powered coaching, learning, or productivity solutions.
  • Experience supporting both high-velocity commercial and complex enterprise sales motions.

$200,000—$275,000 USD

What We Offer
