About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Director, APAC Go-to-Market to build and lead our GTM business in Asia Pacific, starting from Singapore.

APAC represents an important growth opportunity for Tailscale. We have strong conviction in the region and are looking for a leader who can turn that opportunity into a meaningful, durable business: building pipeline and revenue, developing a strong partner ecosystem, winning strategic customers, and building the team we need to scale.

We are looking for someone who has built a region before and wants to do it again from scratch. You will set the APAC go-to-market strategy, determine where and how we invest, recruit and lead our initial regional team, and be directly accountable for commercial results. You will have significant autonomy to determine what Tailscale needs to win in the region.

You will also be a hands-on commercial leader. You’ll spend time with customers and partners, help shape and close our most important opportunities, and develop a deep understanding of how technology companies need to go to market differently across APAC. You’ll bring those insights back to our global Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams and help Tailscale become a truly global company.

In this role, you will be able to hire the team you need to succeed. We suspect that will include Sales Development, Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, and Partner Marketing, but ultimately we will be open to your recommendation based on expertise. These hires will report directly to you with dotted lines to functional departments in North America and EMEA. You’ll lead that team as a region, while working closely with their functional counterparts elsewhere at Tailscale. This role will report to Tailscale’s President, Kevin Kotecki.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the APAC number. You will be accountable for regional pipeline creation and revenue growth. Establish clear targets, build the plan to reach them, maintain strong forecasting and pipeline discipline, and continuously adjust our approach based on what the data and the market tell us. 
  • Build and execute Tailscale’s APAC go-to-market strategy. Determine which markets, customer segments, use cases, and routes to market offer the greatest opportunity for Tailscale. Translate global company strategy into a focused regional plan while recognizing that what works in North America or Europe will not always work in APAC.
  • Build a high-performing regional GTM organization. Recruit, lead, and develop exceptional sellers and other customer-facing talent in the region. Build a team that operates as one APAC organization while remaining tightly connected to its global functional counterparts. Create the culture, operating rhythms, and accountability required for a small regional team to move quickly and perform at a high level.
  • Lead from the front with customers. Personally engage in Tailscale’s most important opportunities in the region. Build relationships with senior technical and business leaders, help the team navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, and serve as executive sponsor for strategic customers. Stay close enough to the market to know why we are winning, why we are losing, and what needs to change.
  • Build Tailscale’s presence in the region. Establish Tailscale as a credible and increasingly visible technology company in APAC. Represent Tailscale with customers, partners, at industry events, and within the broader technology ecosystem. Develop the relationships and market intelligence that allow us to identify opportunities earlier than we otherwise would.
  • Be the voice of APAC inside Tailscale. Build a strong point of view on regional customers, competitors, partners, buying behavior, and market dynamics. Bring that perspective into company decisions about product, packaging, marketing, partnerships, and future investments. 
  • Build the region for the long term. We expect the shape of our APAC organization to evolve considerably. Identify what capabilities and investments we need next, make thoughtful resource tradeoffs, and build systems that can scale beyond the first phase of the Singapore office.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant experience in enterprise technology go-to-market, with meaningful experience leading Sales or a broader GTM organization across APAC.
  • You have done this before. You have helped build or materially scale an APAC business rather than only operating within an already mature regional organization.
  • A proven track record of owning and exceeding meaningful pipeline and revenue targets in a B2B technology business.
  • Deep familiarity with the APAC technology market and experience operating successfully across multiple countries and cultures, with particularly strong knowledge of Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  • Established relationships within the regional channel and partner ecosystem, along with a track record of turning those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.
  • A strong network of exceptional GTM talent in the region. You know what great sellers and SEs look like and have demonstrated that you can attract them to work with you.
  • Experience leading complex enterprise opportunities personally. You are comfortable moving from regional strategy and forecasting into a customer meeting or deal review and materially improving the outcome.
  • Experience selling highly technical products to sophisticated buyers. Experience with infrastructure, networking, security, developer tools, cloud, or adjacent enterprise technology is particularly relevant.
  • Strong commercial judgment and analytical ability. You understand pipeline mathematics, forecasting, unit economics, market prioritization, and where to invest limited resources to produce the greatest return.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills. You can lead a regional team while partnering effectively with global Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations teams that you do not directly manage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and strong executive presence with customers, partners, candidates, and internal leaders.
  • A builder’s mindset. You are comfortable with ambiguity, limited infrastructure, and changing plans, and you know how to introduce enough process and structure to improve execution without slowing the organization down.
  • High agency and low ego. You are willing to personally do the work required to establish the region while simultaneously building an organization that will eventually make you less central to every decision.

About the role:

We are looking for a self-starting, motivated, and experienced Collections Specialist to support the small business globally. The Collection Analyst oversees the accounts receivable efforts of a global portfolio of monthly receivables and acts as the conduit between the sales team, the customer, and corporate. This opportunity requires a candidate with a high volume accounts-centric mindset, high attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and an enthusiastic attitude. Candidates must have the ability to juggle multiple tasks and priorities, thrive in a highly driven environment, enjoy learning new skills, procedures, and systems, and have an overall desire to contribute to company growth. This position plays an essential role in minimizing our financial loss by implementing receivable and collection procedures that reduce the amount of delinquency encountered and reports to our Sr. Manager, Order to Cash.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services. 

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation.  In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes
  • Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms
  • Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution
  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the team:

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information. 

About the role:

Rubrik is seeking a Senior Commercial Compliance Analyst to lead Commercial Audit and Certification Management. In this role, you will own Rubrik's portfolio of security certifications and coordinated audits end-to-end, from evidence collection through auditor management to final report delivery, ensuring audit readiness is continuous and audit findings are tracked to closure.

What you'll do:

  • Own the audit and certification calendar across Rubrik's active portfolio: SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, CSA STAR Level 1 and Level 2, TISAX Level 1 and Level 2, HITRUST, HIPAA.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, managing scoping, fieldwork, evidence requests, and remediation of findings through to closure.
  • Maintain the mapping between compliance controls and underlying evidence sources so audit readiness is continuous rather than a point-in-time scramble.
  • Drive coordinated audit strategy, consolidating overlapping evidence requests across frameworks to reduce duplicate work for control owners.
  • Lead evaluation and scoping of emerging and planned certifications to support Rubrik's international and AI governance expansion.
  • Manage the lifecycle of certifications end-to-end, including retirements and transitions
  • Track and report audit status, findings, and remediation progress to leadership, using the team's Jira-based tracking dashboards.
  • Partner with control owners across InfoSec, IT, Legal, and Engineering to gather evidence and close audit findings on schedule.
  • Collaborate with Risk Management to ensure audit findings feed into the broader risk register and remediation lifecycle (RMLC).
  • Support Customer Trust Enablement by ensuring audit and certification outputs are readily usable to answer customer security inquiries.
  • Leverage AI and automation to streamline evidence gathering, control testing, and audit workflows.

Experience you'll need:

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, audit management, or GRC
  • Hands-on experience managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 audits, plus at least one additional framework
  • Experience working directly with external auditors and certification bodies, including scoping and negotiating audit timelines.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit cycles.
  • Familiarity with GRC tooling and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) for tracking evidence and remediation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Knowledge of regulatory and contractual compliance requirements relevant to enterprise SaaS/security vendors.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Senior Value Engineer 

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the public sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English [and native-level local language] communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of Financial processes in the public sector domain. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor
  • Must possess an active Security Clearance - Secret or Top Secret is preferred 

         Sponsorship is not offered for this role

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This individual will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling the core applications and services that power our platform. The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineer looking to build 0 to 1. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare. As a senior member of the team, you'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions while helping shape technical standards and best practices across the organization.

This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Skills
    • Writes correct and consistent code using both knowledge and expertise (backend, frontend, and devops).
    • Develops and maintains full-stack web applications using React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend.
    • Designs, builds, and integrates APIs and backend services to support product functionality and system integrations.
    • Reviews code efficiently and give feedback on it.
    • Understands industry standards and consistently keeps informed of upcoming trends.
  • Communication and Leadership
    • Communicates and justifies technical decisions via design docs, tech talks and documentation.
    • Mentors Junior Engineers via Pairing, Feedback, PR Review and 1:1's.
    • Communicates effectively cross-functionally to the Product team, his manager, and business if needed.
    • Proactively identifies problems with requirements for and his own projects and the engineers they support and communicates it to stakeholders.
  • Project Management
    • Delivers complex product to QA that is fully developed and bug-free.
    • Takes initiative to fix bugs, open tickets and improve code when needed
    • Persistent in the face of roadblocks, knows when to pull others to solve the problem if needed.
  • Impact
    • End-to-end responsibility for getting production-ready features to the finish line.
    • Identifies problems and potential risks in his code and others.
    • Helps keep consistency and quality in the code base with PR overview and feedback.
    • Helps enforce proper QA for all products that he is involved in.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You 

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering or Math.
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software
  • 5+ years of professional experience working in both react and node.js

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount! 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $146,000 - $180,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications. 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace, a UHS company, is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AI Experience (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. AI Experiences builds the orchestration for Smart Assist and the user-facing implementations that expose Smartsheet's Intelligent Work capabilities to any AI surface, so users can reach the right intelligence at the right time through a coherent, reliable experience.

AI Experiences is a pillar within Applied AI, and this is a full-stack team. The work spans these areas: the Smart Assist frontend (UI components, interaction patterns, and rendering for AI experiences across Smartsheet); the Smart Assist backend and orchestrator; UX for Smart Assist tools and agents, from response formatting and onboarding to error states. On the backend, the orchestrator routes each request to the right sub-agent based on user intent, keeps conversation state across multi-turn interactions, handles fallbacks when sub-agents are unavailable, and controls feature-flagged rollout of new capabilities. We partner closely with Agent Engineering on much of this logic.

The role. You will own features and components of Smart Assist from prototype to production, across the front end, the orchestrator and back-end services. You will turn ambiguous product asks into reliable, well-measured behavior customers can trust, and work with product, design, and AI Experience to ship.

You Will:

  • Own a core piece of the Smartsheet AI experience, or a significant part of one (for example conversational analytics, chart-to-dashboard creation, or a new entry point into the assistant) from design through production.
  • Build full-stack: user-facing components, the services behind them, and the contracts between the two, with typed APIs, clear error states, and tests.
  • Design and ship agent tools, skills, MCP tools, and MCP Apps with contracts the model can use reliably, and decide when an action belongs in a tool, a service, or the model.
  • Shape how agent output appears to users: streaming responses, loading and failure states, and handling of long or partial results, working with design and product.
  • Build and evolve the Smart Assist orchestrator: intent-based routing to sub-agents, multi-turn conversation state, fallback and degradation handling, and feature-flag rollout of new capabilities, partnering closely with Agent Engineering. Populate the context the agent receives, such as user locale, timezone, and workspace state.
  • Define how quality is measured for your area: build golden cases and scorers, set regression gates, and use traces and production signals to decide whether a failure needs a prompt, tool, context, or UI fix.
  • Instrument features with tracing, structured logs, and latency, cost, and error dashboards, and act on what they show.
  • Take part in on-call, security, and cost work for Smart Assist, shared with Agent Engineering. Reproduce production failures and review code for your team.
  • Partner with PMs, designers, Agent Engineering, AI Platform, MCP, and data teams. Learn how customers use what you build and flag gaps in requirements and tests.
  • Use AI coding tools to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

What we're building next:

Our goal for the coming year is to make Smart Assist safe to trust and hard to leave. You will help shape work across four themes:

  • Be everywhere: an assistant that understands what you are looking at, such as the rows you have selected, and meets you in the flow of work, including smoother import and file upload.
  • Build the habit: an assistant that remembers how you like to work, with personal, team, and organization profiles, quick commands, and a growing UI component catalog.
  • Earn the trust: previews before changes apply, linked sources and explanations for results, AI edits visible in history and activity logs, and a view into the agent's reasoning.
  • Work together: a directory of agents, @mentions, and the ability to save and share results as pages.

Further out, the vision is a Smart Assist that finds you before you ask: a proactive, insight-first surface that learns how your workspace works, suggests prompts personalized to you, brings in context from tools like Slack, Zoom, and documents, supports multiplayer conversations, and offers help inside the chat itself. You would help define the trust model for that experience from real customer learnings and feedback.

You Have:

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering shipping production systems.
  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/React, with good habits in testing, code review, and debugging.
  • Experience building and shipping customer-facing features end to end, including APIs, data modeling, and user-facing behavior.
  • 1+ years building LLM-powered features in production: tool or function calling, agent loops, prompt and context design, or multi-step workflows.
  • Working knowledge of how agents fail (bad tool choice, context overflow, hallucinated arguments, runaway cost) and how to design around it.
  • Experience designing eval scorers and golden datasets, and using results to make and defend a decision.
  • Experience with MCP tools and MCP Apps, structured tool calling, or reusable agent skills.
  • Comfort with production observability and with data-heavy environments (Databricks or equivalent).
  • Evidence of using AI coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.
  • Clear communication of quality, cost, and reliability findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

Strong plus:

Experience with conversational or chat UI at scale; LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Phoenix, Braintrust or similar); prompt versioning or CI-integrated evals; dashboard, charting, or data-visualization products; enterprise SaaS permissions and entitlements; prompt-injection mitigation and output validation.

What success looks like:

  • First 90 days: ship a feature or improvement to production with eval coverage, and take your first on-call rotation.
  • First 6 months: own a feature or significant part of a project with measured gains in task success, latency, or user adoption, and contribute at least one reusable component or pattern.

Why this role:

  • You build the Smart Assist experience used by enterprise customers, with real users and a measurable quality bar.
  • You work across the stack, from the interface to the agent tools behind it, so you see your work reach customers end to end.
  • The problems are distinctive: enterprise-grade permissions and security, and one assistant that works across a broad work-management product.
  • You work on the hard parts of production agents, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$125,000—$175,000 USD

 

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. 

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.title: MLRO, Indonesia
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Indonesia (Remote)


Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.
Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development & Management

  • Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
  • Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
  • Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.
  • Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.
  • Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.
  • Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
  • Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT & MLRO Duties

  • Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
  • Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.
  • Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.
  • Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
  • Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance & Culture

  • Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
  • Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
  • Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
  • Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
  • Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting & Recordkeeping

  • Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
  • Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.
  • Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
    • Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

    Experience

    • Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.
    • Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.
    • Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.
    • Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
    • Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
    • Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

    Knowledge & Skills

    • Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
    • Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
    • Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
    • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
    • Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
    • High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.
 

Nice to Haves

    • Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.
    • Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
    • Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
    • Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
    • In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.
 

Additional Notes

This role will be subject to fit and proper assessment as part of the licensing process. Candidates must be prepared to undergo background checks, provide regulatory questionnaires, CVs, references, and proof of relevant qualifications. Prior enforcement history, regulatory sanctions, or unexplained gaps in professional record may affect eligibility.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company event
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager | Referral Program and Client Management
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to join our BASE Focus Area in the Marketplace Management Systems team, to work in Brazil.

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area is responsible for core platform capabilities that enable and evolve Wellhub’s business model, supporting both our current business and future growth opportunities.

In this role, you will lead key product initiatives across two strategic areas: Referral Program and Client Management. You will help evolve our referral program as a scalable growth channel, creating experiences that drive acquisition and engagement, while also building and improving the capabilities that enable a sustainable marketplace.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, design, engineering, operations, business stakeholders, and other product teams to deliver high-quality products that meet both Wellhub's goals and clients' needs.

If you are passionate about building products that make a difference in people’s lives and are excited about the opportunity to join a team that is directly connected to Wellhub's most important goals, to grow in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the development of tools aimed at simplifying and optimizing the way Wellhub offers its services to the market, sustainably increasing value to thousands of clients, millions of users, and partners around the world;
  • Lead the product requirements definition, actively collaborating with various cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions;
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by constantly evaluating and refining current products, processes, tools, and methodologies;
  • Lead the creation and execution of the product roadmap, aligning with business objectives and customer needs. Prioritize initiatives and maintain focus on high-impact features;
  • Utilize analytics and research to measure product success, identify growth opportunities, and iterate on product features. Develop KPIs to track and measure product performance.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A true team player used to build great products in close collaboration with engineering, design, and business team;
  • Enthusiastic about developing global products with global teams;
  • Clear product vision and strategy that aligns with business goals;
  • Be able to balance long-term strategic goals with the ability to execute on short-term priorities. This includes understanding how each product feature or iteration fits into the broader Wellhub's vision;
  • Entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Data-driven mindset with analytical skills and experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Metabase);
  • Familiarity with Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and the ability to run sprints, manage backlogs, and work iteratively is critical;
  • Experience with the entire product lifecycle— from ideation, MVP (minimum viable product) development, testing, and iteration, to launch and post-launch optimization;
  • AI-enabled mindset: You actively leverage AI in your day-to-day work to enhance;
  • Has strong written and spoken advanced English skills for day-to-day business communication.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Product Management and Product Lifecycle are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

Wellhub runs at high scale, on many Kubernetes clusters. Our engineers need logs, metrics, traces and profiles they can trust, at a cost the business can sustain. We build and run this platform ourselves, on open source standards. Your mission is to make it a product that engineers choose to use, and not a set of dashboards they must ask for.

What you will work on:

  • Observability as a Service. A self-service platform that balances performance and cost. Hard problems: high-cardinality metrics, log retention, distributed tracing, profiling.
  • Golden Paths. Defaults that let a developer instrument code in minutes and get good signals without operating anything.
  • The platform itself. Collection, storage, query and alerting that stay reliable when the company grows. We also watch the watchers: the platform must tell us when it is broken.

Our stack includes Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Crossplane and HashiCorp Vault. You will write code in Go, Ruby or Python to build our tools.

jobs.title: Director of Brand Strategy
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

The team have been busy building an ownable and distinctive brand platform. This role is about what comes next - the second album. You’ll partner with our Chief Creative & Brand Officer to set the brand strategy for the coming year and the brand horizon for the next three to five, built on a real understanding of how our customers’ lives are changing rather than a deck full of numbers.

You’ll also be the person who turns messy inputs into a problem worth solving. Requests reach our creative team from markets and teams across the business, each with different goals and levels of detail. It can take our creative team hours to shape them into clear briefs before they can start. You’ll define what great briefing looks like here, help the business work out which work is genuinely worth making and give creative teams a sharp starting point every time.

It’s a role with real room to shape things. We’re a business that has grown quickly and now spans four markets, and the joins between global brand thinking and local market plans are still being drawn. You get to draw a lot of them.

This role is fully remote but must be based in our Australian Hub.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Sprinting on our brand positioning with the Chief Creative & Brand Officer - and telling us which bits of it don’t hold up yet.
  • Sitting with our Consumer Insights lead to work out how our customers’ lives at home are likely to change over the next three to five years, and what that means for the brand.
  • Taking a brief for one of our biggest campaigns and rewriting it into something a creative team can run at.
  • Meeting brand leads and general managers across Australia, the UK, the US and Canada to find out what’s in their plans, and where a single brand approach would make everyone’s life easier.
  • Shaping a set of small, bold experiments to test what “a brand that punches above its weight” really means for us.
  • Acting as a thought partner on our social and content strategy so it pulls in the same direction as the long-term brand strategy.

Let’s talk about you

You get a kick out of making messy things simple.

You’ve been handed the ten-page document with no question in it, and you enjoyed finding the question. The craft you’re proudest of is probably a short, sharp brief rather than a long, clever deck – because you know the brief is where great work either becomes possible or quietly doesn’t. Most people who thrive here have come from an agency planning background, though we’re not precious about it if you’ve built this muscle somewhere else.

You think in years, not weeks.

At least half your time in this role should be spent on what’s coming, not on fixing what’s already landed. You’re genuinely curious about customers and culture, you can point to brand bets you made a few years ago and say honestly which ones played out, and you can hold a three to five year view and this quarter’s campaign in your head at the same time.

You’re deeply collaborative, and you’ll still tell us we’re wrong.

You listen properly, you build relationships across time zones without being asked to, and you notice when a market has gone quiet. You’re also the person who says “hang on, how does this connect to the five-year plan?” when the room is getting carried away. That healthy tension is the job, not a side effect of it – and you can bring the commercial argument that makes the challenge land.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Applications will close on Friday 11th December.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, CEE
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

About the role

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build and grow Horizon3’s enterprise business in CEE, with a focus on Poland. You’ll own a defined territory, develop new customer relationships, and lead complex sales cycles with large organizations and multiple stakeholders.

This is a hands-on territory-building role. You’ll create pipeline, develop executive and partner relationships, and work closely with Sales Engineering, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams to help customers understand the value of autonomous security testing. You’ll be accountable for your territory plan, forecast, and sales results.

What you’ll do

  • Build and execute a territory plan for Poland, prioritizing target accounts, whitespace, pipeline creation, and partner coverage.

  • Create new opportunities through proactive prospecting, customer engagement, and partner collaboration.

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles from discovery and qualification through solution alignment, proof of value, negotiation, and close.

  • Map and engage complex buying groups, including security and IT leaders, executive sponsors, procurement, and other decision-makers.

  • Develop account strategies that connect customer priorities to the business value of the NodeZero platform.

  • Coordinate Sales Engineers, Channel partners, Customer Success, Product, Legal, Deal Desk, and leadership around clear deal plans and customer outcomes.

  • Build productive relationships with resellers, MSSPs, systems integrators, and other relevant partners in Poland; develop joint opportunities and market coverage.

  • Maintain a reliable pipeline and forecast in Salesforce, with clear next steps, close dates, risks, and dependencies.

  • Bring customer, competitive, and market feedback to the broader business to strengthen our regional go-to-market approach.

  • Represent Horizon3 professionally with customers and partners, in person and virtually.

What you’ll bring

  • A track record of success in enterprise technology sales, including ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities and a full sales cycle.

  • Typically 5+ years of professional experience in IT or SaaS sales; cybersecurity experience is strongly preferred. Direct cybersecurity sales experience is a strong advantage.

  • Evidence of achieving or exceeding quota and building a healthy pipeline in a defined territory.

  • Experience introducing new or disruptive software solutions and communicating business value to both technical and executive audiences.

  • Experience developing channel relationships and working effectively with resellers, MSSPs, or systems integrators.

  • Strong discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, and forecasting skills; familiarity with MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or a comparable sales methodology.

  • Confidence leading proof-of-value processes and connecting technical outcomes to customer impact and return on investment.

  • Strong business acumen, sound commercial judgment, and a clear sense of ownership and follow-through.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating across a distributed, cross-functional team.

  • Fluency in Polish and excellent English communication skills.

  • A college degree or equivalent practical experience.

How we work

Horizon3 is a remote company. You’ll work closely with a distributed EMEA team and stay connected to customers, partners, and market activity in Poland. Travel within the assigned territory may be required to build relationships and move opportunities forward; travel plans and expenses are coordinated with your manager.Compensation and benefits

We offer competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills. The applicable Poland compensation range and benefits will be confirmed for this role.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Our InfoSec team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead how we defend Paddle in a rapidly changing threat landscape. AI is changing both sides of security. Attackers are using it to scale social engineering, find weaknesses faster and automate intrusion, while our own adoption of AI tools and agents creates new risks to manage. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an experienced security generalist who wants to build our defences against these threats, and to use automation and AI to make our detection and response faster and more effective. You’ll be a senior technical leader across InfoSec and IT, working across both our Enterprise IT and Product environments, and helping our global team of Paddlers operate securely without slowing them down.

What you’ll do

  • Lead our incident response capability, from playbooks and readiness exercises to acting as senior technical lead during security incidents.

  • Improve our security operations, strengthening detection coverage, alert quality and triage, and turning manual operational work into engineered, repeatable processes.

  • Build and evolve our defences against AI-enabled threats, including AI-driven phishing, impersonation and deepfakes, and accelerated vulnerability exploitation.

  • Help Paddle grow our adoption of AI securely by designing guardrails, access models and monitoring for AI tools and agents, including the non-human identities and integrations they rely on.

  • Use automation and AI to speed up detection, investigation and response, so the team can handle a growing threat volume without growing headcount at the same rate.

  • Contribute to the secure configuration, posture management and monitoring of our AWS cloud infrastructure, working with the Platform team so security initiatives are delivered in a scalable and reliable manner.

  • Strengthen identity and access security as capabilities evolve, including our approach to MFA, device trust and conditional access.

  • Support GRC initiatives on technical control implementation and audit evidence automation, in line with SOC 2, PCI DSS and CIS Benchmarks.

  • Partner with InfoSec, IT and Engineering leadership to set technical direction and deliver the department’s key security programmes, making design decisions and driving work across multiple business functions.

  • Mentor and support other engineers across InfoSec, IT and the wider Engineering function, building a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Have extensive experience as a security engineer or in a similar role, with breadth across incident response, security operations, security engineering and cloud security, and a strong track record of hands-on delivery.

  • Have led or played a senior role in responding to real security incidents, from investigation and containment through to recovery and lessons learned.

  • Bring strong cloud security expertise, including identity, resource configuration, logging and monitoring. Hands-on experience securing AWS, including containerised workloads and cloud-native deployments, is highly desirable.

  • Have experience with detection and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR and cloud security posture management platforms, and know how to make them effective rather than noisy.

  • Understand how AI is changing the threat landscape, and are excited about using automation and AI to improve how security teams detect, investigate and respond.

  • Are familiar with modern identity, device management and endpoint security solutions (e.g. Okta, Iru, Island, SentinelOne), as well as collaboration and networking tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Slack, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

  • Can script or program to automate workflows and integrate systems. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) is desirable.

  • Have experience implementing technical controls against frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS or CIS Benchmarks (nice to have).

  • Are comfortable operating autonomously on high-impact, wide-reaching work, and working collaboratively across multiple business functions.

  • Can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing at all levels of the business, including during high-pressure incidents.

  • Are passionate about security and want to make a real impact at scale.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before.

As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings.

This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle.

What you'll do:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us.

  • Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts.

  • Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.).

  • Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

  • Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand.

  • Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance.

  • Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets.

  • Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone.

  • Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results.

  • Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different.

  • Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets.

  • See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value.

  • Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity.

  • Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity.

  • Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft.

  • Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social.

  • Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)
