jobs.title: Senior Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Senior Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our highest-value employer accounts. In this role, you will manage relationships with large employer clients introduced through Maven’s health plan channel partnerships, working in close coordination with the health plan team who co-owns the broader strategic relationship. 

The Senior Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for some of our larger accounts - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.  You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role — it’s a commercial leadership position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen.

As Senior Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:

  • Own the net revenue retention outcome for your portfolio of large employer clients with direct accountability for renewal rates, expansion pipeline, and risk mitigation Build and maintain strategic account plans, including expansion opportunities, competitive threats (e.g., vendor consolidation, competitor displacement), and renewal milestones
  • Forecast renewal health on a defined cadence, proactively monitor client risk on an ongoing basis and establish documented risk mitigation plans as needed, flagging risk  and develop Client Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) by surfacing expansion signals — new populations, benefit line additions, geographic growth — and building the internal business case before handing to Sales
  • Partner with Renewals and Sales as the account quarterback: own the quality and completeness of every commercial handoff, ensuring these teams inherit a fully developed narrative with quantified ROI, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to close
  • Own member enrollment and engagement campaigns that deliver measurable client business outcomes, developed in coordination with health plan partners and executed in adherence to channel-specific communication protocols and payer approval requirements.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews and data-driven business cases that translate Maven's clinical outcomes and member engagement into quantifiable ROI, tailoring messaging by stakeholder persona — cost containment and claims data for CFOs, utilization and engagement for Benefits leaders, retention and attraction narratives for CHROs
  • Proactively consult clients on program optimization and strategies to better support family building and their working parents, leveraging Maven’s industry expertise, benchmark data, and clinical outcomes to continuously demonstrate measurable business impact
  • Maintain high level of client engagement, satisfaction and loyalty, as measured by high client satisfaction scores and revenue retention
  • Partner with health plan Account Executives to align on strategy, enrollment goals, and renewal timing while maintaining Maven’s distinct presence and value proposition within the partnership.
  • Collaborate with client leadership, broker and consultant partners, and other internal and external stakeholders to unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio
  • Serve as the primary cross-functional point of contact — leading initiatives with Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to deliver exceptional client outcomes, and managing escalations in partnership with Member Support, Operations, Analytics, and Sales — with ownership of project timelines and accountability for deliverables
  • Convert clients into Maven advocates, leveraging their successes for references, case studies, blogs, etc.
  • Provide strategic analysis of member engagement performance and program metrics
  • Own communications to meet mutually agreed upon goals including but not limited to quarterly business reviews, external client meetings/events and other project plans
  • Serve as the voice of the client internally by bringing insights to enhance product development and program marketing efforts
  • Identify and address root causes of challenges, recommending scalable improvements to processes and systems to enhance client outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted decision-maker, balancing multiple perspectives and ensuring alignment with company priorities to drive key decisions forward.

We’re looking for you to bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services role in digital health, healthcare company, benefits or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes (client retention, expansion, NRR), and a deep understanding of the employee benefits and healthcare landscape.
  • Demonstrate a proactive approach to adopting AI tools and technology, applying them to streamline workflows, generate insights, and elevate the client experience — with a mindset of continuous learning as the landscape evolves.
  • Experience working with large employer clients (10,000+ employees) is required
  • Experience working within or alongside channel partner or payer-distributed model is preferred. 
  • Proven track record of positioning and executing marketing strategies that drive enrollment to drive to measurable client business outcomes
  • Passion for healthcare and influencing organizational change
  • Serve as a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, collaborating to deliver a seamless experience for Maven clients and partners, translating insights into product, process, and market improvements.  Demonstrated history of contributing directly to net revenue retention through proactive renewal management, risk mitigation, and expansion pipeline development 
  • Proven ability to broaden and deepen multi-threaded executive relationships (VP, CHRO, CFO, Benefits leaders, consultants), within client relationship, specific experience managing the relationships across both the individual employer group and health plan/channel partner stakeholder simultaneously. 
  • Track record of partnering with Sales and/or Renewals teams to progress commercial opportunities, including developing CSQLs and building business cases for expansion
  • Strong interpersonal and verbal, written, and presentation skills, ability to communicate clearly and persuade, and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while holding yourself and others accountable for deadlines and deliverables
  • Possess analytical skills and strategic thinking- you’re strong on both IQ and EQ, with the ability to translate data, client performance into market insights and action planning in partnership with clients.
  • Experience in working with the full lifecycle of customer success post sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management)
  • Willingness to travel 25-30% of the time for key client meetings and participate occasionally in our NYC office for relationship building and key meetings (quarterly basis)
  • Comfort operating in high-growth environments with evolving processes — you build the plane while flying it and see ambiguity as opportunity, not friction

Helpful experiences and skills (if you don’t have them, you can learn them with us!):

  • Experience at a digital health company in the health, wellness, or family health space is preferred
  • Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients is a bonus
  • Salesforce, Looker and/or Microsoft suite experience

The base salary range for this role is $128,000 - 145,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and  Seattle, WA. This role is exclusively open to candidates in these locations. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. 

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

#LI-NS1

As members of 6sense’s Security department, the Security Engineering team protects the platform. Application Security Engineers work closely with engineering teams, product managers (PM), and third-party entities to ensure that 6sense SaaS products are secure.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote, EMEA - Remote

Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About MetaMask & Trade

MetaMask is a self-custodial wallet used by tens of millions of people. In Trade, people swap, bridge, trade perps, predict and earn. Core UX is the part of MetaMask mobile that sit inside: Home, the navigation, balances, tokens and positions, and the path from the first screen into each of them.

People open the app and land on Home. If that screen is slow, crowded, or unclear about what to do next, Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn see fewer of the people who opened the app. The surface is live. You start from the app people already have, and you keep shipping on it.

The role is Staff Product Manager, Core UX. You write the vision for Home and the navigation, and you run the build with design and engineering. A design background is a requirement, because the work is the screen itself.

The Role

You are the product manager for Core UX on MetaMask mobile. You own the vision, the roadmap and the backlog for Home and the navigation, and you own whether that screen is working.

You will work closely with:

  • The Core UX engineering team
  • Design
  • Data and analytics
  • The product managers for Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn

Those products show up on Home. You own how a person reaches them from there, and how their balances and positions show up. Their roadmaps stay with their product managers. Yours is Home and the navigation.

The app is already live and people open it every day, so you start from what is there. You walk design leadership through the screen, and you are in the reviews where the layout gets decided.

What You'll Do

Set the Core UX vision

Write what Home is for, who has to succeed on it, and what it shows before anyone taps. Getting back to an open position has to be fast for people who already trade here. A first install still has to reach one real action in that same session.

Write down where a MetaMask person would already know what to tap, and where one of those apps does something we should study. Then write the roadmap, with the tradeoffs and the order, and what each step changes on Home.

Own Home, the navigation and the defaults

Own what a person sees when they open the app. That is balances, tokens and positions, and the way into Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn. A balance, a token, a position and an entry point are different, and Home has to show each one in a place the person can find.

Decide what Home shows before anyone taps. Anything past that waits until the person opens it. Put Swap, Perps and Predict close together for people who use more than one of them. A person using only one of those products still has to be able to finish their action.

Search and any assistance that sits on Home are part of this surface. You specify what stays on the screen, and what the person still confirms before money moves.

Get people to a first action, and get them to come back

You own the first session and the return after it. Count how many new wallets take a real action, and how many of those people open the app again. Define the path from the open to a confirmed action, and instrument it.

Review screens with design

You have a design background, and the role uses it. You review screens for hierarchy, type, spacing and what a tap does. You mark up a screen and say what should change, in writing, so design and engineering can build from the note.

You write the product point of view clearly enough that design and engineering can build it. You are in the design reviews. A crowded screen, or a tap that does the wrong thing, gets the specific change you want.

Work with the products that live on Home

Each MetaMask trade primitive already has their own product manager. You own the entry from Home and the way their positions and balances read there. When a change to Home helps one product and hurts another, you name the tradeoff in the spec.

You coordinate the sequencing when a Home change depends on one of those teams, or when one of their launches depends on Home. The spec says what Home will show on the day their change ships.

Run the work

You take a problem through spec, design, build, test and launch, and then you read what happened. You run planning and the backlog with the Core UX engineering team.

A feature is done when the edge cases are handled, the screen is fast enough to use, and we can see the result in the data. That includes an empty Home, a person who uses one product, and a person who uses several.

When something breaks, you write down what happened and what we will change in the screen or in the process, so the same break has a fix.

Who You Are

You have owned the main screen of a consumer product people open every day, and you stayed on it through launch. You can set a direction for that screen and stay with the tickets until it ships.

You:

  • Mark up a screen and say what the tap should do.
  • Know which KPI a given screen is supposed to impact, and tell a real move from noise.
  • Write a short spec that engineering and design can build, and use that same note when you walk a director through the decision.
  • Sit with someone who already uses the app and someone who just installed, and turn what they do into the next change on Home.
  • Work on a live product, where the screen is already open and the next change has to ship on top of it.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

UpGuard has an early presence in Japan, built through a channel partnership and a growing base of enterprise customers. Until now, our APAC team has supported the market from outside the country.

We are hiring our first Japan-based leader to own the market and scale it. You will carry the ARR target for Japan and be accountable for growth across new business, expansion and renewals. You will also have the agency to decide how we get there. Our go-to-market in Japan will be primarily channel-led for the next two years, and over time you will build our local direct sales and marketing team.

You start with an established channel partner, existing enterprise customers and full ownership of how we win in Japan.

What will you do?

As Country Manager, Japan, you will be UpGuard's senior leader in market, reporting to the Head of Sales, APAC. You'll have support from our APAC sales, partnerships, product and marketing teams. You can work remotely or from our channel partner's Tokyo office.

Specifically, you will:

Own UpGuard's ARR target for Japan and set your own plan to hit it, including partner mix, segment focus and where to invest your time

Manage and grow our channel through joint account planning, enablement of partner sales and technical teams, and joint pipeline reviews

Develop our partner ecosystem in Japan as needed to reach our ARR targets

Support the full customer lifecycle for Japan accounts, from new logo through onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion across group entities and products

Run direct opportunities where they arise

Work alongside partners in the field, joining meetings with CISOs, risk and procurement teams and helping move deals to close

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

UpGuard has recently replatformed its analytics stack onto a greenfield foundation built on BigQuery, dbt, infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, CI/CD through GitHub, and a governed semantic layer that both people and AI agents query. We are seeking an experienced data engineer to help take that platform to the next level.

Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this role is the strong technical lead within the data engineering team. You will work under the Director's guidance to evolve the platform and raise its engineering standards, and you will set the example for how the team builds, reviews and ships.

The platform has a broad contributor and consumer base. Analysts, data scientists and business teams build on it, query it and increasingly reach it through AI agents. Keeping those stakeholders well served and satisfied is a central measure of success in this role.

What will you do?

  • Technical Leadership: Act as the senior technical voice within the data engineering team by guiding design decisions, reviewing code, mentoring engineers and contributing to the platform roadmap set by the team.

  • Platform Evolution: Help take UpGuard's recently built GCP data platform to its next stage, proposing and delivering improvements to scale, reliability, performance, cost and AI workflows.

  • Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Raise engineering standards across the platform, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, PR checks, BI model validation and developer environments that keep changes safe to ship.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Satisfaction: Treat the analysts, data scientists, and business teams who depend on the platform as customers. Understand their needs, scope and prioritise requests with them, set clear expectations, follow through on commitments, and track how well the platform serves them.

  • Contributor Enablement: Support the growing group of analysts, data scientists and business users who contribute dbt code, through onboarding, documentation, AI agents, review practices and developer tooling that make good contributions the easy path.

  • Data Integration: Design, build and maintain reliable pipelines that bring data from internal systems (CRM, billing, support, marketing automation and product events) and third-party sources into BigQuery using managed connectors, event streams and vendor APIs, and write data back to operational systems where needed.

  • Platform Operations & Maintenance: Manage infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, run containerised workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, maintain build scheduling and deployment pipelines, and keep the platform monitored, patched and well documented.

  • dbt Development: Author and review dbt models across the staging, source-level and business-level layers, and uphold the team's conventions for modelling, grain testing and documentation.

  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data tests, source freshness checks, observability and alerting, and take part in incident response so that problems are caught and fixed before stakeholders find them.

  • Data Governance & Privacy: Implement access controls as code, process access requests, and apply data classification, PII masking, audit logging and data subject request handling in line with the team's governance policies.

  • AI Enablement & Conversational Analytics: Build and operate the data, semantic layer and tooling that power conversational analytics and AI agents, including MCP access, context and evaluation that let LLMs query structured and unstructured business data accurately and safely.

What will you bring?

  • Proven Experience: 5+ years in data engineering, including significant hands-on work on a production cloud data platform.

  • Technical Leadership: Experience as a tech lead or senior engineer guiding the work of others through design review, code review and mentoring.

  • AI Fluency: Fluency using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, review and documentation.

  • Stakeholder & Consulting Skills: A track record of engaging stakeholders, scoping ambiguous requests, managing expectations and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • dbt Expertise: Very strong, hands-on dbt development covering modular modelling, testing, macros, packages, snapshots, documentation and performance tuning at scale. Experience with a semantic layer such as MetricFlow, Omni’s YAML or LookML is valued.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing cloud infrastructure with OpenTofu, CDK or Terraform.

  • Containers & Orchestration: Confidence running workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, ideally GKE.

  • Experience with Dimensional Data Modeling techniques and complexities

  • Data Integration: Experience with managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Airbyte, event pipelines such as Segment or Pub/Sub, and REST APIs.

  • Data Quality & Governance: Practical experience implementing data testing, observability tooling such as Elementary, access controls and data masking.

  • BigQuery: Deep working knowledge of BigQuery, including partitioning, clustering, cost and quota management, IAM and complex SQL.

  • Proven ability to implement PII detection, masking, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated data lifecycle policies in modern cloud data platforms.

What will give you an edge?

  • Conversational Analytics & AI Management: Experience building or operating conversational analytics, MCP servers, retrieval or tool-calling layers for LLM agents, or evaluation frameworks that measure the accuracy of AI answers on business data.

  • B2B SaaS Experience: Experience working within a software organisation, ideally a B2B SaaS business, and familiarity with metrics such as ARR, NRR/GRR, pipeline and churn.

  • CRM Systems: A firm understanding of CRM data models such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including deals, pipelines, lifecycle stages and property history, and how that data flows into analytics.

  • Modern BI: Familiarity with Looker, Omni or a comparable modern BI tool, and an understanding of how semantic models and BI layers consume warehouse data.

  • Data governance experience in heavily regulated industries or access control around highly sensitive data

  • Hands-on experience designing data architectures compliant with GDPR, the Australian Privacy Act, or similar global privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA/CPRA).

jobs.title: Workforce Management - Real Time Analyst
jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

📍 Remote Global - APAC

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.

The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.

Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

  • Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

  • Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

  • Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

  • Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

  • Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

  • Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

  • Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

  • Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

  • You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

  • Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

  • Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

  • Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.

Hiring Process

  • Application

  • Case Study

  • Interview with Central WFM - RTA Team Lead

  • Interview with Queue Operations Manager - Core Services

  • Interview with Head of Core Services

  • Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

jobs.title: Tech Support Specialist I (Spanish Bilingual)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Department Description

Service Operations is a core function within Palmetto’s Service and Asset Management organization, responsible for post-PTO service and maintenance across the residential solar asset lifecycle. The team ensures system performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction by managing service requests from intake through resolution. This includes remote troubleshooting, site visit coordination, and field execution through both in-house technicians and a national network of service partners.

Service Operations plays a critical role in protecting asset performance and optimizing the cost of service at scale. Our focus is to resolve issues quickly, efficiently, and with high quality—balancing speed, cost, and customer satisfaction while supporting the long-term performance of the assets we manage.

Location

This position will be based remotely in the Philippines.

Summary of Role

The Tech Support Specialist I is responsible for monitoring system performance and resolving service issues through remote troubleshooting across Palmetto’s residential solar portfolio.

This role is the first line of defense in identifying and addressing system underperformance, using monitoring tools, diagnostics, and customer interaction to resolve issues without requiring a site visit whenever possible.

Tech Support Specialists are accountable for quickly identifying root causes, executing effective troubleshooting steps, and determining when escalation to a site visit is necessary. They play a critical role in optimizing service timelines, reducing cost of service, and ensuring a seamless customer experience.

Strategic & Tactical

  • Monitor system performance across the residential solar portfolio, proactively identifying underperforming or non-producing systems through alerting and diagnostic tools.
  • Triage and investigate service cases, validating issues and determining appropriate troubleshooting paths based on system data and known failure modes.
  • Execute remote troubleshooting steps to resolve system issues, including inverter resets, communication troubleshooting, and guiding homeowners through required actions.
  • Maximize remote resolution by identifying and applying effective solutions, minimizing unnecessary site visits.
  • Communicate clearly and empathetically with homeowners to explain issues, guide troubleshooting steps, and set expectations for resolution.
  • Accurately document all troubleshooting steps, findings, and outcomes within Salesforce to ensure clear case history and enable downstream coordination if needed.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Service Project Coordinators with clear, complete context, including validated scope and recommended next steps.
  • Manage and prioritize service queues to ensure all cases are addressed within defined SLA timelines.
  • Identify trends, recurring issues, and failure patterns across the portfolio, contributing insights to improve monitoring, processes, and product performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Service Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to improve alert quality, reduce false positives, and enhance troubleshooting workflows.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives to increase remote resolution rates and reduce overall service cost.

Qualifications

  • BS/BA is preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, customer support, or operations in a high-volume environment.
  • Spanish proficiency is required.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues using data and structured thinking.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate monitoring platforms, CRM systems, and technical tools (Salesforce experience preferred).
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Attention to detail in documenting cases, troubleshooting steps, and outcomes.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously while maintaining SLA performance.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience in residential solar, electrical systems, or field service environments is preferred.
  • Familiarity with OEM monitoring platforms (e.g., Enphase, SolarEdge) is preferred.

Success Defined

Success in this role is measured by the ability to resolve issues quickly and accurately through remote troubleshooting, while ensuring high-quality case handling and seamless escalation when required.

  • Remote Resolution Rate & Timeline
    Achieve target remote resolution rate while maintaining a fast median time to resolution, minimizing the need for site visits and reducing overall service timelines.
  • Troubleshooting Quality & Escalation Accuracy
    Consistently identify root causes and execute effective troubleshooting steps, with clear, complete escalations that enable efficient downstream coordination and minimize rework.
  • Queue Management & SLA Adherence
    Maintain strong performance against SLA targets by effectively prioritizing and managing case queues, ensuring timely response and resolution across all service requests.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

Palmetto embraces diversity and is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

We will keep your information on file for four years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full privacy policy.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Staff Product Designer

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to lead design for our cash products, the fast, affordable liquidity at the heart of the Tilt user’s financial lives. They help members cover the gap between paychecks, and you’ll own the experience end to end: how members understand their offer, take an advance, and repay.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer who has owned the design of a whole product or product area before, not only individual features, and is ready to do the same here. You’ll pair strong product thinking with exceptional craft, and you’ll be accountable for outcomes: the customer and business results the experience drives. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other partners to set direction for the product and raise the quality bar across it.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Lead design for our cash products end to end, from setting the experience direction for the product through launch and iteration.

  • Own outcomes alongside your product and engineering partners: define what success looks like, connect design decisions to measurable customer and business results, and follow the work after launch to see whether it delivered.

  • Set and hold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, and overall product quality, and raise the bar for the wider design team through critique and example.

  • Translate complex financial concepts and flows, such as offers, advances, and repayment timing, into clear, trustworthy experiences.

  • Shape product strategy with your partners: identify the problems that matter most, frame them well, and make tradeoffs explicit.

  • Partner with compliance and legal early, so clarity and trust are built into the experience from the start.

  • Use AI throughout your workflow, from research synthesis and exploration to prototyping and building, and help the team adopt the approaches that work.

  • Help shape the design system and the broader UI patterns that our cash products and the rest of the app rely on.

  • Present work clearly and build alignment among partners and senior leaders with different perspectives and priorities.

  • Mentor other designers and help shape how design operates across product pods.

Why You're a Great Fit

  • Significant experience designing and shipping complex consumer digital products, ideally within fintech, financial services, commerce, transportation, or another multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience as the design owner for a whole product or major product area: you set its design direction and were accountable for the result, beyond designing individual features.

  • A portfolio that shows exceptional visual and UI craft alongside strong UX thinking, at a level that raises the bar for the team around you.

  • A track record of outcomes: examples where your design work measurably moved customer or business results, and how you knew.

  • Comfort setting direction in ambiguous product areas without a fully defined path.

  • Strong interaction-design fundamentals and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Experience working closely with product management and engineering throughout development, and influencing decisions beyond your own team.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior leaders and bringing partners along.

  • Good judgment about when to challenge assumptions, when to seek more context, and when to make a decision.

  • Consistent use of AI tools in your day-to-day design workflow (strongly preferred), with an informed point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing consumer financial products, such as cash advance, banking, payments, or lending

  • Experience prototyping or building in code, including with AI coding tools.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you’ll build a deep understanding of our customers, cash products, and business through shipping; build trusted relationships with your design and cross-functional partners; and form a clear point of view on where the experience should go.

Why Join Us

  • Lead design for the products at the center of Tilt’s business, with meaningful customer and business impact.

  • Set both the experience and the visual direction for a critical financial product.

  • Join a team that values strong design judgment, constructive debate, and thoughtful collaboration.

  • Work directly with product-minded partners who care deeply about customers and shipping useful products.

  • Shape how design operates, including how the team builds with AI, as the product organization evolves.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tilt-staff-product-designer

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.

This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese.

What you'll do

For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.

Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work.

We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting.

  • Task: AI data annotation
  • Area of expertise (domain): TV & Movies
  • Tools: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration
  • Estimated Volume: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule
  • Location: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application.

To proceed, please provide the following:

  • Share an updated CV
  • A brief overview of your relevant experience, particularly in TV & Movies and how many years you have worked in the field
  • Your current availability and estimated monthly capacity

jobs.title: Workforce Management Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Workforce Management Team

Our Workforce Management (WFM) team ensures operational stability by combining smart planning with real-time execution. We forecast demand, develop staffing plans, build schedules, and make adjustments in real time to keep performance on track and minimize disruptions. By protecting service commitments and driving consistency, we help Thumbtack deliver a seamless, reliable experience that builds long-term trust with pros and customers.

About the role

As a Workforce Analyst, you’ll work across the full workforce management cycle — forecasting demand, building schedules, and managing intraday performance — so that customers and pros get reliable, timely support. This hybrid role connects long-range planning with day-to-day execution, giving you a complete view of how staffing decisions shape service outcomes.

You’ll own work of moderate scope with a blend of autonomy and manager support, apply team standards and decision frameworks, and grow your domain expertise by tackling increasingly complex challenges. It’s an ideal next step for a practitioner who wants to build depth across planning, scheduling, and real-time management.

What you’ll do

Forecasting & Capacity

  • Forecast call, case, and task volumes across channels, adjusting for seasonality, campaigns, and business events.

  • Translate forecasts into staffing requirements and capacity plans that balance service performance, utilization, and cost.

  • Compare forecasts against actuals, explain variance, and refine assumptions to improve accuracy over time.

Scheduling & Allocation

  • Build and maintain schedules, shifts, and rotations that meet coverage needs within business constraints.

  • Plan around training, PTO, and project time while keeping scheduling fair and transparent for agents.

  • Allocate staff across queues and skills to meet service goals efficiently.

Intraday Management

  • Monitor real-time queues, adherence, and service levels across channels.

  • Take tactical action when conditions change, such as re-queuing, shift adjustments, or overtime, weighing service, cost, and agent impact.

  • Communicate status, interventions, and escalations clearly and quickly to operations partners.

Analytics & Recommendations

  • Track utilization, shrinkage, adherence, and forecast accuracy to surface trends and improvement opportunities.

  • Deliver clear reporting and insights that inform headcount planning, budgeting, and operational decisions.

  • Diagnose root causes of performance gaps and propose practical, system-aware improvements.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with Operations, HR, Training, and Finance to keep planning assumptions and cadences aligned.

  • Document assumptions, flag changes early, and maintain reliable planning records others depend on.

  • Contribute to WFM processes and team initiatives that improve how we work.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 3+ years of experience in workforce management, with hands-on work in at least two of forecasting, scheduling, and real-time analysis.

  • Solid understanding of demand and staffing drivers, and the judgment to combine data with business context to build realistic forecasts and plans.

  • Calm, sound decision-making when service conditions change quickly, following consistent frameworks while adapting when needed.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using data from multiple sources to find root causes and weigh risks and benefits.

  • Ability to turn data into clear, simple insights and explain the “why” behind recommendations to different audiences.

  • Proficiency with workforce management systems, reporting tools, and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets).

  • Organized, transparent working habits: documenting assumptions, sharing context early, and following through on commitments.

  • A collaborative, proactive mindset, seeking out best practices and opportunities to improve how the team operates.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative, Germany (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.

We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.

Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.

Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.

Role Overview

Accelerate Plasmidsaurus's growth in Europe by converting prospective customers into active users and expanding relationships across a broad portfolio of academic, biotech, government, and pharmaceutical accounts. You'll help build a scalable, high-performing inside sales motion that makes Plasmidsaurus the sequencing partner of choice for more scientists and research organizations.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who combines scientific literacy with a consultative, disciplined approach to selling. We're hiring two people for this team.

What You'll Do

Own and grow your book

  • Manage and develop a portfolio of prospective and existing accounts, from first outreach through close.

  • Prioritize across the book using account potential, engagement, usage, and likelihood to convert.

  • Qualify opportunities and run the full sales cycle: position our services, address objections, and close.

  • Drive repeat purchases and expansion in your accounts through service adoption.

Build deep customer relationships

  • Source new customers, including labs, researchers, and institutions, through outbound prospecting, CRM-driven workflows, and Marketing initiatives.

  • Run consultative discovery with scientists, lab leaders, and procurement to understand research needs, workflows, and purchasing intent.

  • Agree with Account Managers on who is the primary contact for each account, based on usage, complexity, and strategic importance.

Bring the company and customer together

  • Work with Account Managers, Technical Sequencing Specialists, Customer Success, and Marketing on aligned messaging, clean handoffs, and a strong end-to-end customer experience.

  • Help Sales leadership define and refine Inside Sales processes, including prospecting, segmentation, prioritization, and performance metrics, as the function scales.

  • Keep CRM records accurate and timely, including lead progression, opportunities, activity, and forecasts.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

You can position our services accurately, including how plasmid and RNA sequencing differ. You're working your book with a clear approach to prioritization, your CRM records are current, and you've run your first handoffs with Account Managers.

First 6 months

You run the full sales cycle on standard opportunities. You have the pipeline to support your quota and you're meeting prospect-to-purchase conversion targets.

First year

You're meeting or exceeding your quota. Customers you've won are placing repeat orders, and you're helping improve how the team prospects and prioritizes.

What You'll Bring

  • Business fluency in German and English, spoken and written.

  • A bachelor's degree in biology, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Relevant sales experience: inside sales (preferably in biotech, healthcare, or pharmaceutical sales), field or territory sales, or customer-facing technical support such as field applications, technical sales support, customer success, or scientific support. We hire on demonstrated scope and impact, not years alone.

  • Scientific literacy sufficient to understand sequencing workflows and clearly position the value of our services.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to engage credibly with scientists as well as procurement and business stakeholders.

  • A consultative selling mindset: discovery, needs assessment, and objection handling.

  • Strong judgment and prioritization across a large and varied book of business, and the ability to run several processes with different stakeholders at once.

  • Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot. Experience in a fast-moving or startup environment is a plus.

Ways of Working

  • Build. Think from first principles and build complete solutions. Understand the reason behind a request, even when it isn't what was asked for.

  • Own. Take personal responsibility. Know your top priorities and make your work visible and impactful.

  • Move. Favor speed over perfection. Be decisive, with a bias to action.

  • Participate. Speak up, dissent, and engage. Share ideas early, disagree and commit, and give and receive feedback with care.

  • Inspire. Work with great people and raise the bar for the team.

Location: Remote, Germany.

jobs.title: ABM Specialist
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on our Customer Growth Marketing team, inside the account-based marketing (ABM) program that drives site expansion within our existing Enterprise and Mid-Market customers.. You will run the campaigns that introduce MaintainX to new sites and departments, keeping the expansion pipeline growing as targets rise.

The role

You will own the execution behind our ABM programs, so we reach more of our named accounts with timely, relevant campaigns.

  • Run our paid ABM programs on LinkedIn and programmatic: build audiences from account lists and signals, shift budget and creative based on engagement, and test new channels as budget grows. Plan and launch coordinated campaigns across webinars, events, email, and direct mail, timed to account activity and Sales priorities, so Sales has a relevant touchpoint when an account shows buying signals.

  • Set up and QA campaigns in our ABM and marketing tools, and keep account and contact data clean so we reach the right people.

  • Write briefs for ads and landing pages for Creative and keep a refresh calendar, so no campaign goes stale.

  • Report on campaign results and bring your own ideas for one-to-few and one-to-one account plays, so we can go after more high-value accounts.

You will work closely with our Senior Manager, ABM, who sets strategy and signal design, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, Events, and Content. Within 6 to 12 months, you will run our paid programs independently, own your pipeline KPIs, and have designed account plays of your own.

About you

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with hands-on paid digital, ABM, or demand generation experience

  • Experience managing paid campaigns, ideally on LinkedIn and programmatic, and optimizing for pipeline quality rather than volume

  • A track record of executing multi-channel campaigns end to end, ideally ABM campaigns

  • Working knowledge of Outreach (or similar) and Salesforce

  • Strong project management across many campaigns and deadlines at once

  • Comfort pulling performance data, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean

  • Initiative and comfort with ambiguity: you do well in a high-growth environment where priorities pivot

Nice to have:

  • Experience with ABM or sales intelligence tools (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

  • Experience with direct mail or other offline ABM tactics

  • Background in industrial or operations software

We offer

  • Work in the physical world. The accounts you target run factories, fleets, and facilities, and when our software works, their lines stay up.

  • A product the industry already loves. Customers who choose us renew and expand, so you are building on something that already wins.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. MaintainX is part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), which brings Autodesk’s global reach to the problem we were already solving.

  • An early seat. This program is scaling fast, and the account plays we have not had capacity to run are yours to design.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We hire for what you have shipped, not what your title was. You get autonomy and the trust to use it, and we expect you to bring ideas rather than wait to be asked. Priorities shift in a company growing this fast, and we say so openly.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Technical Support Specialists to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities.

You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

jobs.title: Associate GEO and SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on the Demand Generation team, where SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) is a fast-growing source of pipeline. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews which maintenance software to consider, and our job is to make sure MaintainX is in that answer and described well. Today the work is run by one person. You'll help make it a team of two.

The role

  • You will turn our SEO and GEO strategy into shipped work, so MaintainX shows up wherever buyers search.

  • Run content refreshes and gap pieces from brief to QA to publish, so priority pages recover and hold their rankings and AI citations.

  • Review backlink and offsite citation prospects to keep every link we earn high quality.

  • Support technical SEO and keyword research, flagging issues and opportunities before they cost us traffic.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for our web, design, content and product teams and outside vendors, turning their requests into clear next steps and following through until the work ships.

  • Design and run experiments with our Senior SEO/GEO Specialist to learn what moves visibility in LLMs, and document what you find.

Most of your partners don't own SEO, so part of the job is explaining why a change matters so they want to make it. Our Senior Specialist will train you on our tools and processes and mentor you. Within 6 to 12 months, you'll own execution on the team's core projects, handle ad hoc requests independently, and propose experiments of your own.

About you

  • 1 to 2 years in SEO, through a role or a strong internship

  • Hands-on keyword research and rank tracking in Semrush, Ahrefs or a similar tool

  • A clear view of how search is changing, including how LLMs surface and cite sources

  • Tests you've run or contributed to, and what you learned from them (side projects exploring GEO count)

  • Experience explaining technical ideas to non-technical teammates and getting them on board

  • The organization to juggle several projects and follow up until each is done

  • Comfort making decisions without a clear answer, because search rarely offers one

  • Nice to have

  • Screaming Frog or other technical audit tools

  • Exposure to GEO and AEO tools such as Profound or AirOps

  • B2B SaaS or demand generation experience

We offer

  • A product worth recommending. Operations teams in factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses already choose MaintainX, so you'll be earning visibility for something customers love.

  • An early seat. GEO is new and our team is small. You'll own real projects from week one and learn from the person who built the playbook.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. As part of Autodesk, we have more resources and reach, pointed at the problem we were already solving.

  • Room to grow. Search is being rewritten right now, and the people who learn it early become the people the company asks.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We test, measure and share what we learn, including what didn't work. You get autonomy, and we expect you to ask early when you're stuck.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.
