jobs.title: Business Analyst (Mexico Based) - Global Services Company
jobs.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A Leading global professional services firm with over 9,000 employees worldwide and more than 40 years of experience delivering innovative technology and talent solutions. Operating across both public and commercial sectors, the company combines deep industry expertise with a people-first approach to help organizations solve complex challenges and achieve lasting results. As a privately held organization, it maintains the flexibility to prioritize long-term impact, innovation, and excellence, while also being recognized as a pioneer in bringing neurodiversity and inclusive practices into the enterprise.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Business Analyst, Field Operations & Metering to support technology initiatives across the gas, propane, and electric utility sectors. In this role, you will collaborate with field operations, metering, customer operations, IT, and delivery teams to analyze business needs, identify process improvement opportunities, and translate operational requirements into effective technology solutions. You will play a key role in optimizing field workflows, enhancing work execution and service delivery, and driving successful technology adoption across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with field operations, metering, dispatch, customer operations, and IT stakeholders to gather business requirements, document current-state processes, identify operational challenges, and define data, device, and integration needs.

  • Develop process maps, use cases, workflows, business rules, and impact assessments for utility field activities, including meter installations, exchanges, removals, inspections, meter reads, service orders, disconnects/reconnects, and exception handling.

  • Create and maintain epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and supporting documentation in Azure DevOps or similar tools.

  • Analyze SAP 1CX, Field Service Management, Service and Asset Manager, mobile workforce, meter data, and related system enhancements, assessing their impact on configuration, integrations, master data, security, testing, training, and field adoption.

  • Plan and support field-based testing activities and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with operations teams.

  • Track defects, validate business requirements, and ensure delivered solutions meet operational needs.

  • Prepare release notes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), job aids, user guides, and other documentation to support field and metering teams.

  • Support process improvements and technology adoption across gas, propane, and electric utility operations.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Must be located in Mexico and available for a fully remote position.

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst supporting field operations, metering, utility technology, or customer operations projects.

  • Experience with business process mapping and documentation using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, PowerPoint, or similar applications.

  • Practical understanding of utility field operations and metering processes across gas, propane, and electric operations, including:

    • Field service orders and work execution.

    • Meter lifecycle activities, installations, exchanges, and removals.

    • Meter reads, inspections, and troubleshooting.

    • Exception handling and customer-impacting field activities.

  • Functional familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, C4C, Field Service Management (FSM), Service and Asset Manager, mobile field applications, meter data processes, and related integrations.

  • Ability to create clear and comprehensive business requirements, process maps, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, enhancement documentation, SOPs, and operational guides.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and root-cause analysis skills.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.

  • Experience using Azure DevOps or similar project and requirements management tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with mobile workforce management, SAP Field Service Management, SAP Service and Asset Manager, or field productivity tools.

  • Familiarity with meter-to-cash processes, Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Automated Meter Reading (AMR), and Meter Data Management (MDM).

  • Experience with dispatch optimization, workflow automation, or field operations transformation.

  • Previous experience supporting an Application Management Services (AMS) delivery model, AMI/AMR deployment, metering modernization initiative, or utility operations improvement program.

  • SAFe, Scrum, SAP, or other relevant industry certifications.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

jobs.title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Oncology Algorithms)
jobs.description:
Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team in the Oncology R&D organization. You will oversee the planning and execution of development of AI-based diagnostic algorithms, taking them through the development phase, analytical validation and into commercial launch. You will hire and manage the team, support its professional growth, and set the development strategy for new products.

The role calls for extensive experience in algorithm development, NGS data processing across DNA, RNA and methylation, H&E image processing, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product development in a regulated setting. You will implement methods to optimize performance and help define the product profile from a computational perspective, with input from cross-functional teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead, hire and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and build a culture of scientific rigor.
  • Development Strategy: Own the development strategy behind new products, from scoping through execution. Work with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.
  • Development To Launch: Lead algorithms through the development phase to CLIA readiness. This includes locking the algorithm and its intended use, supporting analytical validation studies by setting performance targets and acceptance criteria in collaboration with the biostatistics team. You will also support clinical validation and produce the documentation that quality, regulatory, and laboratory directors need to release the test.
  • Model Robustness and Performance: Develop and improve biomarker models and classifiers across modalities. Establish strategies for quality control, generalization across sites, scanners, and sequencing runs, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable, validated production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, and containerization, and reproducibility under change control. Automate the routine parts of research data management, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.
  • Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team, you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off.
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Biostatistics, or a related field. (An M.S. with equivalent experience considered).
  • 7+ years in bioinformatics, including 3+ years leading scientists and working across functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from multimodal data including, DNA, RNA and/or methylation sequencing data, digital pathology for clinical diagnostic use.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a team that took an algorithm from research into real clinical use, including a successful CLIA or comparable regulated release, not only to a result.
  • Working knowledge of analytical validation for algorithms, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, limit of detection, and reproducibility.

Preferred:

  • Deep expertise in next-generation sequencing analysis: hybrid-capture or amplicon-based target enrichment designs, sequencing quality control, secondary analysis, and variant calling.
  • Experience integrating multimodal data (DNA, RNA, histology and other omics data), into a single predictive model or classifier.
  • Working knowledge of how a diagnostic product moves through development in a regulated, accredited setting, including the practices and standards that apply (CLIA, CAP, design controls, and software validation and change control).
  • Strong Python, programming, and data analysis skills, with experience in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Cloud computing (AWS, GCP) and workflow orchestration (WDL, Nextflow).
  • Containerization (Docker) for reproducible, production-grade analyses.
  • Clear communication of technical detail to people who do not share your background.
  • The ability to run several objectives and timelines at once without close supervision.
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$177,800—$222,800 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a driven, aspiring seller who wants to build a career in sales and get very good, fast. You don’t need years of experience. You do need drive, discipline, and the curiosity to learn a complex space. The right person is competitive, coachable, resilient, and relentless: they can take a “no” on a cold call and pick up the phone again with the same energy. They want to understand why healthcare marketing is hard (HIPAA, tracking pixels, privacy risk) and can turn that into short, sharp outreach that gets a busy executive’s attention. They run their own day in a remote environment, apply feedback on the very next call, and see progress as part of winning.

What you’ll be doing
As an SDR on our Provider team, you’ll build net-new pipeline by booking first meetings with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups. These are the people who decide how patient data is used in marketing, and your work gives our Provider AEs a steady flow of high-quality first conversations. You’ll start with a structured 2-week onboarding bootcamp, get certified on our pitch and objection handling, and be fully ramped by the end of your second month. After that, it’s about steady results: high activity, real personalization, and clean execution.

Primary responsibilities

jobs.title: Director of Product, Search and Curated Experiences
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team

AlphaSense's Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions. Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.

If you're passionate about creating industry-leading tools that shape the future of business intelligence, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are seeking a senior, deeply technical product leader to own Search and Curated Experiences AlphaSense. Search is the front door to a corpus of hundreds of millions of business documents, and the relevance, ranking, document-type coverage, filtering, and performance you own sit underneath every product surface. Curated Experiences define how AlphaSense’s content, functionality, and intelligence show up in pre-built experiences that act as a launchpad for our customers’ research - everything from company profiles and industry profiles, to monitoring and beyond.

This is a leadership role, not a feature role. You will set the search strategy, own the metrics, and be the person the organization turns to drive impact with both Search and Curated Experiences. You will lead a small team, including a domain-expert for Curated Experiences. We expect you to own these programs end to end, with the judgment, drive, and initiative to take them all the way.

What You'll Do

  • Own both Search and Curated Experiences: Relevance, ranking, query understanding, document-type coverage, filters, latency, and reliability across every surface that depends on search are your ownership areas, alongside adoption and engagement of company profiles and future new curated experiences.

  • Define the strategy: Set and defend a roadmap that balances relevance quality, coverage, and performance against clear business priorities.

  • Build evaluation and measurement: Stand up the metrics, benchmarks, and experimentation needed to know whether search is getting better, and to prove it.

  • Collaborate across teams: Partner closely with Knowledge Graph, SuperAnalyst / AI, Engineering, and Design so that search and the experiences built on top of it move together.

  • Lead and grow a team: Manage and mentor the curated-experiences / domain-expert PM, set clear ownership, and raise the bar for the search org as it grows.

  • Execute and deliver: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - from strategy and experimentation through launch, post-launch analysis, and iteration.

Who You Are

  • Deeply Technical: You have built search and relevance systems at scale - e.g., a Google Search-caliber background or equivalent depth in ranking, retrieval, query understanding, and evaluation. You can reason fluently about representation, freshness, quality, and system-design tradeoffs.

  • Strong Ownership & Drive: You take programs end to end and operate autonomously. You set direction, make the calls, and are accountable for the outcome.

  • A People Leader: You can manage and grow PMs, set clear lines of ownership, and resolve ambiguity rather than create it.

  • Analytical & Data-Driven: You balance business goals with technical capability and let metrics, not opinion, settle questions of search quality.

  • Strong Customer Orientation: You understand how sophisticated users search and form conviction, and you use interviews, usability testing, and behavioral data to validate hypotheses.

  • Clear Communicator: You can align engineering, design, and product marketing around a roadmap and gain buy-in to drive high-impact work.

  • Domain Experience a Plus: Direct experience in financial services, capital markets, or with our core customers (financial services, corporate strategy, consulting) is a plus, but not required.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$275,000—$290,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.title: OSP Licensing and Permitting Specialist
jobs.description:
Here at GoNetspeed, we believe in the power of connectivity. We believe that life doesn’t wait for us to catch up. We believe that providing the fastest and most reliable Internet to the communities we serve means committing to the present and building for the future.

And we believe that our amazing team of employees are the key to our future and vision of connecting communities for today and for whatever comes next. If this excites you, come and join our team.

The OSP Licensing & Permitting Specialist is responsible for obtaining, managing, and maintaining permits and approvals required for outside plant fiber and utility infrastructure projects. This role supports the successful delivery of OSP construction by coordinating with municipalities, utility companies, and regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with permitting requirements, joint use agreements, and project schedules.

Essential Job Functions:

License & Permit Application Management:
• Determines required permits based on project scope, OSP design, and jurisdiction
• Performs jurisdictional research
• Prepares, submits, tracks, and closes permits and applications for OSP construction (fiber, conduit, aerial and underground facilities)
• Reviews engineering and construction/permit drawings for permitting compliance
• Ensures compliance with Right-of-Way (ROW), easement, and environmental requirements
• Performs and/or coordinates Make Ready Engineering (MRE) activities, including clearance analysis and utility coordination
• Reviews, coordinates, and validates pole loading analysis (PLA) to ensure structural compliance with joint use and utility standards
• Coordinates with pole owning utilities regarding pole attachment requirements, relocations, replacement, and make ready timelines
• Tracks permit status, conditions, fees, and expiration dates
• Responds to agency comments and revises applications as needed
• Advises engineering on design changes required for permit approvals
• Mentors or guides OSP Licensing & Permitting Coordinators as needed

Regulatory Compliance:
• Interprets and applies utility agreements, municipal ordinances, and state/federal regulations related to utility pole attachments, conduit use, and ROW work
• Coordinates with municipalities, DOTs, utility companies, railroads, HOAs, and private property owners
• Resolves escalated permitting issues and conflicts
Coordination and Communication:
• Coordinates traffic control plans, lane closures, and inspection scheduling
• Communicates permit requirements and constraints to coordinators, engineering, construction, and project management teams
• Supports construction start dates by ensuring permits are approved and active
• Coordinates inspections, restoration requirements, and final sign-offs
• Maintains permit logs, documentation, data base, trackers
• Assists with audits, regulatory reporting, and record retention
Completes special projects as assigned by the Licensing & Permitting Manager*.
*These tasks do not meet the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of essential job functions and are usually less than 5% of time spent. However, these tasks still constitute important performance aspects of the job.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Strong knowledge of OSP construction (aerial, underground, fiber, conduit) and jurisdictional permitting requirements.
• Ability to interpret utility agreements, municipal ordinances, ROW rules, and state/federal regulations.
• Skilled in reviewing OSP engineering drawings, TC plans, and permit packages for compliance.
• Experience with Make Ready Engineering (MRE) and basic pole loading analysis (PLA) review.
• Ability to coordinate with pole‑owning utilities on attachments, relocations, and make‑ready timelines.
• Proven ability to resolve escalated permitting issues and agency comments.
• Strong communication skills for working with municipalities, DOTs, utilities, engineers, and construction teams.
• Excellent organization, documentation, and permit tracking skills; able to manage high permit volumes.
• Proficient with permitting databases, trackers, spreadsheets, and documentation systems.
• Ability to mentor or guide junior permitting staff.
• Ability to consistently follow‑up and strong attention to detail.
• Document control and reporting
• Professional, team‑oriented, and comfortable in a fast‑paced environment.

Education and Experience:
• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• 3–7 years of experience in OSP permitting, joint‑use licensing, or telecom utility coordination.

Compensation

Additional Information

GoNetspeed is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity, color, race, creed, national origin, religious persuasion, marital status, political belief, or disability.

Thank you for choosing GoNetspeed as your potential next employer! We know you have other options when selecting an employer of choice and are so glad you chose to apply with us.

jobs.title: Senior Motion & Graphic Designer (Remote)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights

  • Role: Senior Motion & Graphic Designer

  • Department: Creative

  • Salary Band: $90,000 - $110,000

  • Location: Remote (U.S.)

  • Position Status: Actively hiring for this role

  • Application Deadline: We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no cutoff date. If this job sounds like you, go for it.

    • Today, we're looking for a Senior Motion & Graphic Designer to join our growing team. 

    We're hiring a Senior Performance Creative to partner with our Creative Strategist and turn research, hooks, and loose briefs into polished static and short-form video ads for paid social. The role requires strong range across design and motion editing, including cutting raw shoot footage into finished assets. It also requires the brand fluency to stay on-brand at high volume, whether working from a one-pager or a full brand system, while pushing creative into fresh territory.

    Here’s what we expect from our Senior Motion & Graphic Designer.

—What You'll Do—

    • Translate strategy into visuals: partner closely with our Creative Strategist to take research, hooks, and loose creative briefs and turn them into concrete visual concepts, storyboards, and finished assets
    • Produce both statics and video: design and build static ad creative and edit/produce short-form video and motion content for paid social at a consistently high craft level
    • Interpret brand guidance at any altitude: work from anything ranging from a thin one-pager to a comprehensive brand system, and reliably produce creative that's unmistakably on-brand either way
    • Navigate regulated-industry review cycles: produce creative that anticipates compliance and legal scrutiny, minimizing revision rounds and rejection risk without watering down creative quality
    • Push brands into new creative territory: identify opportunities to evolve a brand's creative expression to unlock scale and new-market growth, while staying inside brand-safety guardrails
    • Select and edit raw footage/imagery: review raw photography and video footage from shoots and select, crop, cut, and edit the strongest material into finished assets — no on-set creative direction required
    • Own asset quality and turnaround: deliver polished, client-ready work with minimal internal revision cycles so assets aren't burning days internally before they even reach the client
    • Maintain visual consistency at scale: keep creative consistent and on-brand across a high volume of ad variations, formats, and platform

—What we are looking for—

    Core Experience
    • 5+ years in a hands-on creative production role — Art Director, Senior Designer, Creative Producer, or similar —with dedicated performance/paid social experience
    • A portfolio that shows range across both static design and video/motion editing, ideally for paid social specifically
    • Experience working within brand guidelines of varying depth and translating them into new creative applications
    • Experience in regulated or highly regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance, legal, or similar) is a strong plus, given our client base
    • Experience working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and layered approval processes

    Craft & Technical Skills
    • Expert-level proficiency in Figma (or similar) for static design and layout
    • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or similar) for motion graphics and video editing
    • Comfortable editing raw video/photo footage into finished assets: selects, cuts, pacing, captions/graphics overlays
    • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator) as needed
    • Understands platform-specific creative specs and best practices across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and other paid social channels
    Creative & Strategic Judgment
    • A strong eye for what "good" looks like in modern performance advertising — thumb-stopping, polished, and effective, not just pretty
    • Understands performance/paid-social fundamentals (hooks, pacing, hierarchy, CTAs) well enough to make smart creative calls independently, without needing to run the strategy
    • Can take a loose brief or visual direction and fill in the gaps with sound creative judgment
    • High attention to detail — typos, brand misapplications, and spec errors don't make it to client review
    • Comfortable giving and receiving fast, iterative feedback in a deadline-driven environment

    Working Style
    • Thrives on speed without sacrificing polish — this role owns production timelines that need to move fast to offset long approval cycles
    • Collaborative by nature; sees the Creative Strategist as a partner, not a hand-off point
    • Self-sufficient in production; doesn't need heavy oversight to get from brief to finished asset

—What success looks like—

    • Assets consistently reach client/compliance review in 1–2 internal revision rounds or fewer

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
Role Description

As an Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Team’s tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropbox’s offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly.

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever’s tech stack: frameworks used to develop our applications, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure that support our operations.
  • You will have lots of Pull Requests merged and running in production.
  • You will attend some of the Fever Originals’ experiences, like Candlelight.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.
  • You will have participated in the launch of one of our new microservices, from 0 to production.
  • You will mentor other team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • You will participate in some of the team-building we organise for your team or the whole engineering team.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of good practices, testing, and design patterns.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Handling services with high concurrency and high-volume requests.
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • You are proficient in business English

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

  • Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
  • Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.
  • Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

This role is "engineer-first" and also delivery-focused. You will work with engineering, security, privacy, finance and business teams to translate requirements into technical controls, build automated evidence collection, assess our vendors, answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs, and manage the compliance projects from start to finish across the Fever group companies.

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. This is an opportunity to have a real impact as a high-growth global category leader.

About you

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst (Europe)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Note: this role is based remotely out of Europe.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in Europe with strong overlap to customer business hours in the region.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

  • Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

  • Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

  • Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

  • Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

  • Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

  • Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

  • Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

  • Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

  • SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

  • Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

This role will be focused on understanding and reducing the security risk of Fever's cloud infrastructure and data. You will run technical risk assessments of our AWS environments, data platforms and new architectures, identify the weaknesses that could lead to a security incident or a data breach, and work with the owning teams until those risks are fixed.

As part of the Cybersecurity team, you will focus on defensive security in cloud and data environments: where our sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, how it is protected, and how secure the infrastructure underneath is. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact in a high-growth global category leader, working alongside experts to implement best practices and innovative security solutions. If you're passionate about cloud and data security and enjoy tackling challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to have you on board!

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, data platforms, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, risk methodology and overall security landscape.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will run infrastructure and architecture risk assessments using our risk methodology.
  • You will map where sensitive data is stored and processed (S3, databases, data warehouse, SaaS) and who can access it.
  • You will participate in security configuration reviews to ensure cloud and data environments meet industry standards.
  • You will develop automation to detect data exposure, excessive permissions and misconfigurations.
  • You will participate in vulnerability management sessions, collaborating with stakeholders to drive continuous security improvements.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will own the risk assessment process for infrastructure and data, from design reviews to risk acceptance.
  • You will drive the remediation of the main data and infrastructure risks with clear owners and deadlines.
  • You will lead initiatives to implement secure solutions for data: classification, encryption and key management, and least-privilege access.
  • You will act as a point of contact for technical guidance on cloud architecture, data security and configurations.
  • You will develop cybersecurity technical documentation and secure best practices guidelines to educate and support stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform technical risk assessments and threat models of cloud infrastructure, data platforms and new architectures, and document residual risk.
  • Maintain the infrastructure and data risk register, prioritising risks and tracking treatment plans with owners.
  • Identify, classify and protect sensitive data across AWS services, data warehouses and SaaS (data security posture).
  • Review and enforce encryption, key management (KMS), network isolation and identity and access controls for data stores.
  • Conduct regular security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in the AWS ecosystem.
  • Develop and deploy automated security solutions to detect, report and remediate data exposure and misconfigurations.
  • Collaborate with Data, DevOps and engineering teams to build security into data pipelines and infrastructure.

About you

Must have:

  • Proven experience performing security risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and architectures (threat modeling, likelihood/impact, residual risk).
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure security including IAM, networking, KMS, S3, logging and organisation-level controls.
  • Good understanding of data security: data classification, encryption, access governance and data loss prevention.
  • Experience securing data platforms (e.g. data lakes, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks or similar) and their pipelines.
  • Proficiency in scripting for automation and security operations (Python, Go or similar).
  • Knowledge of risk and cloud security frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and explain risk to technical and business audiences.
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud security and/or cybersecurity roles.
  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), CNAPP or CSPM tools.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations affecting data (GDPR) and PCI DSS.
  • Security certifications (e.g. CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, CRISC, CISSP or similar).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
  • English and Spanish Lessons
  • Gympass Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) with experience in the IT industry—ideally working with or for major technology vendors and infrastructure providers. The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of hardware solutions and a foundational understanding of infrastructure data center build projects, including how engineering, construction, operations, and IT come together to deliver complex systems.

In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, construction, operations, IT, and commercial organizations to drive clarity, alignment, and momentum across highly technical and interdependent workstreams. You will serve as the connective tissue between disciplines—building trust, ensuring all stakeholders understand their roles, and driving a unified vision for program success.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You will help implement scalable processes and systems while also being comfortable rolling up your sleeves to establish baseline workflows, often using short-term manual approaches before automation or tooling is implemented.

Location. Remote - Norway

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Lead complex, cross-functional technical programs spanning hardware, infrastructure, IT systems, and operational readiness.
  • Work closely with engineering, construction, operations, IT, and commercial teams to ensure alignment on objectives, dependencies, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Bring clarity and structure to complex workstreams by defining program plans, success criteria, and execution frameworks.
  • Create and maintain repeatable, scalable systems and processes, balancing long-term operational excellence with short-term pragmatism.
  • Identify and manage risks, drive mitigation plans, and ensure timely escalation of critical issues.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels to foster trust, shared ownership, and transparent decision-making.
  • Ensure all teams understand roles, responsibilities, and expectations, creating shared clarity around deliverables and the program’s strategic direction.
  • Facilitate effective communication, ensuring technical concepts are translated appropriately for diverse audiences.
  • Drive operational readiness, coordinating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure hardware, infrastructure, and IT systems are prepared for deployment.
  • Track and report on program progress, using data and narrative to clearly communicate status, decisions, and risks to leadership.
  • Promote a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across teams involved in program execution.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in the IT or technology vendor industry.
  • Hands-on experience with hardware solutions, hardware lifecycle management, or hardware-dependent infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure build projects (e.g., data centers, edge deployments, network installations, or similar).
  • Strong track record of driving cross-functional alignment across engineering and operational teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or fast-moving technical programs.
  • Experience establishing scalable systems, workflows, and governance, while being comfortable using manual or lightweight approaches to get started.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to think strategically while also executing tactically.
  • Proven ability to manage risks, dependencies, and detailed plans across several teams.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience working with data center operations, cloud infrastructure, networking hardware, or OEM hardware vendors.
  • Understanding of logistics and supply chain desirable.
  • Certification or training in program management methodologies (e.g., PMP, Agile, Lean) is a plus but not required.
  • Technical background or familiarity with IT infrastructure domains.

Compensation

In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Pension
  • Supplemental Leisuretime Insurance

#LI-AB1

#LI-Remote

Compensation

926.400 kr—1.158.000 kr NOK

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Diep Nguyen, VP Finance here at Customer.io, and I am looking for an Accounting Manager to partner with the Controller on our month-end close and serve as first-level reviewer for the accounting team. We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, with a finance stack that includes NetSuite and FloQast, and we use AI throughout the business, including in Finance. Our accounting team covers revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury. You'll report to the Controller and work closely with partners in Sales, Legal, IT, People, and Engineering.

What we value

  • Ownership — You own a process from source data through the financial statements.
  • Curiosity — You keep asking why until you find the system behind the break.
  • A data-backed voice — You bring findings and recommendations to business owners with numbers behind them.
  • Practical AI use — You apply AI to speed up accounting work, with documented human review.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the Controller on the monthly and quarterly close in FloQast, tracking deadlines and sign-offs, and help shorten the close through process improvements and AI.
  • Review and approve journal entries and reconciliations prepared by others on the accounting team, including cash, accounts receivable, prepaids, deferred commissions, fixed assets, accruals, deferred revenue, and payroll liabilities, and propose the bad debt reserve for Controller approval.
  • Draft the monthly flux analysis with root-cause explanations for material variances, assemble the close review folder, and support the Controller in the review with the VP Finance and CFO.
  • Assist the Senior Revenue Manager with revenue recognition (ASC 606), including deferred revenue, overage accruals, and usage true-ups.
  • Review AP, card, and payroll accruals and entries to confirm liabilities are recorded completely.
  • Prepare audit schedules for our external auditors and help document and test close controls with the Controller.
  • Coach the accountants who prepare the close, and apply AI tools to flux analysis, accrual review, and reconciliation matching with documented human review.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years reviewing the work of others or managing accountants
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field
  • Hands-on month-end close experience at a SaaS company, including reviewing journal entries and reconciliations in an ERP such as NetSuite
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP for the accounts you will review, including accruals and unrecorded liabilities, prepaids, fixed assets, and payroll and commission liabilities, with specific knowledge of the allowance for credit losses (ASC 326), capitalized sales commissions (ASC 340-40), and the evaluation of errors and their materiality (ASC 250)
  • Experience supporting an external audit, including preparing schedules and responding to auditor requests
  • A specific example of using AI to make an accounting process or the close more efficient, which you built or deployed, and what it changed
  • Clear written and verbal communication with non-finance partners, and the judgment to know when to escalate to the Controller
  • Nice to have: CPA license (active or inactive) or a Big 4 or public accounting background; experience with NetSuite, FloQast, and usage-based billing; SOX or internal controls exposure; and remote-first company experience

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $105k–$122k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

jobs.title: Senior Energy Markets Analyst, PJM
jobs.description:
Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility.

What you will do

Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements.

Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships.

Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings.

Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues.

Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028.

Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports.

What success looks like

Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement.

Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does.

New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target.

Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch.

A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up.

Product, Partnerships, Dispatch Ops and utility contacts come to you directly.

Your analysis has informed a program design discussion with Product and Partnerships.

What you bring

Required

3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit.

Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data.

Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep.

Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs.

Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists.

Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time.

Preferred

PJM experience, in this order of relevance: DR programs (ELRP, utility DR programs in PJM states); settlements and performance calculations; capacity market basics (PLCs, nominations, delivery year calendar); wholesale market operations.

Strong DR candidates from ERCOT, NYISO or MISO are encouraged to apply.Â 

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Community

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £68,000 to £78,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional.
