jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
jobs.description:
Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling.
As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise.
Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter, which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments.
You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed.
You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself.
We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world.
You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow.
If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT YOU

You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code.
You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live.
You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution.
You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed.
You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems.
  • Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments.
  • Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed.
  • SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows.
  • Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure.
  • Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform.
  • End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate.
  • Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation.
  • Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments.
  • AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality.
  • Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight.
  • Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

Bonus Points for

  • Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product.
  • Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems.
  • Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure.
  • Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language.
  • Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.
  • Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments.
  • Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio.
  • High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it.
  • End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation.
  • Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions.
  • Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions.
  • Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality.
  • Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community.
  • Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement.
  • Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.
  • Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III | Framework
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Software Engineer III, you will drive key architectural and technical decisions, lead the design and execution of complex engineering initiatives, and elevate technical standards across the Framework team. You’ll partner closely with principal engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure systems that power core ExtraHop products. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.

Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes.Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB.

This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance.
  • Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support
  • Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work.
  • Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage.
  • Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to to define technical roadmaps, break down ambiguous problems, and balance technical debt with delivery.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
  • Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in STEM field, Computer Science, Engineering, or related degree requiring systematic/analytical thinking
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong expertise in C and C++
  • Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems.
  • Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools)
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems
  • Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems
  • Scripting experience (Python or similar)

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Performance- Weights & Biases
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

Weights & Biases at CoreWeave

CoreWeave acquired Weights & Biases to create the most powerful end-to-end platform to develop, deploy, and iterate AI faster. CoreWeave operates a growing footprint of data centers covering every region of the US and across Europe, and was ranked as one of the TIME100 most influential companies of 2024. By bringing together CoreWeave’s industry-leading cloud infrastructure with the best-in-class tools AI practitioners know and love from Weights & Biases, we’re setting a new standard for how AI is built, trained, and scaled.

The integration of our teams and technologies is accelerating our shared mission: to empower developers with the tools and infrastructure they need to push the boundaries of what AI can do. From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform.

Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises.

As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team.

What You’ll Do:

Performance Engineering at Weights & Biases ensures our systems and products scale seamlessly as usage grows. We embed performance thinking into every stage of development—diagnosing issues, designing scalable patterns, and building tools that empower every engineering team to deliver fast, efficient, and reliable experiences. Our mission is to make performance a shared responsibility across the company through data, automation, and collaboration.

About the role:

As a Staff Engineer on the Performance Engineering team, you’ll take technical ownership of complex performance challenges across the W&B platform and infrastructure. You’ll design and lead experiments to improve system scalability and latency, develop standardized benchmarking and load testing frameworks, and drive initiatives to prevent regressions across product surfaces. You’ll collaborate closely with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic understanding of system behavior. Day to day, you’ll blend investigation, architecture, and enablement—helping teams measure, understand, and continuously improve performance.

Who You Are:

  • 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2 years focused on performance optimization, systems scalability, or observability.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, with strong systems-level debugging and profiling skills.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, queuing, concurrency, resource contention, etc.) and their performance implications.
  • Experience designing and implementing load testing, benchmarking, or performance regression frameworks (e.g., Locust, Gatling, k6, custom solutions).
  • Familiarity with metrics and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.) and performance data analysis.
  • Experience integrating performance measurement into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to design experiments, analyze large datasets, and draw actionable conclusions.
  • Proven track record of driving cross-functional technical initiatives from design through adoption.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience in performance engineering or SRE at scale (e.g., supporting multi-region, high-throughput systems).
  • Familiarity with frontend performance monitoring and web vitals.
  • Experience building developer-facing tools or frameworks.
  • Background in data systems, observability, or ML infrastructure.
  • Experience contributing to open-source performance or benchmarking tools.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You love to turn messy, complex performance problems into clear, data-backed stories that lead to concrete action.
  • You’re curious about how systems behave under real-world load and enjoy building experiments that reveal what’s really happening under the hood.
  • You’re an expert in transforming deep technical insights into tools and processes that empower other engineers to build faster, more reliable systems.
  • You find satisfaction in long-term, cross-team collaboration — helping others succeed by embedding performance thinking into their workflows.
  • You get energy from bridging theory and practice: designing scalable architectures and writing the code that proves them out.
  • You care deeply about measurement, iteration, and continuous improvement — not just fixing bottlenecks, but preventing them from ever recurring.

Why Us?

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $188,000 to $275,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance
  • Short and long-term disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
  • Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health
  • Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
  • 401(k) with a generous employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
  • A casual work environment
  • A work culture focused on innovative disruption

All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Solve Clinical Workflow Challenges. Strengthen Healthcare Technology.

Reliable clinical applications enable healthcare professionals to deliver effective, coordinated care. Rackner is seeking an experienced Clinical Workflow Analyst to diagnose complex electronic health record (EHR) issues, restore functional workflows, and strengthen application reliability in mission-critical federal healthcare environments.

In this hands-on role, you'll apply your EHR expertise to resolve challenging application issues, manage cases through confirmed resolution, and identify opportunities to improve clinical technology operations. Working alongside clinical, technical, and service management teams, you'll contribute to dependable healthcare systems, better user experiences, and continuous operational improvement.

Reports To: Head of Engineering. Hours: 40/week. Location: Remote

Company Overview

Do you enjoy making a difference in a child's life, transforming education, and evolving learning? Come join Teachstone, the interaction company!

Teachstone® was founded in 2008 to deliver the Classroom Assessment Scoring System® (CLASS®) nationwide and around the globe. Developed through years of research, the CLASS observation tool measures the interactions between teachers and children, which have been shown to drive learning and lifelong achievement. Teachstone helps organizations conduct classroom observations and provides professional development so that teachers improve, and children learn more. Our online subscription service, myTeachstone, simplifies CLASS implementation by combining observation data with a robust library of CLASS resources and professional development.

At Teachstone, everything we do is about improving the ways teachers interact with their students. We train coaches and observers, build and deliver online support programs, and design professional development—all grounded in one proven fact: the interactions teachers have with students have a lasting impact on their academic and developmental success. By helping educators describe, measure, and improve their interactions and relationships with students, Teachstone is transforming education nationwide, one interaction at a time.

Role Overview

Teachstone is seeking an experienced, hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver the next generation of our technology platform. This role prioritizes product opportunities from initial problem definition through design, development, and production, with a particular emphasis on building AI-enabled capabilities as an integral part of the product experience. Working across frontend, backend, APIs, data models, and infrastructure, this individual will translate evolving business and customer needs into scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. In addition to delivering high-impact technical work, this role will help strengthen engineering team capabilities by mentoring colleagues in AI-assisted development and responsible AI implementation.

Role Responsibilities

  • Deliver Full-Stack Product Capabilities: Design, develop, and ship end-to-end features across the technology stack, from data models and backend services to polished, accessible user interfaces.
  • Support Platform Integration: Integrate Teachstone's next-generation platform with existing systems while maintaining clearly defined boundaries, reliable data flows, and sustainable architectural patterns.
  • Drive Solutions from Concept to Production: Translate loosely defined customer needs and business opportunities into technical solutions, taking ownership of design, implementation, testing, and deployment without requiring fully developed specifications.
  • Build Scalable and Reliable Systems: Work across APIs, application architecture, data models, backend services, and infrastructure to deliver secure, maintainable, and production-ready capabilities.
  • Advance AI-Enabled Development: Incorporate AI and agentic coding tools into development workflows, applying sound judgment about their strengths, limitations, and appropriate use cases.
  • Mentor and Elevate the Engineering Team: Coach teammates, build AI literacy across the team, and promote responsible practices for developing, evaluating, and verifying AI-enabled systems.

Role Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated experience delivering production software.
  • Strong full-stack engineering capabilities, including the ability to work hands-on across application code, infrastructure, and unfamiliar technology systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate loosely defined business problems and customer requirements into technical solutions and shipped products without relying on fully documented specifications.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows, with the ability to evaluate their strengths, limitations, and appropriate applications.
  • Experience building or implementing evaluation and verification infrastructure, such as automated test harnesses, continuous integration systems, evaluation pipelines, or performance benchmarks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and integrating AI-enabled product capabilities using large language models (LLMs), AI services, or cloud-based AI platforms.
  • Experience working with modern cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, and scalable application architectures.
  • Experience integrating new technology platforms with established legacy applications and systems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, sharing technical knowledge, and influencing engineering practices across a team.
  • Familiarity with Teachstone's technology ecosystem or comparable tools and frameworks.

Technology Stack

Our engineering environment includes the following technologies and tools:

  • Languages & Frameworks: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Ruby on Rails
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, Amazon S3, Snowflake
  • AI & Machine Learning: AWS Bedrock, Gemini, Claude

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â 
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written!

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Who you are

  • Establish effective development practices, including code review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation and incident response.
  • Use web analytics, search performance data, experimentation and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities and measure improvements.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, project planning, prioritization, stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

Due to continued growth in the cybersecurity sector, our team is expanding, and we require an Account Manager to join our high-performing team to focus on revenue retention and expansion within our key accounts. The ideal candidate will have a strong commercial background, ideally with experience as an Account Executive or in SaaS renewals, and will be well-versed in the cyber security landscape, particularly in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).

As an Account Manager, you'll report to the Head of Account Management and play a pivotal role in driving renewals and identifying opportunities for revenue growth within our existing client base. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that our clients see continuous value from our platform, focusing on strategic account management and contract negotiation. Your ability to navigate complex client relationships and understand their unique business needs will be essential in achieving our growth objectives.

What will you do?

  • Drive Renewals: Take ownership of the renewal process for a portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely and successful contract renewals.

  • Revenue Retention: Implement strategies to safeguard existing revenue, proactively identifying risks and addressing them before they impact the business.

  • Revenue Expansion: Collaborate with sales teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your accounts, contributing to overall revenue growth.

  • Contract Negotiation: Lead negotiations for renewals and expansions, working closely with legal and finance teams to structure favorable agreements.

  • Market Insights: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and client needs to offer informed recommendations that drive client value and satisfaction.

  • Collaboration: Partner with sales, customer success, and marketing teams to align on account strategies and ensure a cohesive approach to client growth.

  • Reporting & Metrics: Track and report on renewal rates, upsell success, and overall account health, using data to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

What will you bring?

  • Commercial Experience: Previous experience as an Account Manager or in a similar commercial role, with a strong track record in SaaS renewals and revenue growth.

  • Cyber Security Knowledge: A solid understanding of the cyber security landscape, particularly in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).

  • Negotiation Skills: Proven ability to negotiate contracts and renewals, balancing client needs with company goals.

  • Strategic Mindset: Ability to think strategically about account growth, identifying opportunities for expansion and mitigating potential risks.

  • Data-driven: Proficient in using data to drive decisions, with a focus on metrics that impact renewals and revenue growth.

  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to drive account success.

  • We’re looking for someone who’s not just comfortable with change, but curious about it—especially when it comes to adopting AI tools that can enhance how we work

What will give you an edge?

  • Sales Background: Experience as an Account Executive or in a similar sales role, with a strong understanding of the commercial aspects of SaaS renewals.

  • Industry-Specific Knowledge: Deep understanding of the cyber security industry, particularly in the context of SaaS solutions.

  • Advanced Negotiation Skills: Expertise in structuring and negotiating complex contracts, particularly in a SaaS environment.

  • Proven Success in SaaS Renewals: Demonstrated success in driving high renewal rates and identifying revenue expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Cyber Security Certifications: Relevant certifications in cyber security or TPRM that demonstrate your expertise and commitment to the field.

jobs.title: Sr People Partner
jobs.description:
Vantage is growing, and we need a Sr People Partner to help our leaders become great ones. Your core client group is engineering managers, along with new managers and team leads across the business. Your job is to build a culture where coaching drives performance and where people feel it in their day-to-day experience at Vantage. You model the leadership you coach. You give managers candid advice, earn trust through sound judgment and follow-through, and hold leaders accountable for how they lead.

This is a hands-on business partner role. You’ll coach managers through difficult conversations, run performance cycles that focus on growth as much as evaluation and handle employee relations from first concern to resolution. You will lead projects that shape how we define and measure great work and use onboarding, exit interviews and people data to keep improving the employee experience. You’ll also advise on employment compliance across Canada, the US and the UK, support compensation planning, and help build fair, consistently applied policies.

Key Responsibilities

Business Partnering & Manager Coaching

  • Be the primary people partner for employees, people leaders and team leads across the business.

  • Equip managers to drive high performance through clear goals, ongoing feedback and real accountability, so great work gets recognized and issues get fixed early.

  • Build manager habits that drive a culture of performance: setting clear goals, coaching in the moment, recognizing top performers, and acting quickly when performance slips.

  • Advise on and manage employee relations matters, including performance improvement plans, written warnings, and terminations.

  • Help design and launch a leadership training program for new and developing managers.

Performance Management

  • Run the 90-day and Annual Review processes for your client groups, from manager preparation through to follow-up.

  • Help define our competencies and what great work looks like at Vantage, and build them into how we measure performance.

  • Build career planning frameworks that give employees a clear view of how they can grow here.

  • Own ER cases from first concern to resolution, including investigations into harassment and misconduct complaints.

  • Manage accommodations and leaves across jurisdictions with our Payroll and Benefits Specialist.

  • Escalate and partner with the Head of People on higher-risk matters.

Programs, Policy & Compliance

  • Refine People reporting so leaders have the data they need to make decisions.

  • Create company content that explains our people programs, policies, and changes.

  • Own the multi-jurisdiction handbook and support policy rollouts and manager training.

  • Prepare offer, promotion and merit recommendations using market data and our compensation philosophy.

  • Advise on employment standards across Ontario, BC, Alberta, the US (including California) and the UK through our EOR.

Employee Experience

  • Own and improve onboarding and exit interviews to improve the employee experience and lifecycle.

  • Support company events and initiatives, including in-person days, recruiting events, company retreats, and employee resource groups.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in an HR Business Partner role.

  • Experience at a scaling SaaS or technology company including experience partnering with engineering teams.

  • Hands-on ER experience, including investigations, PIPs and terminations.

  • Strong knowledge of performance management, competency frameworks.

  • Sound judgment, discretion with confidential information, and the confidence to give leaders direct coaching and feedback.

  • Experience with comp planning or pay equity.

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

As Manager, Technical Enablement, you will be the founding people leader of a dedicated technical enablement function, built to support our large and growing global Sales Engineering team. Our Sales Engineers are central to how we win, and as the team scales, it needs enablement that matches the depth of the work. You will hire, lead, and develop a team of enablement professionals, and you will serve as a player-coach, contributing directly to the programs your team delivers.

Working in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement and global Sales Engineering leadership, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement. You will identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and build the technical onboarding, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that take our field well beyond foundational product knowledge. You will partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to turn each release into field-ready technical content, and you will measure readiness and program effectiveness so that the function earns its place as a trusted partner to the field and to leadership.

Technologies You’ll Use

Notion, Salesforce, Gong, Thought Industries, Claude, Sumble, Hex, Nook, Jira, Navan, Nooks, Sales Navigator, AI role play tools

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement for the global Field Engineering team
  • Lead and develop a team of enablement professionals while serving as a player-coach, contributing directly to the execution of team priorities.
  • Partner with global Field Engineering leadership to identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and prioritize readiness programs across regions.
  • Build and maintain deep technical product training, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that go beyond foundational seller education.
  • Define technical onboarding curriculum, ramp milestones, and proficiency benchmarks in partnership with the existing onboarding team.
  • Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to translate releases and product differentiation into field-ready technical content and practical exercises.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Revenue Enablement to connect seller-facing technical fluency with advanced solution discovery, demonstrations, evaluations, and technical sales processes.
  • Build a structured feedback loop between field teams and Product, and measure technical readiness, training adoption, demo environment health, and program effectiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional programs through influence, clear stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution in a global matrix environment.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, field engineering, or related technical go-to-market roles, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs or teams.
  • Previous people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing team members

jobs.title: Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler
jobs.description:
About us

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.

Here's what you will do

  • Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation
  • Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies
  • Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together
  • Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems
  • Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization.
  • Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.
  • Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation
  • Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus
  • Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation
  • Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning
  • Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus
  • Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.
  • A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture
  • A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

jobs.title: Marketing Campaigns and Programs Associate
jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

We're looking for a highly organized, creative, and results-driven Marketing Campaigns and Programs Associate to help plan, run, and scale the campaigns and growth marketing programs that put Harness in front of developers, platform engineers, and DevOps leaders. In this role, you'll own the day-to-day execution of our webinar program, both Harness-hosted and third-party, from vendor sourcing and speaker management through promotion and results reporting, while also supporting marketing campaigns and additional growth marketing programs as needed.

You'll partner closely with demand generation, content, product marketing, field marketing, and sales to turn great ideas into repeatable, measurable programs. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves operational excellence, and is eager to find creative ways to scale what works.

  • Bring creative thinking to operationalize and scale demand generation programs, building repeatable playbooks and processes.
  • Support marketing campaigns and additional growth marketing programs.

  • Experience reporting on program results, with a data-driven approach to measuring performance and informing next steps.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple programs, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally with marketing, content, product marketing, sales, and external partners.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where creativity meets accountability.
  • Creative thinker who finds ways to operationalize and scale demand generation programs through process, automation, and testing.

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, or developer-focused growth marketing.
  • Familiarity with fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with growth marketing programs and campaign management.
  • Interest in AI, DevOps, and software delivery.

Work Location

U.S. Remote

What you will have at Harness

  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Pay transparency

Harness in the news:

  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. jobs.title: Associate Counsel, Vendor and Provider Contracting
jobs.description:
Clover Health’s legal team is a group of proactive business partners whose mission is to empower the organization to innovate and achieve its goals within a dynamic and fluid regulatory environment. We are committed to supporting continued excellence for our customers while building a sustainable future for the organization. We believe integrity, collaboration, and sustainability ensures Clover Health exceeds its objectives, while upholding the highest standards of legal and ethical responsibility.

Clover is looking for an attorney with three to five years of experience to join our Legal team and support vendor and healthcare provider contracting. As Associate Counsel, you will independently draft, review, negotiate, and manage agreements that enable Clover’s health plan, clinical, technology, and corporate operations.

You will advise business teams throughout the vendor lifecycle—from initial evaluation and contracting through implementation, ongoing performance, renewal, and termination. You will help Clover establish commercial terms, protect sensitive information, address regulatory requirements, and develop practical solutions that support the company’s business objectives.

You will collaborate with stakeholders across Network, Clinical, Compliance, Procurement, Technology, Information Security, Privacy, Finance, and Operations. This role is well suited to an attorney who has meaningful contracting experience, exercises sound judgment, and is interested in developing deeper expertise at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and value-based care.

As an Associate Counsel, Vendor and Provider Contracting , you will:

Vendor and Commercial Contracting

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of vendor and commercial agreements, including master services agreements, statements of work, software licenses, professional and consulting services agreements, data-use and data-sharing agreements, nondisclosure agreements, business associate agreements, data protection addenda, order forms, and amendments.
  • Support agreements with vendors providing technology, cloud hosting, data analytics, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, clinical services, claims administration, member engagement, care management, provider data, credentialing, pharmacy-related services, utilization management, marketing, staffing, facilities, and other operational services.
  • Structure agreements to clearly define deliverables, implementation responsibilities, acceptance criteria, performance standards, service levels, pricing, invoicing, change-control procedures, and governance processes.
  • Evaluate and negotiate provisions concerning intellectual property ownership, licensing rights, data ownership and use, confidentiality, information security, privacy, artificial intelligence, subcontracting, insurance, indemnification, limitation of liability, audit rights, business continuity, disaster recovery, regulatory cooperation, and dispute resolution.
  • Advise business teams on contract renewals, pricing changes, scope expansions, performance issues, service-level failures, disputes, corrective-action plans, termination rights, transition assistance, and data return or destruction.
  • Partner with Privacy and Information Security teams to evaluate agreements involving protected health information, personally identifiable information, confidential business information, security reviews, incident notification, and vendor access to Clover systems or data.
  • Help address requirements applicable to Medicare Advantage vendors and first-tier, downstream, and related entities, including compliance obligations and cooperation with Clover’s vendor-oversight activities.
  • Identify business and legal risks during vendor selection and contract negotiations, clearly explain available options, and develop practical risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate with Procurement and business owners to promote consistent contracting practices and ensure that appropriate legal, compliance, privacy, security, financial, and operational reviews occur before execution.
  • Independently manage routine and moderately complex negotiations and escalate novel, high-risk, or strategically significant matters when appropriate.
  • Develop and improve vendor templates, clause libraries, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, approval standards, and contract-management processes.
  • Support contract intake, approvals, execution, recordkeeping, obligation tracking, renewals, amendments, and terminations.

Provider Contracting

  • Draft, review, and negotiate healthcare provider agreements, including participation agreements, amendments, value-based arrangements, and agreements with physician groups, facilities, ancillary providers, and other healthcare organizations.
  • Advise on provisions involving reimbursement, claims and payment, performance measures, quality standards, data exchange, credentialing, access, member protections, regulatory compliance, audit rights, records, and termination.
  • Collaborate with Network, Clinical, Operations, Compliance, and Finance teams to support provider relationships and contracting strategies.
  • Assist with resolving provider contract interpretation, performance, reimbursement, and operational issues.
  • Support the development and maintenance of provider agreement templates, amendments, and contracting guidance.

Legal Partnership and Operations

  • Provide timely, practical, and risk-based advice to internal business partners.
  • Conduct legal research concerning Medicare Advantage, managed care, healthcare contracting, privacy, technology, and general commercial matters.
  • Monitor assigned matters and communicate clearly and promptly with stakeholders and Legal team leadership.
  • Help create training materials and educate business teams about contracting requirements and effective vendor-management practices.
  • Support other Legal team priorities as Clover’s business evolves.

Success in this role looks like:

  • You approach legal questions with curiosity, care, and sound judgment.
  • You communicate complicated legal concepts in clear, practical language.
  • You can independently manage contract negotiations while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.
  • You understand that effective contracting requires attention to commercial, operational, regulatory, privacy, and security considerations.
  • You balance legal and regulatory risk with Clover’s operational and business objectives.
  • You are highly organized and can manage multiple agreements, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • You enjoy working collaboratively in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • You are motivated by Clover’s mission and interested in healthcare, technology, and improving outcomes for Medicare beneficiaries.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • You have active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • You have three to five years of relevant legal experience in a law firm, in-house legal department, government agency, or comparable setting.
  • You have experience independently drafting, reviewing, and negotiating vendor, commercial, or healthcare provider agreements.
  • You have demonstrated ability to identify contractual risks and propose practical solutions.
  • You have strong legal research, analytical, drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • You have excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities with limited supervision.
  • You have authorization to practice in and work from the jurisdiction in which you will be employed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have experience working for or advising a health plan, health insurer, managed care organization, or other healthcare payer.
  • You have experience negotiating agreements with vendors supporting health plans or healthcare operations.
  • You have experience negotiating healthcare provider agreements, including participation, reimbursement, value-based care, facility, physician group, or ancillary provider agreements.
  • You have experience with technology, software, cloud services, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, professional services, or other complex vendor agreements.
  • You have familiarity with Medicare Advantage and the laws and regulations applicable to health plans, including CMS requirements, HIPAA, the federal Anti-Kickback Statute, and the Stark Law.
  • You have an understanding of health plan operations, provider networks, claims, reimbursement, delegated functions, utilization management, or vendor oversight.
  • You have familiarity with privacy, information-security, artificial-intelligence, or healthcare data issues.
  • You have experience using contract lifecycle management, matter-management, procurement, or electronic-signature platforms.

Candidates do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We encourage applications from thoughtful, motivated attorneys who are excited to grow with Clover.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
