jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales Field Operations, Americas
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

The Director of AMER Enterprise Sales Field Operations is the primary operations partner to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales. You will own the operating rhythm of the region: forecasting, pipeline generation and inspection, and business reviews. You will also shape the region's go-to-market strategy, expansion plans, and capacity model. In this role, you will act as the COO to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales, ensuring our business is growing efficiently and effectively. You need to think strategically about the Enterprise business, understanding the implications of changing market and team dynamics and proactively developing solutions that enable us to win.

You will lead a team of three field operations managers and analysts. Success in this role means a more accurate forecast, a healthier pipeline, measurable gains in rep productivity, and increasing ARR across AMER Enterprise. The work you do will shape how Fivetran grows in the Americas.

This role sits within the GTM Strategy and Operations organization.

What You’ll Do

Forecasting and pipeline

  • Own the AMER Enterprise forecast process, including call methodology, roll-up, and accuracy tracking against commit and best case, giving leadership a number they can commit to with confidence.

  • Drive pipeline generation planning: with the marketing, partner, and sales leadership teams set coverage targets by segment and source, track progress, and flag gaps early enough to act, so each quarter starts with the pipeline needed to hit plan.

  • Run pipeline inspection with sales leadership, focusing on deal quality, stage progression, and slippage, so risk surfaces while there is still time to save the deal.

Operating cadence and performance management

  • Design and run the region's operating cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Continuously refine those cadences so they drive decisions rather than reporting.

  • Run AE performance reviews with frontline and second-line managers, using consistent metrics to identify coaching needs and performance risk, so managers act on facts rather than anecdotes.

  • Identify and prioritize the metrics the field uses to run the business, and partner with GTM Analytics to build and maintain the supporting dashboards, giving every leader in the region a shared view of performance.

  • Lead deep-dive investigations into performance questions, and turn findings into specific recommendations that change how the region sells.

Regional strategy

  • Shape GTM strategy and org structure for AMER Enterprise by region and sales motion, setting the team up to win as enterprise AI demand grows.

  • Build the analysis behind regional expansion decisions, such as which territories to enter next and in what sequence, so we invest where the opportunity is largest.

  • Design region- and motion-specific SPIFFs, then measure whether they changed behavior and results.

Annual planning and capacity (in partnership with Strategy and Planning)

  • Support quota setting for the region, bringing field context to top-down targets so quotas are both ambitious and attainable.

  • Support and refine territory carving so territories are balanced and match the coverage model.

  • Pressure-test assumptions in the bottoms-up headcount model and coverage ratios, so hiring plans reflect real field performance.

  • Validate rep productivity and ramp assumptions against actual performance data.

Team leadership

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of field operations managers and analysts and grow them into strategic partners to sales leadership.

  • Set clear priorities for the team and allocate its capacity against the needs of AMER Enterprise leadership.

Who you'll work with

  • VP of AMER Enterprise Sales and their leadership team: your primary stakeholders and day-to-day partners.

  • Strategy and Planning: annual plan, quota, territory, and capacity modeling.

  • Revenue Operations: CRM, systems, process, and data integrity.

  • GTM Analytics: dashboards, reporting, and analytical deep dives.

  • Enablement: onboarding, ramp, and skill gaps surfaced through performance reviews.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in sales operations, sales strategy, management consulting, or a related analytical role, including 4+ years supporting enterprise sales teams directly.

  • 4+ years managing people, ideally analysts or operations managers.

  • Track record of owning a forecast process and improving its accuracy.

  • Experience running sales operating cadences and business reviews with senior sales leaders.

  • Working knowledge of annual planning: quota setting, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and ramp assumptions.

  • Strong analytical skills, including building models in spreadsheets and working with CRM and BI data (for example, Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, or SQL).

  • Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and defend it with sales leaders.

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with a consumption-based or usage-based pricing model.

  • Experience designing sales incentive programs or SPIFFs.

  • Experience supporting regional expansion or new-segment launches.

  • Prior experience as the dedicated operations partner to a regional sales leader.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer | Identity Foundations
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to our Identity Foundations (IDF) team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We’re looking for an autonomous and resourceful engineer to join our international Identity Foundations (IDF) team, which owns critical services at the heart of our product—including our login engine, session management, and single sign-on (SSO). You’ll build features that sit at the spine of the platform, powering experiences used by millions of users while tackling complex engineering challenges around performance, reliability, and multi-region scalability. You’ll also play a key role in driving our AI transformation, leveraging AI-assisted development to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and build seamless, reliable identity foundations.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own end-to-end projects from technical design through implementation, rollout, and production operation—impacting critical red-route authentication workflows for users, clients, and partners through heavy testing, organization, and strategic execution.
  • Build and evolve maintainable, reliable, and scalable backend services that operate at massive scale across different regions, continuously identifying ways to improve production systems.
  • Drive our AI transformation by leveraging LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and elevate problem-solving workflows.
  • Author technical documentation, such as RFCs, to articulate architectural ideas, share knowledge, and actively engage in reviewing peers' proposals.
  • Deliver committed initiatives across tactical cycles to help the company achieve its core strategic goals.
  • Champion a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture by monitoring rollouts, guaranteeing quality through comprehensive testing, and responding effectively to bugs and production incidents.
  • Collaborate within an agile, people-first environment by exchanging constructive feedback on growth, successes, and mistakes to help your team develop professionally and foster a great place to work.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced backend engineer with years of experience building and operating production backend systems, with expertise in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang highly desirable.
  • A distributed systems specialist with strong experience designing and scaling APIs, data-intensive applications, cloud-native architectures on platforms like AWS, and scalable databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • A cloud-native practitioner with hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and operating services in production using Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms, alongside Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision components like databases, caches, lambdas, and CDN configurations.
  • An infrastructure and reliability-minded builder experienced in asynchronous processing using message brokers (such as Kafka, SQS/SNS, or RabbitMQ) and production observability tools (such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus).
  • An AI-fluent technologist who thoughtfully leverages modern LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to enhance engineering workflows and solve complex technical problems.
  • An autonomous, end-to-end owner who makes thoughtful technical decisions, embraces a "you build it, you run it" mindset, and independently drives projects from design to production operation.
  • A clear and confident communicator who thrives in collaborative, agile environments that prioritize people over process—comfortable influencing technical decisions, sharing ideas across teams, and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.
This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a growth mindset, be inclusive and win as a team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with customers and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
  • Bilingual (Spanish and English) is required
  • Strong spoken and written language skills for working with multiple teams and publishing documentation
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Candidate must be based in Monterrey, N.L., or willing to relocate

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders and operational teams.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: Executives, Day-to-day users of our software
  • Experience serving a large and complex customer base in B2B SaaS
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
  • Experience working with different countries of the LATAM regions preferred, but not required
  • Experience working in Tech Touch Engagements
  • Experience using Customer Success Platforms

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Director AI Native Product Builder in our New Ventures area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Wellhub serves millions of members today. The next generation of wellness experiences they are waiting for (deeper personalization, integrated journeys across fitness, longevity and emotional wellbeing) does not yet exist inside our walls. New Ventures exists to build those products, at AI speed. Small squads own each bet end-to-end, from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, and scale. Every prototype starts with AI, and every workflow is rebuilt around it.

You will report directly to the Founder/GM of the bet you join and lead its builders as part of a small, single-threaded squad. You own the build end-to-end, minimizing friction and rethinking traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering. You will work daily with the Founder/GM, the bet's product manager, data and design craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents. This is a player-coach role: you lead people, and you are still in the work, directing AI to ship. The methods we prove in New Ventures are the methods that will shape future bets, and your work will connect directly to Wellhub's company goals: be loved, be global, be fit.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the build for your bet: take ambiguous problems from earliest hypothesis to a production-grade MVP and into scale, end-to-end.
  • Make AI the product fabric: embed AI as the core mechanic of the member experience, not a feature bolted on top, so the product would be impossible to recreate without it.
  • Compress cycle time: the metric that defines us is days from member insight to shipped experiment. Ship working prototypes in days and production-grade increments in weeks, and set the pace the squad has to match.
  • Set the AI-native bar for the squad: define the context, agents, prompts, evals, and ways of working every builder in the bet operates at, and make the bar visible by shipping above it yourself.
  • Build foundations that compound: when a pattern (agent harness, eval framework, prompt library, shared context) is reusable, extract it and make it the default, so the next builder in New Ventures doesn't re-solve what you already shipped.
  • Lead and grow the builders in the bet: hire, coach, and develop the team. Run the rituals that pull everyone up the AI curve (pair, demo, document, teach). Before approving a hire, show why AI couldn't do the work.
  • Own quality and safety in production: partner with the product manager on evals and guardrails, so we know the AI is good enough before members do, and sensitive data is handled with care.
  • Stand behind kill decisions: when an experiment or a direction doesn't pan out, say so early. Killing on time is part of how a healthy portfolio operates.
  • Bring product taste and founder mentality: call great products great and bad products bad, make decisions with incomplete information, and move toward the unknown rather than away from it.
  • Live the mission: care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues', and build a team where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience shipping consumer or B2B SaaS products, hybrid by craft: deep fluency in product craft (discovery, UX, instrumentation, iteration) and modern engineering (architecture, systems, full-stack thinking). The combination is the role.
  • Shipped products to production at meaningful scale, from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, and scale, and comfortable killing a hypothesis that didn't pan out.
  • Deep, hands-on AI fluency: you use modern AI tooling (AI-assisted IDEs, agent frameworks, LLM APIs) every day, and hold strong, evidence-backed opinions on prompts, evals, retrieval, and model selection.
  • Fluent across the AI-native disciplines: context engineering as infrastructure, agentic development as your primary execution model (direct, execute, review, iterate), and vibe coding to compress build-measure-learn. You can teach all three.
  • Experience leading a team of builders or engineers as a player-coach: you teach by pairing, demoing, and documenting, and you don't delegate the interesting work and review slides about it.
  • Customer-centric to the core: you can name the customer problem behind every product you've shipped, in the customer's own words.
  • Bias to ship, with taste: you ship Monday and iterate Tuesday, and you know which corners cannot be cut.
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook: you push back when the data says so, change your mind fast when shown new evidence, and are comfortable being a beginner again on the things AI changes every month.
  • Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

Nice to have:

  • Background in health, fitness, or wellbeing products.
  • Experience building AI products that handle sensitive personal or health data.
  • A track record of pulling a team or an organization toward a new way of working.
  • Exposure to products operating across multiple countries and languages.
  • Advanced Portuguese.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that deep hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling and concepts (AI-assisted development, agent frameworks, LLM APIs, evals, prompt design), a track record of shipping consumer or B2B products at scale, and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Consultant (ISM/ESM)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Engagement Services Consultant (ESC), Integrations is a new, consultant-level role within Samsara's Engagement Services team in Customer Success. You will partner directly with our largest Enterprise customers in a focused, roughly three-month engagement to understand their operational processes, map how those processes connect to the Samsara platform, and translate that understanding into a well-defined, build-ready request for our Solutions Integration Services (SIS) team.

This role complements the Engagement Services Manager (ESM) and SIS teams. It ensures every integration request reaches SIS with validated requirements, aligned stakeholders, and documented processes. This role can be office-based or fully remote.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

. Discover and define processes (weeks 1–6)

  • Run structured discovery with customer stakeholders to document current-state processes and systems.
  • Facilitate workshops to map future-state process flows and identify where data must be sent, received, or transformed.
  • Build a systems and API inventory covering data volumes, authentication constraints, and regulatory or data-residency considerations.
  • Engage SIS early for lightweight feasibility checks so blockers surface before build.
  1. Package requirements (weeks 6–10)
  • Turn findings into a prioritized requirements package: use cases, field-level data mappings, success criteria, and open risks.
  • Validate the package with customer stakeholders and the internal account team (CSM, ESM, Sales Engineer).
  • Complete and submit the SIS Request Log so scoping starts from a validated baseline.
  1. Hand off and transition (weeks 10–12)
  • Join the initial SIS/ESM scoping meeting to preserve context and answer requirements questions directly.
  • Support the ESM during SOW drafting where scope or customer intent needs clarification.
  • Formally close the discovery engagement once SIS and the ESM confirm the request is ready for build, with documentation handed off in full.

Ongoing

  • Track engagement status, milestones, and timelines in Salesforce and Compass.
  • Maintain a library of discovery templates and playbooks by integration type, and share lessons learned with the teams that originate requests.
  • Champion Samsara's cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Speed - Short time from kickoff to a request SIS accepts without further scoping clarification
  • Quality - Requests that need no rework during SIS and ESM scoping.
  • Cycle time - Faster path from Request Log to signed SOW compared with baseline.
  • Customer experience - Strong discovery-phase CSAT and feedback from Enterprise stakeholders.
  • Portfolio impact - More Enterprise accounts moving from an unscoped integration need to a signed, in-build SIS project each quarter.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years in a customer-facing consulting, business/systems analysis, solutions consulting, or implementation role, ideally in enterprise SaaS or IoT software.
  • Experience running structured discovery with enterprise customers: stakeholder interviews, current- vs. future-state process mapping, and requirements gathering.
  • Working understanding of APIs and system-integration concepts; comfortable in technical conversations without needing to write integration code.
  • Strong facilitation, synthesis, and documentation skills, with the ability to turn cross-functional conversations into an actionable requirements document.
  • Track record managing multi-month, multi-stakeholder engagements independently, with ownership of timeline and quality.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with integrations involving fleet/telematics, ERP, WMS, TMS/dispatch, HRIS, or fuel-card systems.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and services/project-tracking tools.
  • Background as a Solutions Consultant, Sales/Solutions Engineer, Professional Services consultant, or Business/Systems Analyst.
  • Experience supporting Mexico and broader LatAm Enterprise accounts.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

  • Shadow the ESM and SIS teams on 2–3 active integration engagements to learn the Request Log, scoping, and SOW process end to end.
  • Complete SIS Office Hours and Request Log training, and review prior SIS project documentation for common integration patterns.
  • Take ownership of a first discovery engagement with an Enterprise account, with an ESM as coach.
  • Deliver a first fully validated requirements package and SIS Request Log independently by the end of the quarter.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - DACH
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working across EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. We already work with some well-known teams in the region, and we’ve recently announced an EMEA data centre. We want to invest properly in the community there, and we know that needs to be led by someone local. Someone who knows the market, speaks the language and understands how TA teams in the region actually work. You’ll own the DACH community end to end, from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in Germany regularly, plus travel to another DACH (or wider EMEA) country every month, usually for around four days. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine and a TA leader workshop with a partner at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices in Stockholm, our company offsite in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London.

What you’ll do

  • Lead DACH Community Events

    • Run community events across target DACH markets. Event types might include:

      • Customer learning breakfasts

      • A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects

      • Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players

    • Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders

    • Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps

    • Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

  • Drive Customer Education

    • Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content

    • Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics

    • Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program

    • Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

  • Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy

    • Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully

    • Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA

    • Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits

    • Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

  • You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

  • You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

  • You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

  • You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

  • You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

  • You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

  • You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

  • You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

  • You’re fluent in German and English, and have a strong understanding of how hiring works in DACH

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

  • You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

  • You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

  • You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

  • You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

  • You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

  • You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

  • You’re uncomfortable with moderating discussions or being a speaker

  • You’d rather focus purely on the community side and aren’t keen to understand how it connects to the wider business

  • You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs across the DACH region

  • You aren’t fluent in both German and English

Interview Plan

  • Recruiter Screen with Kayla/Willem - 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

  • Cross-functional Panel - 1 hour

  • Assignment (written) - 2 hours

    • Followed by Assignment Review with Kayla - 30 Minutes

  • Final Round - 1-1.5 hours

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

jobs.title: Core Account Executive - DACH
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you a high-achieving sales professional ready to digitally transform the physical operations that power our planet? Samsara is seeking a driven Enterprise (Core) Account Executive to introduce our cutting-edge Connected Operations® Platform to Enterprise-sized customers across the DACH region. This is a unique opportunity to sell a much-needed product into a historically underserved market, working directly with leaders to drive real-world impact and unlock significant career progression. As a Strategic AE you will be helping large mid-market and enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

Whilst the individual can work remotely anywhere in Germany, the role will entail travel to customer sites across the region as required


In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices


Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in Enterprise level accounts, winning multiple $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Proven expertise winning new business logos through a repeatable sales motion
  • Demonstrable expertise in strategic outbound prospecting, particularly via inside sales
  • Experience handling enterprise deal sizes with multiple stakeholders at C-Level
  • Value based selling approach, leveraging Command of the Message, MEDDPICC or similar
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Native-level German language skills


An ideal candidate also has:

  • SaaS sales experience
  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience or similar (Sandler Pain Funnel, etc)
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset.
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: 1199 - QA Engineer
jobs.description:

Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

We need an English-proficient QA Engineer, based in Guadalajara, Mexico availability to work in a hybrid setting.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.

Are you the one we are looking for?

Responsibilities:

  • Work with product and development teams to develop, automate, and execute the required comprehensive tests against specified requirements and use case scenarios.

  • Participate in product development early on during the development life cycle, create the necessary test infrastructure and test setup, and help with early integration testing.

  • Drive SaaS & Cloud testing strategy to deliver in a continuous delivery model.

  • Continually assess and evaluate existing test cases/suites with an objective of identifying and eliminating potential gaps in test coverage.

  • Good knowledge of Cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), Networking, HTTP/HTTPS.

  • Experience in developing and running performance and scalability testing of cloud applications.

  • Experience executing Functional, Non-Functional, Integration, System, Regression, and End-to-End testing.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE
jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer-centric Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will play a crucial role as a technical solution expert and advisor working closely with some of the largest Harness AppSec customers to design, implement and optimize Harness platform and adoption strategies to ensure they realize maximum value and outcomes.

Our team is small, collaborative, and deeply motivated — we work at the intersection of technology, security, and business, and we bring curiosity and rigor to a wide range of challenges. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a rapidly growing company while helping customers harness the power of our AI-enabled DevSecOps platform to build and deliver software securely and efficiently — including protecting AI applications from emerging threats.

We prioritize psychological safety, mentorship, and continuous learning. Whether you're coming from engineering, architecture, consulting, or security — we want to hear from you.

About the role

  • Serve as the primary technical owner of customer implementations and adoption programs across the Harness AppSec portfolio, developing deep familiarity with each customer's environment, goals, and success criteria
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and consulting to customers throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and implementation to adoption and value realization.
  • Develop strategic account success plans to ensure successful operationalization and value realization and drive alignment with all levels of customer leadership.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Harness platform and AppSec modules as well as general skillset across AI applications and security, DevOps, SecOps, application security, cloud architectures, networks and infrastructure disciplines and industry trends to effectively support, educate and advise customers.
  • Proactively analyze customer usage data to surface trends, adoption gaps, and optimization opportunities — delivering actionable recommendations across technology, process, and people dimensions.
  • Bring constructive feedback from customers to product management to improve the solution, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and engineering, to drive the successful adoption, integration, and ongoing optimization of our solution.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and check-ins with customers to ensure their ongoing success and satisfaction, addressing any concerns or issues in a timely and effective manner.
  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts by performing churn and adoption analysis to ensure target product adoption and business (AGRR) goals are met.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of customer success processes, tools, and resources to continuously improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our customer success delivery methodologies and collateral.
  • Participate in Harness Community forums and help build reference architectures, best-practice guides, and enablement content

About you

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, security engineering, or technical account management within the software or technology industry.
  • 5+ years of experience with some multiple of the following solutions preferred:
    • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, CloudFormation, Linux
    • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, OpenShift, PCF
    • CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Harness Pipelines, Jira, ServiceNow.
    • Languages & Scripting: Python, Bash, YAML, Go (a plus).
    • Application Security: SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, SBOM generation, API security testing, pen testing fundamentals, SIEM (Splunk, Datadog), SOAR platforms.
  • Prior experience in security engineering and architecture, application security, API and AI security, development, DevOps, SecOps, or web security is preferred.
  • Ability to quickly learn, understand, and work with new emerging technologies and solutions in the AI, DevOps, Cloud and Security space.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to manage complex customer relationships and communicate business and technical value to all levels of management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and growth.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering is preferred

Must Have Skills

  • Kubernetes eco system expertise (k8s, helm, release, upgrade, troubleshooting etc)
  • In depth Cloud experience - AWS is a must (GCP, Azure good to have) - infra provisioning, VPC++ ,EKS, S3, EBS ,EFS, EC2 etc
  • Linux ecosystem
  • Troubleshooting skills for the above
  • Programming (Scripting) experience along with ability to write custom integrations or tailored

Pay transparency

$180,000—$202,000 USD

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role Description:

Being a Product Manager at Defense Unicorns is more than just being part of the sparkliest Product team in defense tech. It means taking radical ownership over real products that make a real impact on real people. At Defense Unicorns, our mission is to make software a strategic deterrent, and our Product Management team clears the path.

In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Product and work with teams who deliver outcomes that are critical business enablers and directly support both our missions and other internal teams. This team’s primary responsibility is the creation and maintenance of tooling and pipelines that support UDS application packaging, as well as maintenance of several packages which comprise our core software deliverables.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

  • Passion for the intersection of business, open-source software, and national security
  • Participate in and foster open source communities around Defense Unicorns’ open source projects
  • Comfortable owning a product vision end-to-end and being accountable for delivering to several customer segments, including both paid and OSS
  • Managing the expectations and delivery of outcomes of unicorns engineers entrusted to you
  • Establishing and clearly communicating vision and objectives at all levels of the company - from engineers to executives
  • Continuously balance customer, business, and technical priorities with limited resources
  • Synthesizing external customer requests into an internal product roadmap
  • Discipline required to work in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Keep our Growth and Delivery teams aligned on roadmap and value proposition in order to support product pricing, customer segmentation, and customer needs
  • Experience managing, updating and using task, information and code management tools like GitHub, Notion, Hubspot, Google Workspace, etc.
  • Continuous learning is a must. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in Product Management, DevOps, regulated IT, and the CNCF community
  • Experience working with and continuously delivering software under Agile software development principles
  • Understand business strategy and adapt product strategy and roadmap to accomplish company objectives
  • Comfortable presenting information in customer facing engagements
  • Comfortable having technical conversations which engineering and design to trade off roadmap versus engineering effort needed

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • A deep understanding of how DevSecOps pipelines operate and the tools which make them work
  • An understanding of core Kubernetes concepts, specifically images, Helm charts, and related technologies.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and metrics for informed decision-making
  • Experience establishing a clear product roadmap and value proposition to prospective customers
  • Knowledge of and experience with monetization models for open source software

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA

$170,850—$231,150 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CCPA DISCLOSURE

jobs.title: Field Coordination Specialist
jobs.description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance.   • Some college preferred. 4 year degree, highly preferred
