jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
This role is part of our Ayrshare team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

Ayrshare is a social media API. Developers use it to post, schedule and pull analytics on networks like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, X and YouTube from inside their own products.

Profile Overview

As our Sales Development Representative, you'll own the top of Ayrshare's outbound funnel. This is a majority outbound role: you'll find companies building social features into their products, reach the right people before they've heard of Ayrshare, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. Most of your day goes on account research, cold calls and cold emails.

Our buyers are mostly technical: product managers, CTOs and founders at SaaS companies, agencies and multi-location brands. You don't need to write code, but you'll learn how an API works well enough to explain why ours saves a team months of work. If you're curious about how software gets built and enjoy the craft of outbound, this is a chance to make a direct, measurable impact on a growing API business.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Learn Ayrshare's product, API use cases and ideal customer profile well enough to explain our value to technical buyers with confidence.
  • Build your first target account lists with our Account Executives and launch multi-step outbound sequences across call, email, LinkedIn and video.
  • Consistently book qualified meetings and hit your monthly targets for meetings booked and pipeline created from outbound.
  • Share early learnings on what messaging and channels work, and what you're hearing from prospects, with sales, marketing and product.

Your responsibilities

  • Build target account lists with Account Executives, focused on SaaS platforms, agencies and multi-location brands that need social features, and research each account to find the right people to contact.
  • Run multi-step outbound sequences by cold call, cold email, LinkedIn and short personal videos, with outreach that refers to what each prospect is building, not generic templates.
  • Keep a high, steady daily pace of calls and personalized emails.
  • Run short discovery calls with prospects who reply, to learn what they're building and whether Ayrshare fits, then book qualified meetings and hand over clear notes.
  • Track reply and meeting rates, test new messages and channels, and share what works and what you hear from prospects with sales, marketing and product.
  • Meet monthly targets for meetings booked and pipeline created from outbound.

What You bring to the table

  • Technical curiosity: You're curious about software, developer tools and how products are built. Our customers include dozens of AI businesses, so you can speak their language and get excited about their products.
  • Outbound resilience: You're comfortable cold calling every day and with hearing "no" often.
  • Discipline and organization: You keep a high, steady level of activity and manage many prospects at once without losing track.
  • Research skills: You can find the right person at a company and a real reason to contact them.
  • Coachability and communication: You're open to coaching and feedback, and you're fluent in English.
  • AI Literacy & Application: You actively use AI tools to enhance personal productivity and work quality, staying curious about emerging capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply AI pragmatically in day-to-day work.

Nice to have:

  • Experience prospecting into SaaS companies, or selling APIs and developer tools to technical buyers.
  • Experience with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and a sequencing or contact data tool.
  • Knowledge of the social media management market.

What’s in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

Ayrshare is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

  • Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

  • Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

  • Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

  • Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

  • Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

  • Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

  • Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

  • Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

  • Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

  • Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

  • A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

  • Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

  • Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

  • Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

  • Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Our Benefits:

  • Annual remote expense budget.

  • Flexible PTO.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

  • Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

  • Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

  • Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Specialist focused on protective security, you will lead in the collection, engineering, analysis, and dissemination of threat intelligence to support corporate security, data center security, travel risk, supply chain security, and protective operations globally. You will bring domain expertise in geopolitics, terrorism, instability, and transnational threat actors and independently deliver high‑impact intelligence to cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and investigate potential physical threats to CoreWeave, its executives, employees, facilities, operations, and other assets using open-source (OSINT), investigative tools, and structured analytical techniques.
  • Conduct persons of interest (POI) and behavioral threat investigations to evaluate the credibility, intent, capability, and potential severity of identified threats and provide appropriate risk mitigation recommendations.
  • Identify and manage intelligence pipelines and analytical tooling to integrate geospatial, OSINT, proprietary, and commercial threat feeds.
  • Monitor global events, conflict zones, transnational crime, terrorism, civil unrest, political instability, and state-sponsored threats, translating them into risk assessments relevant to business operations and personnel.
  • Produce forward-looking threat intelligence products: strategic forecasts, operational risk alerts, incident briefs, heat maps, geospatial overlays, and dashboards.
  • Serve as a partner to global security, resilience, executive protection, data center security, supply chain security, and other business units to contextualize and operationalize intelligence.
  • Automate early warning systems (alerts, triggers, thresholds) and integrate threat intelligence directly into security and business operations workflows.
  • Conduct post-incident analyses and drive lessons learned to improve detection, alerting, and mitigation processes.
  • Establish and own technical standards, architectural design, and best practices for threat intelligence systems.
  • Leverage advanced analytical tools, automation, and emerging technologies to improve threat detection, investigations, assessments, and the broader intelligence cycle.
  • Mentor and guide junior analysts or engineers (where applicable), share domain knowledge, and contribute to continuous improvement of the team.
  • Engage with external intelligence vendors, academic institutions, open-source communities, and government/law enforcement counterparts (as permitted) to enrich intelligence inputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, Security Studies, Political Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent. Advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in threat intelligence, intelligence analysis, physical security, or related domain.
  • Strong command of the threat intelligence lifecycle: requirements development, collection, processing, analysis, production, dissemination, feedback.
  • Deep knowledge of geopolitical risk, state instability, terrorism, organized crime, and regional dynamics.
  • Experience operationalizing intelligence in support of security operations (travel, crisis, executive protection, facility security).
  • Excellent communication skills: ability to brief senior leadership, distill complex scenarios into actionable recommendations, write polished reports.
  • Strong judgment, intellectual autonomy, and ability to manage ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.
  • Willingness to travel (regional or international) when required to support field operations or site assessments.
  • Familiarity with social media intelligence (SOCMINT).
  • Proven utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) in intelligence workflows

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in private-sector corporate security or critical infrastructure sectors.
  • Technical proficiency: scripting (Python, SQL, etc.), APIs, data engineering, familiarity with threat intelligence platforms (TIPs), geospatial systems (GIS), dashboards/visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with vendor management and intelligence partnerships.

The base salary range for this role is $182,000 to $242,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Walker Sands is one of the fastest-growing integrated B2B marketing agencies in the world. We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to help fuel that continued growth. The starting salary for this role is expected to be between $155,000 and $175,000 per year.

Walker Sands is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to join our DATA practice (Data, Analytics, Technology and AI) and help lead the data infrastructure behind our client reporting, measurement, internal operations, and AI-driven work.

This is a hands-on role, but not a heads-down one. Reporting to the SVP, DATA, you'll lead key technical parts of our data stack and be a strategic partner on where it goes next: what to build, what to buy, what to fix, and what actually matters to the business. You don't need a lot of direction and are comfortable working through ambiguity.

The role grows as you do. Near term, you'll work alongside our team and external partners to extend and strengthen the platform. Over time, you'll take on more of the technical ownership and help lead what comes next. And as the practice scales, you'll build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage.

What You Will Do (Responsibilities):

Data Engineering

  • Build and maintain pipelines and dbt models in Snowflake that are tested, documented, and trusted
  • Integrate data from paid media, web analytics, SEO, CRM, and business systems using tools like Fivetran or Airbyte and direct APIs
  • Find and fix breaks at the root, before an account team or client finds them
  • Maintain data governance: access controls, privacy, and consent requirements
  • Structure and document data so AI agents can use it reliable: clear semantic layers, consistent definitions, and metadata that tells an agent what a table or metric actually means
  • Build governed access patterns for agentic tools (scoped, read-only, permission aware) so agents only query the data they're allowed to, and their answers can be traced back to the source

Strategy + Partnership

  • Work with the SVP, DATA on architecture, roadmap, and build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions
  • Translate business and client needs into data designs that hold up, and push back when a request won't
  • Make data usable for analysts, reporting, and AI-driven tools through well-modeled, well-governed layers

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage, including the playbooks and escalation paths behind it
  • Eventually build out the team as needed for various functions to drive better accuracy, performance and data tools for the business

What You Bring (Requirements):

You've spent 7+ years in data engineering, enough of it in lean environments where you owned real things without much hand-holding. You can go deep on a broken pipeline in the morning and talk through a roadmap tradeoff in the afternoon, and you're good at both. You are a clear communicator, and work to understand needs beyond the technical with empathy and a ‘here’s what’s possible’ mindset.

You find problems, fix them, document them, and explain them without making them more complicated than they need to be.

    • 7+ years in data or analytics engineering, including time as the lead or senior technical owner on a production data platform
    • Deep, hands-on Snowflake experience
    • Strong dbt, advanced SQL, and working Python
    • Experience integrating SaaS and marketing APIs (ad platforms, GA4, Salesforce, HubSpot) through ELT tools and custom pipelines
    • A track record of shaping technical direction, not just executing tickets
    • Clear communication with technical and non-technical people alike

    Strong Pluses

    • Agency or B2B marketing data background
    • Data governance and privacy experience (role-based access, masking, consent data)
    • Experience making data usable for AI and LLM-driven tools
    • Experience leading or mentoring others
    • Comfortable using AI like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and bringing new ways of working within the data and privacy guardrails of the business

What We Offer (Compensation + Benefits):

  • Starting Salary: $155,000 - $175,000
    • Base salary is only a part of the total rewards package. Placement on the salary scale will be determined by a variety of factors to ensure internal equity.
    • Starting salaries are not inclusive of a full range of compensation for this role and are instead meant to reflect the expected beginning salary for a new hire. Merit-based increases can be earned after time in role.
  • 💰Bonus Potential: This role will be eligible for a bonus based on company performance.
  • 🌱Growth Opportunities: Clear career paths, mentorship programs, and learning events to help you grow professionally.
  • 🌴Flexible PTO and Hybrid Work: Take time as needed for vacations, mental health, or personal days. Includes 8 paid holidays, half-day summer Fridays, and a week off between Christmas and New Year.
  • 🩺 Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. Mental health resources, pet insurance, and more.
  • 📈Retirement Savings: Employer-matched 401(k) and access to financial planning services.
  • 🛡️ Additional Protection: Life insurance, disability coverage, and other benefits that provide added financial security.
  • 🧠 Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free, confidential support for you and your household, including counseling, mental health resources, and help navigating life’s everyday challenges.
  • 👶 Family Support: Paid leave for new parents and caregivers, plus policies for fertility treatment, pregnancy loss, adoption challenges, and more.
  • 🎯 Performance & Coaching: Regular performance reviews, clear goal-setting, and ongoing coaching to help you understand expectations, grow your skills, and make progress in your career.
  • 🎉 Milestone Sabbatical: Celebrate five years with a two-week sabbatical and a $2,000 gift.
  • 🤝 Community & Belonging: Employee resource groups, volunteer opportunities, and programs designed to build connection across the agency.
  • 🌟 Culture: Our agency offers an award-winning culture. Read more on our website here!

We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. As an equal opportunity employer Walker Sands is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and welcomes everyone to our team.

jobs.title: Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting Sr Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description

As a Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting Sr. Analyst on the Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting quarterly and annual external reporting, SEC filing coordination, and the broader close process. You will independently manage recurring reporting workstreams, help keep critical timelines on track, and contribute to accurate, thoughtful, and audit-ready external reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of financial reporting and technical accounting. In addition to coordinating core reporting deliverables, you will partner across Accounting, Legal, FP&A, Equity Ops, Tax, Investor Relations, senior Finance leadership, and external auditors to support disclosure processes, governance materials, and reporting requirements tied to complex accounting matters.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex processes, thrives in fast-paced environments, and wants to deepen their experience in both SEC reporting and technical accounting. You will gain exposure to new accounting standard adoption, disclosure analysis, and transaction-related workstreams, including M&A and other strategic projects.

Responsibilities

  • Independently manage recurring financial reporting and close workstreams, including journal entry preparation, reconciliations, and financial analysis, with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Support quarterly and annual SEC reporting activities, including preparation and coordination for Forms 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Coordinate timelines, stakeholder feedback, and sign-offs across Accounting, Legal, FP&A, Equity Ops, Tax, Investor Relations, senior Finance leadership, and external auditors.
  • Prepare and maintain reporting support, disclosure checklists, sign-off packages, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Support materials for Disclosure Committee, Audit Committee, earnings-related deliverables, and other reporting governance processes.
  • Partner on technical accounting matters that have disclosure or external reporting implications, including adoption of new accounting standards such as ASU 2024-03, Disaggregation of Income Statement Expenses (“DISE”).
  • Contribute to technical accounting and special projects, including M&A, strategic transactions, and other non-routine accounting matters.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, technical accounting, audit, or corporate accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial statement reporting.
  • Experience supporting SEC reporting processes, including 10-Q and 10-K preparation and review.
  • Experience working in reporting at a publicly traded company.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional partners.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • CPA preferred.
  • Experience with technical accounting topics, including new accounting standard adoption, complex accounting issues, and disclosure analysis.
  • Experience preparing or supporting technical accounting memoranda, reporting support, or external reporting disclosures.
  • Experience supporting M&A, strategic transactions, or other special accounting projects.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior State Government Affairs Manager, Texas & Southeast
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do:

The CoreWeave Legal and Government Affairs (LGA) team is highly collaborative and partners closely with teams across the company to navigate complex policy, regulatory, and business environments while enabling innovation and growth. The team is pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and deeply engaged in strategic decision-making, with a strong emphasis on building trusted relationships across the organization.

As Senior State Government Affairs Manager, you will lead state government affairs across assigned states and influence legislative outcomes impacting CoreWeave’s ability to grow and operate. You will build trusted relationships with state executives, policymakers, and staff. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are eager to make a significant impact, CoreWeave is the place for you.

About the Role

Reporting to the Director of State Government Affairs, the Senior Manager will help shape CoreWeave’s state government affairs strategy and advance policy initiatives that support the company’s expansion and growth.

You’ll work closely with governors’ offices, state legislators, economic development agencies, in-state consultants, trade associations, and advocacy groups to advance CoreWeave’s objectives at the state level. This role combines deep policy analysis, relationship building, and strategic execution, with a focus on expanding CoreWeave’s data center footprint growth and supporting economic development through AI innovation.

You’ll represent CoreWeave before state lawmakers and other key stakeholders, execute on our government affairs priorities, and help shape the policy environment in markets where we operate and seek to grow. This role is ideal for a proactive, commercially minded professional who thrives in building coalitions, identifying opportunities, and translating policy analysis into business outcomes.

In this role you will:

  • Own and lead CoreWeave’s legislative and political engagement for your assigned states in the Southeast region.
  • Develop and execute state-specific engagement plans that identify key stakeholders, anticipate emerging issues, establish engagement milestones, and recommend practical courses of action and escalation paths.
  • Monitor, analyze, and interpret state legislative and regulatory developments relevant to data centers, AI infrastructure, energy policy, and economic development across the region.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with state lawmakers, staff, and key stakeholders to support CoreWeave’s state-level priorities.
  • Conduct policy research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for CoreWeave participation in coalitions, working groups, and advocacy initiatives.
  • Coordinate with internal cross-functional stakeholders (commercial, legal, communications, operations) to ensure consistent messaging and alignment around state government objectives.
  • Represent CoreWeave at relevant hearings, industry events, and stakeholder meetings.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive professional experience in multi-state government affairs, legislative affairs, or a closely related policy role.
  • Deep understanding of state legislative and regulatory processes and how they translate to business outcomes.
  • Proven track record of building and managing bipartisan relationships with government officials and policymakers.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex policy information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for different audiences.
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, and drive projects to completion.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ability to operate in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute strategies within a collaborative team structure.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong multi-state government affairs experience.
  • Experience in tech, tax policy, energy policy, or infrastructure development.
  • Knowledge of AI, cloud computing, or related technology sectors.
  • Experience with coalition building or advocacy campaign management.
  • Familiarity with the political landscape and key decision-makers in multiple state markets, with particular focus on Texas.
  • Track record of generating business results or revenue impact from government affairs work.

Work Environment

  • Location: Remote (based in Texas)
  • Travel: Frequent travel to state capitals and key markets throughout the Southeast region and to conferences is required (estimated 40-50% of time)
  • This is a domestic position focused on the United States

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You love building bipartisan relationships and turning a first meeting with a legislator into a lasting partnership.
  • You're curious about how data centers can be good neighbors, from paying for the grid upgrades they require and using closed-loop cooling to becoming a lasting source of tax revenue, jobs, and infrastructure that helps a region grow.
  • You’re curious about how energy, tax, and infrastructure policy shape where the next generation of AI infrastructure gets built.
  • You’re an expert at reading a state political landscape and finding a practical path to shape issues.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $143,000 to $191,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. jobs.title: Director, Strategic AI Partnerships
jobs.description:
Role Description

The Dropbox Business Development team builds strategic partnerships that expand product adoption, create new distribution channels, and drive long-term customer and revenue growth. We are hiring a Director of Strategic AI Partnerships to own a focused portfolio of Dropbox’s highest-priority AI relationships, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.

You will define and execute multi-year strategies across product integration, distribution, enterprise GTM, commercial agreements, and joint marketing. The opportunity goes beyond maintaining individual integrations: you will identify where Dropbox and each partner can create differentiated customer value, align executives and product leaders around a small number of high-impact workstreams, and move those workstreams from concept through agreement, launch, adoption, and growth.

This role requires enough technical fluency to shape product discussions involving AI assistants and agents, native content experiences, connectors and MCP, authentication and account linking, model and platform capabilities, and governed access to customer content. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Communications, and senior executives to translate strategic ambition into clear owners, milestones, commercial terms, and measurable outcomes.

The role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area to support frequent in-person engagement with partner teams and Dropbox leadership. Success requires executive presence, product and commercial judgment, and the ability to create momentum in relationships where the opportunity is large but the path is not predetermined.

Responsibilities

  • Own executive and operating relationships with a small portfolio of Tier 1 AI partners, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.
  • Build partner-specific, multi-year strategies that connect Dropbox priorities with each partner’s product roadmap, enterprise motion, distribution, and strategic objectives.
  • Identify and structure high-impact opportunities across native integrations, AI-agent workflows, enterprise identity and administration, model or platform collaboration, joint GTM, distribution, and co-marketing.
  • Lead complex commercial and strategic negotiations, balancing customer value, product feasibility, reciprocal economics, data and security requirements, and long-term positioning.
  • Drive cross-functional execution from opportunity definition through technical scoping, agreement, launch, adoption, and expansion, with clear internal and external owners.
  • Establish executive governance, operating cadences, escalation paths, joint roadmaps, and scorecards that keep the most important workstreams moving.
  • Provide market intelligence and a clear point of view on the AI ecosystem, using partner and customer evidence to influence Dropbox product, GTM, and corporate strategy.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, product partnerships, enterprise technology, cloud platforms, AI, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success owning complex, high-value relationships with major technology platforms and engaging directly with senior executives.
  • Track record of creating and negotiating strategic agreements that combine product, technical, commercial, distribution, and marketing components.
  • Technical fluency across AI models and agents, APIs, connectors, MCP, enterprise identity and administration, content workflows, and cloud or developer platforms.
  • Strong product and commercial judgment, including the ability to prioritize opportunities, build business cases, evaluate reciprocal value, and make clear tradeoffs.
  • Ability to lead through influence across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to travel for partner and company engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, or comparable AI and technology platforms.
  • Experience launching native integrations or strategic platform experiences used by enterprise and consumer customers.
  • Experience building enterprise AI partnerships involving identity, administration, security, distribution, or model consumption.
  • Strong public-speaking and executive-presentation skills, including experience representing a company in high-visibility partner settings.
  • Demonstrated use of AI and automation to improve research, partner preparation, operating cadence, and decision quality.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

$253,300—$342,700 USD

US Zone 2

$228,000—$308,400 USD

US Zone 3

$202,600—$274,200 USD

  • Lead some of our more complex client relationships, acting as the senior point of contact for those clients
  • Develop and maintain strategic account plans for your key clients
  • Lead renewal and contract negotiations for your accounts, including extensions and multi-year agreements, and agree renewal close plans with the Regional Director, EMEA

What you have

  • Strong commercial acumen, including building business cases and forecasting

  • Analytical, with proficiency in data visualisation

Perks

jobs.title: Manager, Training and Enablement
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As Manager, Training & Enablement, you will lead the team that empowers Cloudbeds colleagues and customers through product and hotel operations training. You will own the knowledge, content and learning programs behind it, and bring our new knowledge engine to life. You will also build the operations hub for Customer Success knowledge: documented processes, a content library and the standards behind them. You will run an AI-assisted operating model with expert human oversight. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the vision for how our teams learn, simplify and speed up how the work gets done, and act as the main liaison between Training & Enablement and our cross-functional partners. You will have the chance to shape functional strategy and scale your impact as the team grows.

Our Training & Enablement Team:

Our team is where Hospitality Hearts meet AI Smarts. We are a fully remote, multilingual group of trainers, writers, localization specialists and hospitality veterans who turn a fast-moving product into knowledge people can use. We test and learn, use AI to strip out drafting and lookup work, and keep people on teaching, judgment and quality. Our principle: standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Lead, coach and develop the team across knowledge, delivery and operations. Own hiring, capacity planning and metrics, and set an intake and review framework with a published scope charter.
• Bring the knowledge engine to life. Run a content engine that turns product updates into role-based knowledge assets, linking content to the Jira tickets that carry releases and sourcing release notes from them. Manage knowledge base architecture and tagging so the content library works for two readers, people and AI tools, and hold the line on quality, brand voice and terminology.
• Run an AI- assisted operating model. Sort workflows by automation level, keep human oversight on high judgment work, own the verification of AI-generated content (who reviews it, to what standard, and how errors are caught before publishing), and build the team’s AI skills through continuous learning and smart tooling choices.
• Document how Customer Success operates: processes, escalation paths and hand-offs, and a library of the macros and templates teams use with customers, kept current and searchable.
• Design modular, role-based learning programs for internal teams and customers, built on unified content, covering Cloudbeds processes as well as the product with live training reserved for interactive problem-solving. Add badging and certification to validate product expertise, grounded in practical hospitality context.
• Manage live delivery schedules, global time-zone coverage and contractors, and set localization policy that pairs AI-assisted translation with human review.
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Ops on release readiness and customer feedback. Oversee enablement platforms and vendors, and use performance data to refine programs and show business value.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• 5+ years in training, enablement, learning and development, learning technology, knowledge management or customer education, with a record of running learning or content programs at scale and measuring outcomes such as time to competence, ticket deflection or content accuracy
• 2+ years leading a team, including specialists across several countries and time zones
• Hands-on AI builder: you have created learning, training or content solutions with AI, can show what you built and explain how you designed it, and know where human review must stay
• Vision and creativity: a fresh point of view on how people learn, an eye for retiring process and speeding things up with new tooling, and a self-driven habit of experimenting with new ways to teach and build
• Confidence with learning and knowledge tools, such as an LMS (for example Docebo) and content platforms, and the judgment to know when to adopt or replace them
• Skill at setting scope and saying no clearly to partners across Product, Support, Sales and Operations without relying on authority, and at turning throughput, survey and support data into priorities and a business case
• Strong written and spoken communication with a global audience, fluent English, and calm, self-directed work in a results-driven, remote-first, fast-growing environment. A “mop bucket” attitude: some days you are the planner, the trainer and the editor in the same afternoon.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

• Hospitality or hospitality-technology experience (a PMS or SaaS company, or hotel training)
• Experience commissioning, building or managing a knowledge engine or AI knowledge base, including structuring content and tagging for retrieval
• Experience documenting operational processes or running an operations function for a support or customer success team
• Portuguese, Spanish or Thai

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $110,000 and $135,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. (The salary is only for US-based candidates).

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Cloudbeds Awards:

  • Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

  • Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Discover our Benefits:

  • Remote First, Remote Always

  • PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

  • Fully Paid Parental Leave

  • Home office stipend based on country of residency

  • Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

  • Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring process.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. jobs.title: Senior Sales Development Representative - 4 Day Week + Remote
jobs.description:
Still get a buzz from a cold call? Good. So do we.

Our SDRs call commercial, project and operations leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms. They're busy, they're blunt, and they've heard every software pitch going (some of them twice before lunch). Earn their two minutes, find a genuine problem on a live project, and you'll hand over a meeting your Account Executive can actually win.

You've done this before, so you know a full calendar isn't the same as a good one. Here, quality wins every time, and you'll have a playbook that works, coaching from people who know construction, and a team that backs you to do it properly.

If you want your experience to count for more than your dial count, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

You're where every Shape deal starts, and one of the people who sets the standard for how we prospect. As you grow, you'll shape our messaging and set the bar for the SDRs who join after you.

What the job actually is

You know the job. Most of your day is on the phone, and you'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" more than anything else. Here, you'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself.

You also know that to be good at cold calling, you have to genuinely love it. If you don't, and you plan to go through the motions, it's a boring job, and it shows on every call. We're looking for someone who still gets a buzz from turning a cold "who's this?" into a real conversation.

Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we want people who feel the same. You'll know a booked meeting isn't the same as a good one. Here, it means understanding their problem properly: being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and knowing by the end of the call what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. It also means only offering a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having.

How the team is set up

You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell.

Where you'll work

Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future.

Why it's worth it

  • A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way.
  • Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers.
  • Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones.
  • A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch.
  • Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown.
  • You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook.
  • A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days.

Your top responsibilities

  • Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide.
  • Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off.
  • Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you.
  • Raise the bar: once you're up to speed, share what's working, contribute to the playbook and help newer SDRs get better faster.

Your roadmap: your first 30 days and beyond

You bring the experience. We'll make sure you're selling the Shape way, with confidence, by week 3 or 4.

  • Before day 1, ready to go: your CRM, dialler, call recording and your own Shape login set up, so week 1 is spent learning.
  • Week 1, understand the why: the problems we solve, who for, and why it beats how contractors work today, with the product shown in action by Customer Success.
  • Week 2, build your pitch: write your first-call pitch, compare it with the winning calls in our library, get it reviewed, and make your first live calls if you're ready.
  • Weeks 3–4, up and running: calling daily with call reviews, booking your first meetings and handing them over properly.
  • By day 30: signed off as ready to call, every call in the library listened to, and your first measures reviewed with your manager.
  • Months 2–3, ramp: half the full target, with your own quality scorecard.
  • By the end of month 3, full target: the same target every SDR carries, in line with your probation period.
  • 6–12 months, step up: own a set of key accounts or a segment, help refine our messaging and set the bar for newer SDRs, with a clear path to Account Executive or SDR Team Lead.

Why three months is realistic: it's quick by industry standards, and that's deliberate. You won't be figuring it out alone. You'll have a playbook built from calls that have won, regular call reviews, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. Training never stops at day 30, however experienced you are.

How you'll be measured

Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having?

Your main target is qualified meetings attended: meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week.

No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics.

What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there.

A start-up at a pivotal point

If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next.

You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way.

We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone.

Your Capabilities

Must haves:

  • Proven outbound experience at a senior level: 2+ years of phone-led B2B prospecting into directors and heads of department, in a complex sale where several people are involved in each decision and sales cycles are longer.
  • A track record: you've been at or above target for most of the last 12 months, and you can show it.
  • Your own toughest critic: you can listen back to your own call and say what worked, what didn't and what you'd change.
  • A forever learner: however good you get, you never feel you know enough. You're always looking for the next thing to learn, and you go after it.

What we look for in you

  • Numbers-obsessed: you know why your numbers are what they are: not just dials and meetings booked, but how many showed, how many qualified and what you changed when one dipped.
  • Quality over volume: you'd choose a better conversation over a faster one. You test the problem before you pitch and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Quick on your feet, and a genuine listener: calls rarely go word perfect. You think creatively, react to what's actually been said, and listen to understand. Construction people can spot a fake a mile off, and so can we.
  • A strategist who takes action: you plan who to call, when and why, run your own day and keep your CRM honest. Then you act, without waiting to be told.
  • You've done your homework: you understand the problems construction teams face, and you can say clearly why construction and why this job.
  • A sponge, with no ego: however good you are, you soak up how we do things here and take feedback on your calls. Egos stay at the door, on both sides.

Why experience alone isn't enough

Experience gets you an interview, but it isn't what gets you the job. We've seen numbers-first sales cultures produce full calendars and empty pipelines, so we're looking for experience that's still coachable.

Nice to have (if you don't have it now, you will after joining)

  • Experience selling into construction, engineering or infrastructure.
  • Having helped build or improve a playbook, sequence or messaging.
  • Start-up or scale-up experience.
  • Experience managing your own pipeline in a CRM and using diallers and other sales tools.
  • Construction site experience, or time working in the industry.
  • Full-cycle (360) sales experience, from first call through to close.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

Apply with your CV and a cover letter answering these three questions:

  1. Why construction, and why this job?
  2. What do you think are the biggest problems facing the people we'd have you calling?
  3. What's the number you're most proud of from your current or last role, and why?

A note on AI: yes, we use it every day, and you're welcome to use it to research or sharpen your thinking. But right now this is about getting to know you, so make sure your answers sound like you. There are no wrong answers. We'd rather hear what you really think, even if it's not completely accurate.

What happens next

Every application is read by the people you'd work with. We move quickly, and you'll hear back at every stage. After an initial screen, there are three stages:

  • Meet and greet: we get to know each other and make sure we're aligned on expectations, both yours and ours.
  • Mock call with feedback: a role-play cold call. We'll give you feedback and see how you use it. We'll prepare you for this, and nobody expects it to be perfect.
  • Meet the team, then a decision: meet the people you'd be working with every day. Then we'll give you a clear answer either way, with feedback.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.title: Presales Architect
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Presales Architect.

About the job

This position is needed to drive technical wins and design scalable customer engagement solutions using Twilio's API platform.

As a Presales Architect, you will act as the trusted technical advisor for our most strategic enterprise prospects. You will bridge the gap between complex business problems and Twilio's powerful communication APIs, crafting innovative architectures that drive customer success. By partnering closely with the sales team, you will lead technical discovery, build compelling proofs-of-concept, and demonstrate how Twilio can transform a company's customer engagement strategy.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with enterprise sales executives to lead technical discovery sessions, understanding complex business requirements and translating them into comprehensive Twilio solutions.
  • Design and architect scalable, secure, and resilient communication workflows using Twilio's suite of APIs (SMS, Voice, Video, Flex, etc.) tailored to client-specific use cases.
  • Develop and deliver compelling technical demonstrations, custom prototypes, and proofs-of-concept (POCs) that clearly articulate the business value of the Twilio platform.
  • Mitigate technical risks and overcome objections during the sales cycle by providing authoritative guidance on security, compliance, integration patterns, and architectural best practices.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to relay critical market feedback, feature requests, and emerging trends from the field to influence the Twilio roadmap.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in a presales, sales engineering, or solutions architecture role, preferably within the CCaaS, CPaaS, or broader enterprise SaaS industry.
  • Technical Skills: Demonstrated proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, or C#) and hands-on experience integrating and troubleshooting RESTful APIs.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex cloud architecture, web security, and enterprise integration concepts for both technical and C-level non-technical stakeholders.

Desired:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Curious and willingness to work with ambiguity.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Singapore.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 50% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

We’re the layer between the home and the grid. Our platform connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one. Asset connectivity gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands. Home energy coordination turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar. Residential flexibility brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on.

Europe’s largest energy companies build on Enode: retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. We’re looking for people who take ownership, think clearly under complexity and care deeply about the craft of building software that matters.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer for our new Deployment team. The team works inside Europe's largest energy retailers, deep in their software architecture, to turn Enode's platform into infrastructure that enables steering large fleets of residential load. A retailer's charging data arrives in several formats from a few legacy systems and their team has been blocked for weeks: you are the person who unblocks them.

You'll join as one of the first members of the team, working directly with our Head of Deployment, Ben Brandt. There is no playbook yet, and you'll help write it. Every deployment should make the next one faster.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical delivery of customer deployments from discovery to production: understand the customer's architecture, scope the work, sequence it and flag blockers early

  • Sit with customer architects and earn the right to change how their systems work

  • Write production code in the customer's environment and in Enode, and know which is which. Anything we would build twice becomes Enode code.

  • Build agents, harnesses, customer-facing MCP servers and tooling that make every deployment faster than the last

  • Run your work with AI in the loop, and turn what works into something the team can reuse

  • Turn what you see in the field into concrete ideas for product and engineering to become part of the core product

  • Travel to customer sites for up to 50% of your time

This role will be right for you if:

  • You have 5+ years building and shipping production software, with real contact with customers or users, ideally as a forward-deployed engineer at large Enterprises

  • AI is how you work by default, in and outside of work, and you can raise the bar of people who already consider themselves advanced

  • You're technically credible with enterprise architects, including in messy legacy environments

  • You get more excited by the customer's outcome than by the most elegant technical solution

  • You're comfortable in high ambiguity and take ownership of large pieces of work

  • You can tell a customer they are wrong, and be proven right

  • You're genuinely interested in the energy transition

  • Bonus: experience in energy, mobility or connected devices; early-engineer or founder experience; a forward-deployed background, for example at Palantir; fluency in another major European language

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

  • A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

  • Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

  • Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

  • Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

  • Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

  • Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

  • Flexible, human-first culture.

  • Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

  • Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here.

jobs.description:

We are looking for an Account Manager to build long-term, supportive relationships with our clients across a wide-ranging customer base. You will look after a portfolio of assigned accounts, help shape partnership plans for them, and actively look for opportunities to grow mutual revenues.

You will take real ownership of your client accounts and act as the internal “voice of the client”. Externally you will be the face of SeatGeek, representing the business in every client interaction. Creating and maintaining strong working relationships with customers and colleagues alike, will be essential.

You will keep track of the health of each client’s business and help them meet their KPIs. By understanding what each client needs, you will bring insights and solutions that grow their business and you will present SeatGeek’s latest product and service updates. You will also advocate for your clients and partners across the organisation. Success in this role comes from a passion for creating a better ticketing experience for venues, rights holders and their fans. This role will suit an Account Manager who wants to work with some of the most progressive and established sports brands in Europe. It is home based, with about 30% travel and time on customer sites expected across our UK client base.

What you'll do
